1.1: Ubusisiwe umuntu ongahambi ngeziluleko zababi, ongemi endleleni yezoni, ongahlali enkundleni yabaklolodayo,
1.2: kepha okuthokoza kwakhe kusemthethweni kaJehova, ozindla ngomthetho wakhe imini nobusuku.
1.3: Unjengomuthi otshaliwe ngasemifuleni yamanzi, othela isithelo sawo ngesikhathi sawo, oqabunga lawo lingabuni, nakho konke akwenzayo uyakuba nenhlanhla kukho.
1.4: Ababi abanjalo, kepha banjengamakhoba aphephethwa ngumoya.
1.5: Ngalokho ababi abayikuma ekwahlulelweni, nezoni ebandleni labalungileyo.
1.6: Ngokuba uJehova uyayazi indlela yabalungileyo, kodwa indlela yababi yobhubha.

2.1: Kungani ukuba abezizwe baxokozele, nabantu bazindle ngokuyize na?
2.2: Amakhosi omhlaba ayazihlanganisa, nababusi baceba icebo ngoJehova nangogcotshiweyo wakhe ngokuthi:
2.3: “Masigqabule izibopho zabo, silahle izintambo zabo, zisuke kithina.”
2.4: Yena ohlezi ezulwini uyahleka, iNkosi iyabadelela.
2.5: Ibisikhuluma kubo ngentukuthelo yayo, ibethuse ngolaka lwayo, ithi:
2.6: “Nokho ngibekile iNkosi yami eSiyoni, intaba yami engcwele.”
2.7: Ngizakulanda ngesinqumo: uJehova wathi kimi: “Uyindodana yami wena; namuhla ngikuzele.
2.8: Cela kimi, ngikunike abezizwe babe yifa lakho, nemikhawulo yomhlaba ibe yimfuyo yakho.
2.9: Uzakubaphula ngentonga yensimbi, ubaphahlaze njengesitsha sombumbi.”
2.10: Ngakho hlakaniphani nina makhosi; yalekani nina bahluleli bomhlaba.
2.12: Yangeni indodana, ingaze ithukuthele, nibhubhe endleleni, ngokuba ulaka lwayo luyakuvutha masinyane. Babusisiwe bonke abaphephela kuyo.

3.1: Hhawu, Jehova, ziningi izitha zami. Baningi abangivukelayo.
3.2: Baningi abathi emphefumulweni wami: “Akukho ukusinda kwakhe kuNkulunkulu.”
3.3: Kepha wena Jehova uyisihlangu kimi, uludumo lwami nophakamisa ikhanda lami.
3.4: Ngezwi lami ngiyakhala kuJehova; yena uyangiphendula esentabeni yakhe engcwele.
3.5: Ngalala phansi, ngazunywa ngubuthongo; ngavuka, ngokuba uJehova ungiphasile.
3.6: Angesabi amashumi ezinkulungwane zabantu abangihaqile nxazonke.
3.7: Vuka, Jehova, ungisindise, Nkulunkulu wami, ngokuba zonke izitha zami uzishayile emhlathini, amazinyo ababi uwaphulile.
3.8: Insindiso ingekaJehova; isibusiso sakho masibe kubantu bakho.

4.1: Ngiphendule ekukhaleni kwami, Nkulunkulu wokulunga kwami. Ekucindezelweni wangenzela indawo; yiba nomusa kimi, uzwe umkhuleko wami.
4.2: Madodana abantu, koze kube nini ubukhosi bami budunyazwa na? Koze kube nini nithanda okuyize, nifuna amanga, na?
4.3: Yazini ukuthi uJehova uzahlukanisele omesabayo; uJehova uyezwa lapha ngikhala kuye.
4.4: Thukuthelani ningoni; zindlani enhliziyweni yenu okhukhweni lwenu, nithule.
4.6: Baningi abathi: “Ngubani oyakusibonisa okuhle na?” Jehova, phakamisa ukukhanya kobuso bakho phezu kwethu.
4.7: Ubeke injabulo enhliziyweni yami edlula eyamabele abo newayini labo sekuvamile.
4.8: Ngizakucambalala ngokuthula, ngilale ubuthongo, ngokuba wena Jehova wedwa ungihlalisa ngokulondeka.

5.1: Yizwa amazwi ami, Jehova, uqaphele ukuzindla kwami.
5.2: Yizwa izwi lokukhala kwami, Nkosi yami, Nkulunkulu wami, ngokuba ngithandaza kuwe.
5.3: Jehova, ekuseni uyalizwa izwi lami; ekuseni ngiyakuzibika kuwe, ngilinde.
5.4: Ngokuba wena awusiye uNkulunkulu othanda okubi; omubi akanakuhlala kuwe.
5.5: Abazidlayo abayikuma phambi kwamehlo akho; uyabazonda bonke abenza okubi.
5.6: Uyabhubhisa abakhuluma amanga; uJehova uyamenyanya umuntu wegazi nowenkohliso.
5.7: Kepha mina ngiyakungena endlini yakho ngobuningi bomusa wakho, ngikhothame ngokukuhlonipha, ngibhekene nendawo yakho engcwele.
5.8: Jehova, ngihole ngokulunga kwakho ngenxa yezitha zami, ulungise indlela yakho phambi kobuso bami.
5.9: Ngokuba alikho iqiniso emlonyeni wabo; izibilini zabo zingukonakala: umphimbo wabo uyithuna elivulekileyo; bayathopha ngolimi lwabo.
5.10: Balahle ngecala, Nkulunkulu. Mabawe ngenxa yamacebo abo, ubawise ngobuningi beziphambeko zabo, ngokuba bahlubukile kuwe.
5.11: Kepha mabajabule bonke abathemba kuwe, bahalalise kuze kube phakade, abathanda igama lakho bethabela kuwe.
5.12: Ngokuba wena Jehova uyambusisa olungileyo; umphahla ngomusa njengesihlangu.

6.1: Jehova, ungangijezisi ngentukuthelo yakho, ungangishayi ngolaka lwakho.
6.2: Yiba nomusa kimi, Jehova, ngokuba ngidangele; ngiphilise, Jehova, ngokuba amathambo ami ayathuthumela,
6.3: nomphefumulo wami uyathuthumela, kepha wena Jehova, koze kube nini na?
6.4: Buya, Jehova, ukhulule umphefumulo wami, ungisindise ngenxa yesihawu sakho.
6.5: Ngokuba akukho ukukhumbula wena ekufeni; ngubani oyakukubonga endaweni yabafileyo na?
6.6: Ngikhathele ukububula kwami; ngimanzisa icansi lami njalo ebusuku, ngimanzisa ukhukho lwami ngezinyembezi zami.
6.7: Iso lami liyafiphala ngokudabuka; liyaguga ngenxa yezitha zami zonke.
6.8: Dedani kimi nina nonke enenza okubi, ngokuba uJehova ulizwile izwi lokukhala kwami;
6.9: uJehova uzwile ukunxusa kwami, uJehova uyamukela umkhuleko wami.
6.10: Zonke izitha zami ziyakujabha, zishaywe luvalo; ziyakuhlehla, zijabhe ngokuphazima kweso.

7.2: ngisindise kubo bonke abangizingelayo, ungikhulule, bangaze bawudwengule umphefumulo wami njengengonyama eklebhula, kungekho okhululayo.
7.3: Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, uma ngikwenzile lokho, uma kukhona okubi ezandleni zami,
7.4: uma ngiphindise okubi kohlalisene nami ngokuthula, ngaphanga isitha sami kungekho sici,
7.5: isitha masiwuzingele umphefumulo wami, siwufice, sikunyathele phansi ukuphila kwami, nesithunzi sami sisilahle phansi othulini.
7.6: Sukuma, Jehova, ngentukuthelo yakho, uvuke ngenxa yolaka lwezitha zami, ungimele; ngokuba uyalezile ukwahlulela.
7.7: Umhlangano wezizwe mawukuphahle, ubuyele phezulu ngaphezu kwawo.
7.8: UJehova uyahlulela izizwe; ngahlulele, Jehova, ngokulunga kwami nangobuqotho bami obukimi.
7.9: Makuphele ukonakala kwababi, kepha olungileyo mawumqinise. Nguwe phela ohlola izinhliziyo nezinso, Nkulunkulu olungileyo.
7.10: Isihlangu sami sikuNkulunkulu osindisa abaqotho ngenhliziyo.
7.11: UNkulunkulu ungumahluleli olungileyo; unguNkulunkulu othukuthela imihla yonke.
7.12: Uma umuntu engaphenduki, uyakulola inkemba yakhe, ansale umnsalo wakhe, awulungisele,
7.13: izikhali zokubulala azibhekisele kuye; imicibisholo uyenza ishise.
7.14: Unemihelo ngobubi; ukhulelwe ngukona, uzala amanga.
7.15: Umgodi uwumba, uwugubha, kepha ukhalakathela egebeni alenzileyo.
7.16: Ukwelelesa kwakhe kubuyela ekhanda lakhe; ubudlwangudlwangu bakhe behlela okhakhayini lwakhe.
7.17: Ngizakumbonga uJehova ngokokulunga kwakhe, ngihubele igama likaJehova oPhezukonke.

8.1: Jehova Nkosi yethu, igama lakho liyababazeka kangaka emhlabeni wonke! wena owabeka inkazimulo yakho ezulwini.
8.2: Ngomlomo wezingane nowabancelayo wagxilisa amandla ngenxa yabamelene nawe ukuba uthulise isitha nophindisayo.
8.3: Lapha ngibuka izulu lakho, umsebenzi weminwe yakho, inyanga nezinkanyezi ozimisileyo,
8.4: umuntu uyini ukuba umkhumbule, nendodana yomuntu ukuba uyinake na?
8.5: Wamenza waba ngaphansana kukaNkulunkulu, wamqhelisa ngenkazimulo nangobukhosi.
8.6: Wamenza abe ngumbusi phezu kwemisebenzi yezandla zakho; konke wakubeka phansi kwezinyawo zakhe:
8.7: izimvu, nezinkomo zonke, yebo, nezilwane zasendle,
8.8: nezinyoni zezulu, nezinhlanzi zolwandle, nakho konke okuhamba ezindleleni zolwandle.
8.9: Jehova Nkosi yethu, igama lakho liyababazeka kangaka emhlabeni wonke!

9.1: Ngiyakumbonga uJehova ngayo yonke inhliziyo yami; ngiyakulanda zonke izimangaliso zakho.
9.2: Ngiyakujabula, ngethabe kuwe; ngiyakudumisa igama lakho wena oPhezukonke,
9.3: ngokuba izitha zami zibuyela emuva, ziwa, zibhubha ebusweni bakho,
9.4: ngokuba ulimelele ilungelo lami nendaba yami, uhlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi, ungumahluleli olungileyo.
9.5: Ujezisile abezizwe, wabhubhisa ababi; igama labo ulesulile kuze kube phakade naphakade.
9.6: Izitha ziphelile, zachitheka kuze kube phakade; imizi wayisimbula, ukukhunjulwa kwayo kwaphela nya.
9.7: UJehova uyabusa kuze kube phakade; isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi usimisela ukwahlulela;
9.8: umhlaba uyakuwahlulela ngokulunga, athethe amacala ezizwe ngobuqotho.
9.9: UJehova uyinqaba yocindezelweyo, uyinqaba ezikhathini zokuhlupheka.
9.10: Nabalaziyo igama lakho bayakwethemba wena; ngokuba wena Jehova awubashiyi abakufunayo.
9.11: Hubani nimdumise uJehova ohlezi eSiyoni; memezelani ezizweni izenzo zakhe ezinkulu.
9.12: Ngokuba yena ophindisela igazi uyabakhumbula abahluphekayo; akakhohlwa ukukhala kwabo.
9.13: Yiba nomusa kimi, Jehova; kubone engihlupheka ngakho ngabangizondayo wena ongiphakamisa emasangweni okufa,
9.14: ukuze ngilande ngalo lonke udumo lwakho, ngethabe ngokusindisa kwakho emasangweni endodakazi yaseSiyoni.
9.15: Abezizwe bashone phansi egebeni abalenzileyo; unyawo lwabo lubhajwe esihibeni abasifihlileyo.
9.16: UJehova uzazisile, wahlulela; umcuphile omubi emsebenzini wezandla zakhe.
9.17: Ababi bayakubuyela endaweni yabafileyo, bonke abezizwe abakhohlwa uNkulunkulu.
9.18: Ngokuba ompofu kayikukhohlakala njalo; ithemba labahluphekayo aliyikunyamalala kuze kube phakade.
9.19: Vuka, Jehova! Mawungavumi ukuba abantu bahlule; abezizwe mabahlulelwe ebusweni bakho.
9.20: Mabashaywe luvalo, Jehova; abezizwe mabazazi ukuthi bangabantu nje.

10.1: Jehova, umeleni kude na? Uzifihlelani ubuso ezikhathini zokuhlupheka na?
10.2: Ngokuqhosha komubi ompofu uyahlupheka; mababanjwe ngamacebo abawacebileyo.
10.3: Ngokuba omubi uyazigabisa ngokufisa komphefumulo wakhe, nohulazayo uyamvalelisa, amdelele uJehova.
10.4: Omubi ngokuzikhukhumeza kobuso bakhe uthi: “Akanaki lutho; akakho uNkulunkulu,” injalo imicabango yakhe yonke.
10.5: Izindlela zakhe zithembekile izikhathi zonke; izahlulelo zakho ziphakeme kakhulu kunokubona kwakhe; zonke izitha zakhe uyazidelela.
10.6: Uthi enhliziyweni yakhe: “Angiyikuzanyazanyiswa; izizukulwane nezizukulwane angisoze ngehlelwa ngozi.”
10.7: Umlomo wakhe ugcwele isiqalekiso nenkohliso nobudlova; ngaphansi kolimi lwakhe kukhona ukwelelesa nokonakala.
10.8: Uhlezi ezindaweni zokuqamekela zemizi; ezindaweni ezisithekileyo uyambulala ongenacala; amehlo akhe ayamhlwaya othithibeleyo.
10.9: Endaweni esithekileyo uqamekela njengengonyama emphandwini wayo; uhlomele ukumbamba ohluphekileyo; uyambamba ohluphekileyo ngokumngenisa esihibeni sakhe.
10.10: Uyanyonyoba, uyakhothama, abathithibeleyo bawe ngamazipho akhe.
10.11: Uthi enhliziyweni yakhe: “UNkulunkulu ukhohliwe, ubusithezile ubuso bakhe; akasoze wakubona nanini.”
10.12: Vuka, Jehova! Nkulunkulu, phakamisa isandla sakho, ungakhohlwa abahluphekileyo.
10.13: Kungani ukuba omubi adelele uNkulunkulu, athi enhliziyweni yakhe: “Awuyikukunaka,” na?
10.14: Ubonile wena; ngokuba ukukhathazeka nokuhlupheka uyakubona wena ukuze ukubeke esandleni sakho; othithibeleyo uyazinikela kuwe; wena ungumsizi wentandane.
10.15: Yaphula ingalo yomubi; buphenyisise ububi besoni, ukuze ungabe usabufumana.
10.16: UJehova uyinkosi kuze kube phakade naphakade; abezizwe bayachithwa emhlabeni wakhe.
10.17: Jehova, uyakuzwa ukulangazela kwabamnene; uyaqinisa inhliziyo yabo, indlebe yakho uyibeka kubo
10.18: ukuba wahlulele intandane nocindezelweyo, ukuze umuntu wasemhlabeni angabe esabanga uvalo.

11.1: Ngiyaphephela kuJehova; nisho kanjani kuwo umphefumulo wami ukuthi: “Balekela entabeni yenu njengenyoni, na?
11.2: Ngokuba bhekani, ababi bawunsala umnsalo wabo, babeka imicibisholo yabo entanjeni ukuba bacibishele ebumnyameni abaqotho ngenhliziyo.
11.3: Nxa izisekelo zidilizwa, olungileyo angenzani na?”
11.4: UJehova usethempelini lakhe elingcwele, uJehova, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi sisezulwini; amehlo akhe ayabuka, izinkophe zakhe ziyahlola abantwana babantu.
11.5: UJehova uyamhlola olungileyo; kepha omubi nothanda ubudlwangudlwangu umphefumulo wakhe uyamzonda.
11.6: Unisa izihibe phezu kwababi; umlilo nesibabule nomoya oshisayo kuyisabelo sendebe yabo.
11.7: Ngokuba uJehova ulungile, uyathanda ukulunga; oqotho uyakubheka ubuso bakhe.

12.1: Siza, Jehova, ngokuba owesaba uNkulunkulu akasekho, ngokuba banyamalele abathembekileyo kubantwana babantu.
12.2: Bakhuluma amanga, kwaba yilowo nalowo kumakhelwane wakhe; ngezindebe ezithophayo bakhuluma nganhliziyombili.
12.3: UJehova uyakunquma zonke izindebe ezithophayo, ulimi olukhuluma amazwi amakhulu,
12.4: abathi: “Siyakunqoba ngolimi lwethu; izindebe zethu zinathi; ngubani oyinkosi phezu kwethu na?”
12.5: “Ngenxa yokubandezeka kwabahluphekileyo nangokububula kwabampofu ngizakuvuka kalokhu,” usho uJehova, “ngimbeke ekusindisweni akulangazelelayo.”
12.6: Amazwi kaJehova angamazwi ahlanzekileyo, anjengesiliva elihlanjululwe esithandweni emhlabathini, lihlanjululwe kasikhombisa.
12.7: Wena Jehova uyakubagcina, ubavikele kulesi sizukulwane kuze kube phakade.
12.8: Abangamesabi uNkulunkulu bayashanguza nxazonke, lapho amanyala ephakeme kubantwana babantu.

13.1: Koze kube nini, Jehova, ungikhohlwa njalonjalo na? Koze kube nini usitheza ubuso bakho kimi na?
13.2: Koze kube nini ngikhathazeka emphefumulweni wami, nginosizi enhliziyweni yami usuku lonke, na? Koze kube nini isitha sami siziphakamisa phezu kwami na?
13.3: Bheka neno, ungiphendule, Jehova Nkulunkulu wami; khanyisa amehlo ami, ngize ngingalali ubuthongo bokufa,
13.4: ukuze isitha sami singasho ukuthi: “Ngimahlulile,” funa abamelene nami bethabe lapha ngintengayo.
13.5: Kepha ngiwuthembile umusa wakho; inhliziyo yami izakwethaba ngensindiso yakho;

14.1: Isiwula sithi enhliziyweni yaso: “Akakho uNkulunkulu.” Yonakele, iyanengeka imisebenzi yabo; akakho owenza okuhle.
14.2: UJehova uyabuka esezulwini abantwana babantu ukucinga ukuba ukhona yini oqondayo, ofuna uNkulunkulu.
14.3: Baphambukile bonke, bonakele bonke; akakho owenza okuhle, akakho noyedwa.
14.4: Abaqondi lutho yini bonke abenza okubi, abadla abantu bami, njengokuba bedla isinkwa, bangakhuleki kuJehova, na?
14.5: Khona besaba nokwesaba, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ukuso isizukulwane sabalungileyo.
14.6: Icebo lohluphekileyo niyalijabhisa, kepha uJehova uyisiphephelo sakhe.
14.7: Sengathi ukusindiswa kuka-Israyeli kungavela eSiyoni. Mhla uJehova ebuyisa ukuthunjwa kwabantu bakhe uJakobe uyakwethaba, u-Israyeli ajabule.

15.1: Jehova, ngubani oyakuhlala etendeni lakho na? Ngubani oyakwakha entabeni yakho engcwele na?
15.2: Yilowo ohamba ngobuqotho nowenza ukulunga, okhuluma iqiniso enhliziyweni yakhe,
15.3: ongahlebi ngolimi lwakhe, ongamoni umngane wakhe, nongamhlazi umakhelwane wakhe;
15.4: obuka onengekayo ngokuzakumenyanya, kepha ebazisa abamesabayo uNkulunkulu; ofunga ngokuzakumlimaza, nokho angalaphuli izwi lakhe;
15.5: ongatsheleki muntu imali yakhe ukuba izale, nongamukeli umvuzo ngongenacala; owenza lokhu akayikuzanyazanyiswa naphakade.

16.2: Ngithi kuJehova: “Wena uyiNkosi yami; anginakho okuhle ngaphandle kwakho.”
16.3: Abangcwele abasemhlabeni, abayizikhulu, yonke intokozo yami ikubona.
16.4: Ziningi izinhlupheko zabazizuzela omunye unkulunkulu; angiyikunikela ngeminikelo yabo yegazi; angiyikuwaphatha amagama abo ngezindebe zami.
16.5: UJehova uyisabelo esahlukaniselwe mina, nendebe yami; wena uqinisa ifa lami.
16.6: Izabelo zingehlele ezindaweni ezinhle, yebo, nginalo ifa elihle.
16.7: Ngiyakumbonga uJehova ongilulekayo; nasebusuku izinso zami ziyangiyala.
16.8: Ngimbeke uJehova njalo phambi kwami, ngokuba ungakwesokunene sami, angiyikuzanyazanyiswa.
16.9: Ngakho-ke inhliziyo yami iyajabula, nomphefumulo wami uyethaba, nenyama yami iyakuhlala ngokwethemba.
16.10: Ngokuba awuyikunikela umphefumulo wami endaweni yabafileyo; awuyikuvuma ukuba ongcwele wakho abone ukubola.
16.11: Uyakungazisa indlela yokuphila; ukugcwala kwenjabulo kusebusweni bakho; intokozo isesandleni sakho sokunene kuze kube phakade.

17.1: Yizwa ukulunga, Jehova, ulalele ukukhala kwami, ubeke indlebe emkhulekweni wami ophuma ezindebeni ezingenankohliso.
17.2: Ukwahlulelwa kwami makuvele ebusweni bakho; amehlo akho mawabheke okulungileyo.
17.3: Uyalinga inhliziyo yami; ungihambele ebusuku, uyangihlolisisa, awufumani lutho; ngiyahlosa ukuba umlomo wami ungaphambuki.
17.4: Emisebenzini yabantu ngiyazilinda, ezindleleni zezidlova ngezwi lezindebe zakho.
17.5: Izinyathelo zami zinamathela ezinyaweni zakho, izinyawo zami azisheleli.
17.6: Ngikhala kuwe, ngokuba uyangizwa, Nkulunkulu; beka indlebe yakho kimi, uzwe izwi lami.
17.7: Bonakalisa isihe sakho esimangalisayo wena osindisa ngesandla sakho sokunene labo abaphephela kuwe kwababahlaselayo.
17.8: Ngigcine njengenhlamvu yeso, ungisithe ethunzini lamaphiko akho
17.9: kubo ababi abangilimazayo, kuzo izitha zokuphila kwami ezingihaqileyo.
17.10: Bavalelwe ngamanoni abo, bakhuluma ngokuzidla ngomlomo wabo.
17.11: Noma siyaphi, bayangizungeza; amehlo abo bawabhekisa kukho ukungiwisa phansi emhlabathini.
17.12: Unjengengonyama ehahela ukubamba, njengebhongo lengonyama elilele ezindaweni ezisithekileyo.
17.13: Vuka, Jehova, umhlangabeze, umwise phansi; sindisa umphefumulo wami komubi ngenkemba yakho,
17.14: nakubantu ngesandla sakho, Jehova, abantu baleli zwe abasabelo sabo sikulokhu kuphila, nabasisu sabo usigcwalisa ngengcebo yakho, nabashiyela izingane zabo okusele kubo.
17.15: Kepha mina ngiyakubuka ubuso bakho ekulungeni, ngisuthe ngesimo sakho ekuvukeni kwami.

18.2: Jehova uyidwala lami, nenqaba yami, nomkhululi wami; uNkulunkulu wami uyidwala lami engiphephela kulo, nesihlangu sami, nophondo lokusindiswa kwami, inqaba yami ephakemeyo.
18.3: Ngiyamemeza kuJehova odumisekayo, ngisindiswe ezitheni zami.
18.4: Izintambo zokufa zangizungelezela, izikhukhula zokona zangethusa.
18.5: Izintambo zasendaweni yabafileyo zangizungeza, izihibe zokufa zangehlela.
18.6: Ekuhluphekeni kwami ngambiza uJehova, ngakhala kuNkulunkulu wami; walizwa izwi lami esethempelini lakhe; ukukhala kwami phambi kwakhe kwangena ezindlebeni zakhe.
18.7: Umhlaba wawusuzamazama, wadikizela; izisekelo zezintaba zathuthumela, zagubhuzela ngokuba ethukuthele.
18.8: Kwenyuka umusi emakhaleni akhe, nomlilo odlayo emlonyeni wakhe; amalahle avutha kuye.
18.9: Wathobisa izulu, wehla; ubumnyama babuphansi kwezinyawo zakhe.
18.10: Wakhwela phezu kwekherubi,* wandiza; washweza ngamaphiko omoya.
18.11: Ubumnyama wabenza isisibekelo, idokodo lakhe elimphahlayo; amanzi amnyama, amafu anzima.
18.12: Ekukhazimuleni okuphambi kwakhe amafu akhe abanga phambili, isichotho namalahle avuthayo.
18.13: UJehova waduma ezulwini; oPhezukonke walizwakalisa izwi lakhe: isichotho namalahle avuthayo.
18.14: Wathuma imicibisholo yakhe, wabangquzula, nemibani eminingi, wabadidizelisa.
18.15: Kwase kubonakala imisinga yamanzi; izisekelo zomhlaba zambulwa ngesijeziso sakho, Jehova, ngokufutha komoya wamakhala akho.
18.16: Waselula isandla sakhe ephezulu, wangibamba; wangikhipha emanzini amaningi.
18.17: Wangophula esitheni sami esinamandla nakubo abangizondayo, ngokuba base bengahlulile.
18.18: Bangihlasela ngosuku lwesigemegeme sami, kepha uJehova waba yinsika yami.
18.19: Wangiphumisela endaweni ebanzi; wangikhulula, ngokuba ebethokoza ngami.
18.20: UJehova wangivuza ngokokulunga kwami; wangibuyisela njengokuhlanzeka kwezandla zami.
18.21: Ngokuba ngizigcinile izindlela zikaJehova, angimukanga kuNkulunkulu wami ngokushinga.
18.22: Ngokuba yonke imithetho yakhe yayiphambi kwami, nezimiso zakhe angivumanga ukuba zisuke kimi.
18.24: UJehova wayesebuyisela kimi njengokulunga kwami, njengokuhlanzeka kwezandla zami phambi kwamehlo akhe.
18.25: Kothembekileyo uyazibonakalisa uthembekile; kumuntu oqotho uzibonakalisa uqotho;
18.26: kohlanzekileyo uyazibonakalisa uhlanzekile; koyisigwegwe uyazibonakalisa unenkani.
18.27: Ngokuba wena uyabasindisa abantu abathobekileyo, kepha amehlo abaqhoshileyo uyawathobisa.
18.28: Ngokuba wena uyokhela isibani sami; uJehova uNkulunkulu wami uyakhanyisa ubumnyama bami.
18.29: Ngokuba ngawe ngingahlasela impi; ngoNkulunkulu wami ngingeqa ugange.
18.30: Indlela kaNkulunkulu iphelele; izwi likaJehova lihlanzekile; yena uyisihlangu kubo bonke abaphephela kuye.
18.31: Ngokuba ngubani onguNkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaJehova, ngubani oyidwala ngaphandle kukaNkulunkulu wethu na?
18.32: uNkulunkulu ongibhincisa amandla, owenza indlela yami ilunge;
18.33: owenza izinyawo zami zibe njengezendluzelekazi, angimise emagqumeni ami;
18.34: ofundisa izandla zami ukulwa, ukuze izingalo zami zinsale umnsalo wethusi.
18.35: Wena unginikile isihlangu sensindiso yakho, isandla sakho sokunene singisekele, nobumnene bakho bungikhulisile.
18.36: Amabanga okunyathela kwami uwandisile; amaqakala ami awaxegi.
18.37: Ngazixosha izitha zami, ngazifica; angibuyanga ngingakaziqedi.
18.38: Ngaziphahlaza, zaze zahluleka ukuvuka; zawa phansi kwezinyawo zami.
18.39: Wangibhincisa amandla okulwa; ababengivukele wabathobisa phansi kwami.
18.41: Bakhala, kepha akubangakho osindisayo, nakuJehova, kodwa akaze aphendula.
18.42: Ngabacolisisa njengothuli emoyeni; ngabalahla njengensila ezitaladini.
18.43: Wangikhulula ezimpini zabantu; wangimisa ngaba yinhloko yabezizwe; abantu engingabaziyo bangikhonza.
18.44: Banele ukungizwa nje ngendlebe, base bengilalela; abafo bazithoba phansi kwami.
18.45: Abafo babuna, baphuma ezinqabeni zabo bethuthumele.
18.46: UJehova usekhona, malidunyiswe iDwala lami; makaphakanyiswe uNkulunkulu wensindiso yami,
18.47: uNkulunkulu onginikile impindiselo, wathobisa izizwe phansi kwami;
18.48: ongikhululile ezitheni zami, yebo, ongiphakamisile phezu kwabangivukelayo, wangikhulula kumuntu oyisidlwangudlwangu.
18.49: Ngalokho-ke ngizakukubonga phakathi kwabezizwe, Jehova, ngilihubele igama lakho.
18.50: Uyenza insindiso ibe nkulu enkosini yakhe; uyenza umusa kogcotshiweyo wakhe uDavide nasenzalweni yakhe kuze kube phakade.

19.1: Amazulu ayalanda ngenkazimulo kaJehova, nomkhathi ushumayela umsebenzi wezandla zakhe.
19.2: Usuku luyalandisa usuku inkulumo, nobusuku bushumayeza ubusuku ukwazi.
19.3: Akukho ukukhuluma, awakho amazwi, lapho izwi lingezwakali khona.
19.4: Isilinganiso sawo siphumele emhlabeni wonke namazwi awo emkhawulweni womhlaba. Ulimisele ilanga itende kulo.
19.5: Lona linjengomyeni ephuma ekamelweni lakhe; lijabulisa okweqhawe ukugijima endleleni yalo.
19.6: Ukuphuma kwalo kusemkhawulweni wezulu; ukuzungeza kwalo kuya ekugcineni kwalo; akukho okufihlelwe ukushisa kwalo.
19.7: Umthetho kaJehova uphelele, uvusa umphefumulo; ukufakaza kukaJehova kuqinisile, kuhlakaniphisa oyisiwula.
19.8: Imiyalo kaJehova ilungile, ijabulisa inhliziyo; umyalezo kaJehova uhlanzekile, ukhanyisa amehlo.
19.9: Ukumesaba uJehova kuhlanzekile, kumi kuze kube phakade; imithetho kaJehova iyiqiniso, ilungile yonke.
19.10: Inxanelekile kunegolide, kunegolide elihlanzekileyo eliningi; imnandi kunezinyosi, kunoju lwamakhekheba.
19.11: Nenceku yakho iyayalwa ngayo; oyigcinayo uyakuba nomvuzo omkhulu.
19.12: Ngubani owazi iziphosiso zakhe na? Ngithethelele kwezisithekileyo.
19.13: Yilonde inceku yakho nasezonweni ezihlazisayo; mazingabusi phezu kwami. Yikhona ngiyakube ngiphelele, ngingabe ngisaba necala eziphambekweni ezinkulu.
19.14: Amazwi omlomo wami nokuzindla kwenhliziyo yami makuthandeke ebusweni bakho, Jehova, dwala lami nomhlengi wami.

20.1: UJehova makakuphendule ngosuku lokuhlupheka; igama likaNkulunkulu kaJakobe malikuvikele.
20.2: Makakuthumele usizo lwasendlini engcwele, akusekele ngamandla aseSiyoni.
20.3: Makakhumbule yonke iminikelo yakho yokudliwa, awamukele umnikelo wakho wokushiswa.
20.4: Makakunike njengokwenhliziyo yakho, afeze icebo lakho lonke.
20.5: Siyahalalisa ngensindiso yakho, siphakamise ibhandela* egameni likaNkulunkulu wethu; uJehova makagcwalise zonke izicelo zakho.
20.6: Kalokhu ngiyazi ukuthi uJehova uyamsindisa ogcotshiweyo wakhe: esezulwini lakhe elingcwele uyamphendula ngamandla okusindisa esandla sakhe sokunene.
20.7: Abanye izinqola, abanye amahhashi, kepha thina sibonga igama likaJehova uNkulunkulu wethu.
20.8: Bayathoba, bawe; kepha thina siyavuka, sime.
20.9: Sindisa, Jehova! INkosi mayisiphendule ngosuku lokukhala kwethu.

21.1: Jehova, inkosi iyajabula ngamandla akho; iyethaba kangakanani ngensindiso yakho.
21.2: Uyinikile njengokwenhliziyo yayo, nesicelo sezindebe zayo awusinqabanga.
21.3: Ngokuba wayihlangabeza ngezibusiso zokuhle; wafaka umqhele wegolide elihle ekhanda layo.
21.4: Yacela ukuphila kuwe, wayinika khona, izinsuku ezinde kuze kube phakade naphakade.
21.5: Inkulu inkazimulo yayo ngenxa yensindiso yakho; udumo nobukhosi ukubeka phezu kwayo.
21.6: Ngokuba uyibeka ukuba ibe yisibusiso kuze kube phakade; uyithokozisa ngenjabulo ebusweni bakho.
21.7: Ngokuba inkosi iyethemba uJehova, nangenxa yesihawu soPhezukonke ayiyikuzanyazanyiswa.
21.8: Isandla sakho siyakufumana zonke izitha zakho; esokunene sakho siyakubafumana abakuzondayo.
21.9: Uyakubenza babe njengesithando somlilo, nxa ubonakalisa ubuso bakho; uJehova uyakubagwinya ngentukuthelo yakhe, umlilo uyakubaqeda.
21.10: Isithelo sabo uyakusichitha emhlabeni kanye nenzalo yabo phakathi kwabantwana babantu.
21.11: Ngokuba babehlosa okubi, baceba icebo; kepha bayahluleka.
21.12: Ngokuba uyakubafulathelisa; ngosinga lomnsalo wakho uyakukhomba ebusweni babo.
21.13: Mawuphakame, Jehova, emandleni akho; thina siyakuhlabelela, sidumise amandla akho.

22.1: Nkulunkulu wami, Nkulunkulu wami, ungishiyeleni na? Ukude namazwi okubububula kwami nokusindiswa kwami.
22.2: Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhala emini, kepha awuphenduli, nasebusuku, ngingabi nakuthula.
22.3: Kepha wena ungoNgcwele ohlezi ezibongweni zika-Israyeli.
22.4: Obaba bethu babekwethemba; babethemba, wena wabakhulula.
22.5: Bakhala kuwe, bakhululwa; bethemba wena, abaze bajabha.
22.6: Kepha mina ngiyimphethu, angisiye umuntu; ngiyisithuko sabantu, ngiyindelelo yabantu.
22.7: Bonke abangibonayo bayangiklolodela, baphukule imilomo, banikine amakhanda,
22.8: bathi: “Zinikele kuJehova; makamsindise, amkhulule, njengokuba emthanda.”
22.9: Impela nguwe owangikhipha esizalweni, wangikhoselisa ngasemabeleni kamame.
22.10: Ngaphonswa phezu kwakho kwasesizalweni; unguNkulunkulu wami kwasesizalweni sikamame.
22.11: Ungabi kude nami, ngokuba inhlupheko iseduze, nosizayo akakho.
22.12: Izinkunzi eziningi zingibunganyele, ezinamandla zaseBashani zingizungezile.
22.13: Zingikhamisele umlomo wazo njengengonyama edwengulayo nebhodlayo.
22.14: Ngichithiwe njengamanzi; onke amathambo ami enyele; inhliziyo yami injengengcina, incibilikile phakathi kwezibilini zami.
22.15: Amandla ami omile njengodengezi; ulimi lwami lunamathela olwangeni lwami; ungibeka othulini lokufa.
22.16: Ngokuba izinja ziyangibungayela; umbonda wababi ungizungezile; izandla zami nezinyawo zami bazibhobozile.
22.17: Ngingabala onke amathambo ami; bayabukela, bangibuke bengiklibhizela.
22.18: Babelana izingubo zami, benzelana inkatho ngesambatho sami.
22.19: Kepha wena Jehova mawungabi kude, wena mandla ami, shesha ungisize.
22.20: Sindisa umphefumulo wami enkembeni, ukuphila kwami emandleni ezinja.
22.21: Ngisindise emlonyeni wengonyama; nasezimpondweni zezinyathi uyangizwa.
22.22: Ngiyakushumayeza abafowethu igama lakho, ngikudumise phakathi kwebandla.
22.23: Nina enesaba uJehova, mbongeni; nina nonke nzalo kaJakobe, mdumiseni, nimesabe nina nonke nzalo ka-Israyeli.
22.24: Ngokuba akadelelanga, akanengwanga yinhlupheko yohluphekayo; akamfihlelanga ubuso bakhe, kepha nalapha ekhala kuye, wezwa.
22.25: Kuyakuvela kuwe ukudumisa kwami ebandleni elikhulu; izithembiso zami ngiyakuzigcwalisa phambi kwabamesabayo.
22.26: Abamnene bayakudla, basuthe; abafuna uJehova bayakumdumisa; inhliziyo yenu mayiphile kuze kube phakade.
22.27: Imikhawulo yonke yomhlaba iyakukhumbula, iphendukele kuJehova, nezizukulwane zonke zezizwe ziyakukhuleka ebusweni bakho.
22.28: Ngokuba umbuso ungokaJehova; nguye obusa izizwe.
22.29: Bonke abacebileyo bomhlaba bayakudla, bakhuleke; bonke abehlela othulini bayakukhothama phambi kwakhe, naye ongenakugcina umphefumulo wakhe ekuphileni.
22.30: Inzalo iyakumkhonza; isizukulwane esizayo siyakulandiswa ngayo iNkosi.
22.31: Bayakuza bashumayele ukulunga kwayo kuso isizwe esiyakuzalwa ngokuthi ikwenzile.

23.2: Uyangilalisa emadlelweni aluhlaza; uyangiyisa ngasemanzini okuphumula.
23.3: Ubuyisa umphefumulo wami; uyangihola ezindleleni zokulunga ngenxa yegama lakhe.
23.4: Noma ngihamba esigodini sethunzi lokufa, angesabi okubi, ngokuba wena unami, intonga yakho nodondolo lwakho ziyangiduduza.
23.5: Ulungisa itafula phambi kwami ebusweni bezitha zami; ugcoba ikhanda lami ngamafutha; indebe yami iyachichima.
23.6: Impela okuhle nomusa kuyakungilandela imihla yonke yokuphila kwami; ngiyakuhlala endlini kaJehova kuze kube phakade.

24.1: Umhlaba ungokaJehova nokugcwala kwawo, izwe nabakhileyo kulo.
24.2: Ngokuba yena wawusekela phezu kwezilwandle, wawumisa phezu kwemifula.
24.3: Ngubani oyakukhuphukela entabeni kaJehova, ngubani oyakuma endaweni yakhe engcwele na?
24.4: Yilowo onezandla ezingenacala nenhliziyo ehlanzekileyo, ongaphenduleli umphefumulo wakhe emangeni nongafungi ngenkohliso.
24.5: Uyakwamukela isibusiso kuJehova nokulunga kuNkulunkulu wensindiso yakhe.
24.6: Yilesi esiyisizukulwane sabamfunayo; bona abasinga ubuso bakho bangabantwana bakaJakobe.
24.7: Phakamisani, masango, izinhloko zenu; nani minyango yaphakade, phakamani ukuba iNkosi yenkazimulo ingene.
24.8: Ingubani le Nkosi yenkazimulo na? InguJehova onamandla, oyiqhawe, uJehova oyiqhawe lokulwa.
24.9: Phakamisani, masango, izinhloko zenu; nani minyango yaphakade, phakamani ukuba iNkosi yenkazimulo ingene.
24.10: Ingubani le Nkosi yenkazimulo na? UJehova Sebawoti nguyena oyiNkosi yenkazimulo.

25.2: Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyethemba kuwe; mawungangijabhisi; izitha zami mazingethabi ngami.
25.3: Yebo, akuyikujabha noyedwa kwabakulindelayo; bayakujabha abaphambuka ngeze.
25.4: Ngazise imendo yakho, Jehova; ngifundise izindlela zakho.
25.5: Ngihambise eqinisweni lakho, ungifundise, ngokuba wena unguNkulunkulu wensindiso yami; ngilindela wena usuku lonke.
25.6: Khumbula, Jehova, ububele bakho nomusa wakho, ngokuba kukhona kwaphakade.
25.7: Ungazikhumbuli izono zobusha bami neziphambeko zami; ngikhumbule ngokomusa wakho ngenxa yobubele bakho, Jehova.
25.8: UJehova muhle, ulungile; ngalokho ufundisa izoni indlela.
25.9: Abathobekileyo ubaholela kokulungileyo, abathobekileyo ubafundisa indlela yakhe.
25.10: Zonke izindlela zikaJehova zingububele neqiniso kulabo abagcina isivumelwano sakhe nezifakazelo zakhe.
25.11: Ngenxa yegama lakho, Jehova, ngithethelele ukona kwami, ngokuba kukhulu.
25.12: Ngumuphi umuntu omesaba uJehova na? Nguyena oyakufundiswa nguye indlela ayakuyikhetha.
25.13: Umphefumulo wakhe uzakuhlala ngokwenama, inzalo yakhe iyakuzuza izwe.
25.14: Ubuhlobo bukaJehova bukubo abamesabayo; uyakubazisa isivumelwano sakhe.
25.15: Amehlo ami akuye uJehova njalo, ngokuba nguyena okhipha izinyawo zami enetheni.
25.16: Phendukela kimi, ube nomusa kimi, ngokuba nginesizungu, ngihluphekile.
25.17: Izinsizi zenhliziyo yami zikhulile; ngikhiphe ezinhluphekweni zami.
25.18: Bheka ukuhlupheka kwami nosizi lwami, ungithethelele zonke izono zami.
25.19: Bheka izitha zami, ngokuba ziningi; ziyangizonda ngenzondo yonya.
25.20: Londoloza umphefumulo wami, ungikhulule; mawungangijabhisi, ngokuba ngiphephela kuwe.
25.21: Ukulunga nobuqotho makungilondoloze, ngokuba ngilindele wena.
25.22: Nkulunkulu, hlenga u-Israyeli kuzo zonke izinkathazo zakhe.

26.1: Ngahlulele, Jehova, ngokuba ngihamba ekulungeni kwami; ngithemba uJehova, angiyikuntenga.
26.2: Ngivivinye, Jehova, ungilinge; hlolisisa izinso zami nenhliziyo yami.
26.3: Ngokuba ububele bakho buphambi kwamehlo ami; ngihamba eqinisweni lakho.
26.5: Ngiyawuzonda umhlangano wabenza okubi, angihlali nababi.
26.6: Ngiyahlamba izandla zami ngingenacala, ngizungeza i-altare lakho, Jehova,
26.7: ukuba ngizwakalise izwi lokudumisa, ngilande ngazo zonke izimangaliso zakho.
26.8: Jehova, ngiyayithanda inkundla yendlu yakho nendawo lapho kuhlezi khona inkazimulo yakho.
26.9: Ungamukisi umphefumulo wami kanye nezoni nokuphila kwami kanye nabantu begazi
26.10: abanehlazo ezandleni zabo, nesokunene sabo sigcwele izipho zenkohliso.
26.11: Kepha mina ngihamba ekulungeni kwami; ngihlenge, ube nomusa kimi.
26.12: Unyawo lwami lumi ebaleni; ngizakudumisa uJehova emihlanganweni.

27.1: UJehova ungukukhanya kwami nensindiso yami; ngizakwesaba bani na? UJehova uyinqaba yokuphila kwami; ngizakuba novalo ngobani na?
27.2: Ekusondeleni kwababi ukuba badle inyama yami abamelene nami nezitha zami bayakhubeka, bawe.
27.3: Noma impi imisa ngakimi, inhliziyo yami ayesabi; noma ngivukelwa ngukulwa, nokho nginethemba.
27.4: Kunye engikucele kuJehova, ngiyakufuna khona: ukuba ngihlale endlini kaJehova izinsuku zonke zokuphila kwami ukubona ubuhle bukaJehova, ngibuke ithempeli lakhe.
27.5: Ngokuba uyangithukusa edokodweni lakhe ngosuku lokuhlupheka, angicashise ekusithekeni kwetende lakhe, angiphakamisele edwaleni.
27.6: Nakalokhu ikhanda lami lizakuphakama ngaphezu kwezitha zami ezingihaqileyo; ngizakunikela iminikelo yokwethaba etendeni lakhe, ngihlabelele, ngidumise uJehova ngogubhu.
27.7: Yizwa, Jehova, ngikhala ngezwi elikhulu; yiba nomusa kimi, ungiphendule.
27.8: Kuwena othi: “Funani ubuso bami,” inhliziyo yami ithi: “Ubuso bakho, Jehova, ngiyabufuna.”
27.9: Ungafihli ubuso bakho kimi, ungaxoshi inceku yakho ngokuthukuthela; wena ulusizo lwami, ungangilahli, ungangishiyi, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yami.
27.10: Ngokuba ubaba nomame bangishiyile, kodwa uJehova uzakungamukela.
27.11: Ngifundise indlela yakho, Jehova, ungihole endleleni ekhanyayo ngenxa yezitha zami.
27.12: Unganginikeli entandweni yezitha zami; ngokuba ofakazi bamanga bangivukele kanye nabafutha ukudlozomela.
27.13: Yeka, uma bengingathembanga ukubona okuhle kukaJehova ezweni labaphilayo!
27.14: Lindela uJehova, uqine, inhliziyo yakho ime isibindi; yebo, lindela uJehova.

28.1: Ngikhala kuwe Jehova; Dwala lami, ungabi yisithulu kimi, funa kuthi, uma uthula kimi, ngifane nabashona emgodini.
28.2: Yizwa izwi lokunxusa kwami, nxa ngikhala kuwe, ngiphakamisela izandla zami endaweni yakho engcwelengcwele.
28.3: Ungangimukisi kanye nababi nabenza okubi abakhuluma ukuthula nabakhelwane babo, kanti kukhona okubi ezinhliziyweni zabo.
28.4: Banike njengokwenza kwabo nanjengobubi bemisebenzi yabo; banike njengokwenza kwezandla zabo, baphindisele abakwenzileyo.
28.5: Ngokuba abayinaki imisebenzi kaJehova nokwenza kwezandla zakhe; uyakubadiliza, angabakhi.
28.6: Makabongwe uJehova, ngokuba ulizwile izwi lokunxusa kwami.
28.7: UJehova ungamandla ami nesihlangu sami; inhliziyo yami ithembe kuye, ngasizwa; ngakho-ke inhliziyo yami iyethaba; ngizakumdumisa ngesihlabelelo sami.
28.8: UJehova ungamandla abantu bakhe; uyinqaba yensindiso yogcotshiweyo wakhe.
28.9: Sindisa abantu bakho, ubusise ifa lakho, ubaluse, ubathwale kuze kube phakade.

29.1: Mnikeni uJehova, nina madodana kaNkulunkulu, mnikeni uJehova udumo namandla.
29.2: Mnikeni uJehova udumo lwegama lakhe, nikhuleke kuJehova emvunulweni engcwele.
29.3: Izwi likaJehova liphezu kwamanzi, uNkulunkulu wenkazimulo uyaduma; uJehova uphezu kwamanzi amakhulu.
29.4: Izwi likaJehova linamandla; izwi likaJehova linenkazimulo.
29.5: Izwi likaJehova liyaphula imisedari;* uJehova waphula imisedari yaseLebanoni.
29.6: ILebanoni ulitshekulisisa okwenkonyane, neSiriyoni njengethole lenyathi.
29.8: Izwi likaJehova lizamazamisa ihlane; uJehova uzamazamisa ihlane laseKadeshi.
29.9: Izwi likaJehova liphunzisa izimbabala; lihluba amahlathi; nasethempelini lakhe konke kuthi: “Udumo!”
29.10: UJehova wayehlezi ebusa phezu kukazamcolo; uJehova uhlezi eyinkosi kuze kube phakade.
29.11: UJehova uzakunika abantu bakhe amandla; uJehova uzakubusisa abantu bakhe ngokuthula.

30.1: Ngiyakuphakamisa, Jehova, ngokuba ungikhuphulile; awuvumanga ukuba izitha zami zijabule phezu kwami.
30.2: Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, ngakhala kuwe, wangiphilisa.
30.3: Jehova, umphefumulo wami uwukhuphulile endaweni yabafileyo, wangiphilisa phakathi kwabashona emgodini.
30.4: Dumisani uJehova nina enimkhonzayo, nibonge igama lakhe elingcwele.
30.5: Ngokuba ukuthukuthela kwakhe kuba ngokomzuzwana nje, umusa wakhe uba ngowokuphila konke; kusihlwa kungena ukukhala, ekuseni ukujabula.
30.6: Mina ngithe ekubuseni kwami: Angisoze nganyakaziswa naphakade.
30.7: Jehova, ngomusa wakho ubuwenzile ukuba iqine intaba yami; wabufihla ubuso bakho, ngase ngithuthumela.
30.8: Ngakhala kuwe Jehova; nganxusa kuJehova, ngathi:
30.9: “Kukhona nzuzoni egazini lami nasekushoneni kwami egebeni na? Uthuli luzakukudumisa yini, lushumayele iqiniso lakho, na?
30.10: Yizwa, Jehova, ube nomusa kimi; Jehova, yiba ngumsizi wami.”
30.11: Waphendula ukukhala kwami kwaba ngukusina; wangikhumula izingubo zami zokulila, wangembathisa ukujabula,
30.12: ukuze umphefumulo wami ukudumise, ungathuli; Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, ngizakukubonga kuze kube phakade.

31.1: Ithemba lami ngilibeka kuwe Jehova; mawungangijabhisi naphakade; ngikhulule ngokulunga kwakho.
31.2: Beka kimi indlebe yakho, ungophule masinyane, ube yidwala eliqinileyo kimi, indlu yezinqaba yokungisindisa.
31.3: Ngokuba wena uyidwala lami nenqaba yami; ngenxa yegama lakho uyakungihola, ungiqondise.
31.4: Uyakungikhipha enetheni abangicuphe ngalo, ngokuba wena uyinqaba yami.
31.5: Ngibeka umoya wami esandleni sakho; uyangihlenga, Jehova Nkulunkulu othembekayo.
31.6: Ngiyabazonda abakhonza onkulunkulu abayize, kepha mina ngithemba uJehova.
31.7: Ngizakwethaba, ngijabule ngomusa wakho, ngokuba ukubonile ukuhlupheka kwami, wazinaka izinsizi zomphefumulo wami;
31.8: awunginikelanga esandleni sesitha, wazimisa izinyawo zami endaweni ebanzi.
31.9: Yiba nomusa kimi, Jehova, ngokuba ngiyahlupheka; iso lami liyafa usizi, nomphefumulo wami nomzimba wami.
31.10: Ngokuba ukuphila kwami kuphelela osizini, neminyaka yami ekububuleni; amandla ami aphelile ngokona kwami, namathambo ami ancunzekile.
31.11: Ngenxa yezitha zami zonke sengaba yisihlamba, ikakhulu kubakhelwane bami ngaba ngobesabisayo abangane bami; abangibona endleleni bayangibalekela.
31.13: Ngokuba ngikuzwile ukuhleba kwabaningi ngokwesabisayo nxazonke; besenza icebo ngami bahlosa ukubulala umphefumulo wami.
31.14: Kepha mina ngithemba wena Jehova; ngithi: “UnguNkulunkulu wami.”
31.15: Izikhathi zami zisesandleni sakho; ngikhulule esandleni sezitha zami nakwabangizingelayo.
31.16: Khanyisa ubuso bakho phezu kwenceku yakho; ngisindise ngomusa wakho.
31.17: Jehova, mawungangijabhisi, ngokuba ngiyakubiza; mabajabhiswe ababi, bathuliswe endaweni yabafileyo.
31.18: Mazithuliswe izindebe zamanga ezijivaza olungileyo ngokuzidla nangokweyisa.
31.19: Yeka ubukhulu bomusa wakho obagodlele wona abakwesabayo, owenzele bona ababalekela kuwe, phambi kwabantwana babantu.
31.20: Ubafihla ekusithekeni kobuso bakho ngenxa yezigungu zabantu; ubalondoloza edokodweni ekuxabaneni kwezilimi.
31.21: Makabongwe uJehova, ngokuba ungenzele umusa wakhe omangalisayo emzini oqinileyo.
31.22: Mina-ke ngithe ovalweni lwami: Ngixoshiwe emehlweni akho; nokho walizwa izwi lokunxusa kwami ekukhaleni kwami kuwe.
31.23: Mthandeni uJehova nina nonke enimkhonzayo; uJehova uyabalondoloza abakholekileyo, amphindisele kakhulu ozidlayo.
31.24: Qinani, inhliziyo yenu ibe nesibindi, nina nonke enithemba uJehova.

32.1: Ubusisiwe osiphambeko sakhe sithethelelwe, osono sakhe sisibekelwe.
32.2: Ubusisiwe umuntu uJehova angambaleli isiphambeko, kungekho nkohliso emoyeni wakhe.
32.3: Kwathi ngithule, amathambo ami aguga ngokububula kwami usuku lonke.
32.4: Ngokuba imini nobusuku isandla sakho sasinzima phezu kwami, uloya lwami loma njengokomisa kwehlobo.
32.5: Ngasivuma isono sami kuwe, angisifihlanga isiphambeko sami; ngathi: “Ngizakuzivuma izono zami kuJehova,” wena wathethelela icala lesono sami.
32.6: Ngakho-ke yilowo nalowo olungileyo makakhuleke kuwe ngesikhathi sokukufumana; impela kuyakuthi lapho amanzi amakhulu ekhukhula, angafinyeleli kuye.
32.7: Wena uyindawo yami yokucasha; uyangilondoloza ngingahlupheki; ungiphahla ngenjabulo yokukhululwa.
32.8: Ngizakukufundisa, ngikubonise indlela ozakuhamba ngayo; ngizakukululeka ngeso lami.
32.9: Ningabi njengehhashi nembongolo engenangqondo; umkhala netomu yimvunulo yayo yokuyiqondisa, uma ingasondeli kuwe.
32.10: Omubi unezinhlupheko eziningi, kepha othemba uJehova umusa uyakumphahla.
32.11: Jabulani kuJehova, nethabe nina balungileyo, nethabe nina nonke baqotho ngenhliziyo.

33.1: Yethabani kuJehova nina balungileyo; ukudumisa kubafanele abaqotho.
33.2: Bongani uJehova ngehabhu;* mdumiseni ngogubhu oluzintambo ziyishumi.
33.3: Mhubeleni ihubo elisha, nibethe kahle ngenhlokomo.
33.4: Ngokuba izwi likaJehova lilungile; zonke izenzo zakhe ziyakholeka.
33.5: Uthanda ukulunga nokwahlulela; umhlaba ugcwele umusa kaJehova.
33.6: Ngezwi likaJehova izulu lenziwa, namabandla onke ngomoya womlomo wakhe.
33.7: Ubuthela ndawonye amanzi olwandle njengenqwaba; uwabeka ajulileyo ezinqolobaneni.
33.8: Umhlaba wonke mawumesabe uJehova; bonke abakhileyo ezweni mabathuthumele phambi kwakhe.
33.9: Ngokuba wakhuluma, kwaba khona; wayaleza, kwema khona.
33.10: UJehova uchitha icebo labezizwe; uphuthisa imicabango yabantu.
33.11: Icebo likaJehova limi phakade, nemicabango yenhliziyo yakhe ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
33.12: Sibusisiwe isizwe esiNkulunkulu waso nguJehova, isizwe asikhethileyo sibe yifa lakhe.
33.13: UJehova uyabheka esezulwini; uyababona bonke abantwana babantu.
33.14: Esendaweni lapho ehlala khona uyababuka bonke abakhileyo ezweni,
33.15: yena owadala izinhliziyo zabo bonke, oqaphela zonke izenzo zabo.
33.16: Ayikho inkosi esindiswa ngobuningi bempi yayo; isiqhwaga asikhululwa ngobukhulu bamandla aso.
33.17: Ihhashi liyize ekusindiseni, alihlangulisi ngobukhulu bamandla alo.
33.18: Bheka, iso likaJehova liphezu kwabamesabayo, abathemba umusa wakhe,
33.19: ukuba akhulule umphefumulo wabo ekufeni, abaphilise endlaleni.
33.20: Umphefumulo wethu ulindela uJehova; ungukusiza kwethu nesihlangu sethu.
33.21: Ngalokho inhliziyo yethu ithokoza ngaye, ngokuba sithemba igama lakhe elingcwele.
33.22: Umusa wakho, Jehova, mawube phezu kwethu, njengalokhu sithemba wena.

34.1: Ngiyakumbonga uJehova ngezikhathi zonke; ukudunyiswa kwakhe kuyakuba semlonyeni wami njalonjalo.
34.2: Umphefumulo wami uyakuzibonga ngoJehova; abathobekileyo bayakukuzwa, bajabule.
34.3: Mtuseni uJehova kanye nami, siphakamise igama lakhe kanyekanye.
34.4: Ngamfuna uJehova, wangiphendula; wangikhulula kulo lonke uvalo lwami.
34.5: Babheka kuye phezulu, bakhanya; ubuso babo abusoze bajabha.
34.6: Nasi isihlupheki esakhala, uJehova wezwa, wasikhulula kuzo zonke izinhlupheko zaso.
34.7: Ingelosi kaJehova iyamisa nxazonke kubo abamesabayo, ibakhulule.
34.8: Yizwani nibone ukuthi uJehova muhle; ubusisiwe lowo muntu ophephela kuye.
34.9: Mesabeni uJehova nina bangcwele bakhe, ngokuba abasweli lutho abamesabayo.
34.10: Amabhongo ezingonyama ayaswela, alambe, kepha abafuna uJehova abayikuswela lutho oluhle.
34.11: Zanini, bantwana, ningilalele; ngizakunifundisa ukumesaba uJehova.
34.12: Ngumuphi umuntu othanda ukuphila, ofisa izinsuku zokuba abone okuhle na?
34.13: Londa ulimi lwakho kokubi, nezindebe zakho kukho ukukhuluma inkohliso.
34.14: Deda kukho okubi, wenze okuhle; funa ukuthula, ukujonge.
34.15: Amehlo kaJehova akubo abalungileyo; izindlebe zakhe zikukho ukukhala kwabo.
34.16: Ubuso bukaJehova bumelene nabenza okubi ukuba achithe ukukhunjulwa kwabo emhlabeni.
34.17: Labo bayakhala, uJehova uyezwa; uyabakhulula kuzo zonke izinhlupheko zabo.
34.18: UJehova useduze nabo abanenhliziyo eyaphukileyo; uyabasindisa abanomoya odabukileyo.
34.19: Ziningi izinhlupheko zolungileyo, kepha uJehova uyamkhulula kuzo zonke.
34.20: Uyawagcina onke amathambo akhe; alaphulwa nelilodwa kuwo.
34.21: Okubi kuyakumbulala omubi; abazonda olungileyo bayakulahlwa ngecala.
34.22: UJehova ukhulula umphefumulo wezinceku zakhe; akakho kwabamethembayo oyakuba necala.

35.1: Phikisana, Jehova, nabaphikisana nami, ulwe nabo abalwa nami.
35.3: Hosha umkhonto, uvimbe indlela kwabangizingelayo; yisho kuwo umphefumulo wami, uthi: “Mina ngiyinsindiso yakho.”
35.4: Mabajabhe, bahlazeke abafuna umphefumulo wami; mababuyiselwe emuva, bajabhiswe abangisongelayo.
35.5: Mababe njengamakhoba emoyeni, ingelosi kaJehova ibadudule.
35.6: Indlela yabo mayibe mnyama, ibebushelezi, ingelosi kaJehova ibaxoshe.
35.7: Ngokuba bangenzele ngasesitha igebe lenetha labo, kungekho sici, bembele umphefumulo wami umgodi, kungekho cala.
35.8: Ukubhujiswa makumehlele engazelele; inetha lakhe alibeke ngasesitha malimbambe yena; makawele kulo kube ngukubhujiswa kwakhe.
35.9: Khona umphefumulo wami uzakwethaba kuJehova, uthokoze ngokusindisa kwakhe.
35.10: Onke amathambo ami azakuthi: “Jehova, ngubani onjengawe, wena okhulula ohluphekayo, yebo, ohluphekayo nompofu komphangayo, na?”
35.11: Ofakazi abangalungile bayasukuma, babuza kimi engingakwaziyo.
35.12: Bangiphindisela okubi ngokuhle; umphefumulo wami bawusozisele.
35.13: Kanti ekuguleni kwabo mina ngangembethe ezokuzila; umphefumulo wami ngawuhlupha ngokuzila ukudla; umkhuleko wami wabuyela esifubeni sami.
35.14: Ngahamba kungathi bekungumngane wami nomfowethu; njengokhalela unina ngakhothama ngokulila.
35.15: Kepha ekuweni kwami bahlekisa ngami, babuthana ndawonye; abashayi engingabaziyo bangibunganyela; badumaza bengayeki.
35.16: Njengezinteli ezikhonzela ucezu lwesinkwa bangigedlela amazinyo.
35.17: Nkosi, lokho uzakukubukela kuze kube nini na? Sindisa umphefumulo wami ekubhubhiseni kwabo, ukuphila kwami ezingonyameni ezingamabhongo.
35.18: Ngizakukubonga ebandleni elikhulu, ngikudumise phakathi kwabantu abaningi.
35.19: Mabangajabuli ngami abayizitha zami bengenasizathu; mabangaqwayizi amehlo abangizonda ngeze.
35.20: Ngokuba abakhulumi ukuthula, kepha baqamba amazwi enkohliso ngabazithuleleyo emhlabeni.
35.21: Yebo, bangikhamisela kakhulu umlomo wabo, bathi: “Ashila, ashila, iso lethu liyabona!”
35.22: Uyakubona, Jehova; mawungathuli; Nkosi, mawungabi kude nami.
35.23: Vuka, usukumele ukwahlulelwa kwami, Nkulunkulu wami, Nkosi yami, umele icala lami.
35.24: Ngahlulele ngokulunga kwakho, Jehova Nkulunkulu wami; mabangajabuli ngami.
35.25: Mabangasho enhliziyweni yabo ukuthi: “He, kwaya ngesifiso sethu!” Mabangasho ukuthi: “Simgwinyile.”
35.26: Mabajabhe, babe namahloni bonke abajabula ngokuhlupheka kwami; abazikhukhumeza ngami mabembathiswe ukujabha nendumazo.
35.27: Mabethabe, bajabule abathokoza ngokulunga kwami; mabathi njalonjalo: “Makadunyiswe uJehova othokoza ngenhlanhla yenceku yakhe.”
35.28: Ulimi lwami luzakushumayela ngokulunga kwakho, usuku lonke ngodumo lwakho.

36.1: Inkulumo yesiphambeko komubi, isekujuleni kwenhliziyo yami, ithi: Akukho ukumesaba uNkulunkulu phambi kwamehlo akhe.
36.2: Ngokuba ukonakala kwakhe kuyamthopha emehlweni akhe, ukuze kungafunyanwa, azondeke ngakho.
36.3: Amazwi omlomo wakhe angukona nenkohliso; ukuyekile ukuhlakanipha nokwenza okulungileyo.
36.4: Uceba okubi ecansini lakhe, uzimisa endleleni engalungile; okubi kakwenyanyi.
36.5: Jehova, ububele bakho bufinyelela ezulwini, nokuthembeka kwakho kuze kube semafwini.
36.6: Ukulunga kwakho kunjengezintaba ezinkulukazi, ukwahlulela kwakho kulutwa olukhulu; usindisa abantu nezilwane, Jehova.
36.7: Ububele bakho, Nkulunkulu, buyigugu elingaka; abantwana babantu bakhosela ethunzini lamaphiko akho.
36.8: Bayakusutha ngamanoni endlu yakho, ubaphuzise okomfula wokuthokoza kwakho.
36.9: Ngokuba ukuwe umthombo wokuphila; ekukhanyeni kwakho siyakubona ukukhanya.
36.10: Mawume umusa wakho kubo abakwaziyo, nokulunga kwakho kubo abaqotho ngenhliziyo.
36.11: Unyawo loziqhenyayo malungangifikeli; nesandla somubi masingangixoshi.
36.12: Bheka, bawile abenza okubi; bawiswe phansi, abasenakuvuka.

37.1: Ungazikhathazi ngababi, ungabi namhawu ngabenza okungalungile.
37.2: Ngokuba bayakusikwa masinyane njengotshani, babune njengemithana eluhlaza.
37.3: Themba kuJehova, wenze okulungileyo; hlala ezweni, uzondle ngokukholeka;
37.4: zithokozise ngoJehova, yikhona ezakukunika okufiswa yinhliziyo yakho.
37.5: Nikela indlela yakho esandleni sikaJehova, umethembe; yena uzakukwenza.
37.6: Uzakuhlalukisa ukulunga kwakho njengokukhanya, nokufanele wena njengemini.
37.7: Thula phambi kukaJehova, ulindele yena; ungakhathazeki ngonenhlanhla endleleni yakhe, ngomuntu osongoza amacebo amabi.
37.8: Pheza ukuthukuthela; yeka ulaka, ungakhathazeki; kubanga ukona nje.
37.9: Ngokuba ababi bazakuchithwa, kepha abalindela uJehova bazakudla ifa lomhlaba.
37.10: Kuse ngumzuzwana, omubi angabe esabakho; kuyakuthi lapho uhlola indawo yakhe, uyakube engasekho.
37.11: Kepha abathobekileyo bazakulidla ifa lomhlaba, bathokoze ngokuthula okukhulu.
37.12: Omubi uyamsongela olungileyo ngokubi, amgedlele amazinyo.
37.13: INkosi iyakumhleka, ngokuba iyabona ukuthi usuku lwakhe luyeza.
37.14: Ababi bahosha inkemba, bansale umnsalo wabo ukuba bamwise phansi ohluphekileyo nompofu, babulale abandlela ilungile.
37.15: Inkemba yabo izakungena kweyabo inhliziyo, iminsalo yabo yaphulwe.
37.16: Okuncane anakho olungileyo kungcono kunemfuyo yababi abaningi.
37.17: Ngokuba izingalo zababi ziyakwaphulwa, kepha uJehova uyabaphasa abalungileyo.
37.18: UJehova uyazazi izinsuku zabaqotho; ifa labo liyakuma kuze kube phakade.
37.19: Abayikujabha esikhathini esibi; bayakusutha ezinsukwini zendlala.
37.20: Ngokuba ababi bayakubhubha; izitha zikaJehova zinjengobuhle bamadlelo: ziyakunyamalala, zinyamalale njengentuthu.
37.21: Omubi uyatsheleka, angabuyiseli; kepha olungileyo unesihawu, aphane.
37.22: Ngokuba ababusisiweyo bakhe bazakulidla ifa lomhlaba, kepha abaqalekiswa nguye bazakuchithwa.
37.23: Izinyathelo zomuntu ziqiniswa nguJehova; uyayithanda indlela yakhe.
37.24: Noma ekhubeka, akayikuwa phansi, ngokuba uJehova uphasa isandla sakhe.
37.25: Kade ngimusha, manje sengimdala; angizange ngibone olungileyo eshiyiwe nenzalo yakhe iphanza ukudla.
37.26: Usuku lonke uyahawukela, atsheleke, nenzalo yakhe iyisibusiso.
37.27: Deda kokubi, wenze okuhle, uyakuhlala kuze kube phakade.
37.28: Ngokuba uJehova uthanda ukulunga, akabashiyi abangcwele bakhe; bayalondolozwa kuze kube phakade, kepha inzalo yababi iyachithwa.
37.29: Abalungileyo bazakudla ifa lomhlaba, bahlale kuwo njalonjalo.
37.30: Umlomo wolungileyo ushumayela ukuhlakanipha; ulimi lwakhe lukhuluma ukulunga.
37.31: Umthetho kaNkulunkulu wakhe usenhliziyweni yakhe; izinyathelo zakhe azisheleli.
37.33: UJehova akayikumnikela esandleni sakhe; akayikumlahla lapho ahlulelwa khona.
37.34: Lindela uJehova, ulonde indlela yakhe; uzakukuphakamisa, udle ifa lomhlaba, ubukele lapho ababi bechithwa khona.
37.35: Ngambona omubi oyisidlova ezenabisile njengomuthi oluhlaza ogxilileyo;
37.36: kwathi lapho umuntu edlula, bheka, wayengasekho; ngamfuna, kepha akabe esafunyanwa.
37.37: Mbhekisise ongasolekiyo, umbone oqotho; ngokuba umuntu wokuthula, ukugcina kwakhe kuhle.
37.38: Kepha abaphambukayo bayakubhujiswa bonke; isikhathi sababi siyakunqunywa.
37.39: Ukusindiswa kwabalungileyo kuvela kuJehova; uyinqaba yabo esikhathini sokuhlupheka.
37.40: UJehova uyabasiza, abakhulule; ubakhulula kwababi, abasindise, ngokuba bayamethemba.

38.1: Jehova, ungangijezisi ngentukuthelo yakho, ungangishayi ngolaka lwakho.
38.2: Ngokuba imicibisholo yakho ingihlabile; isandla sakho singicindezele kanzima.
38.3: Akukho ukuphila enyameni yami ngenxa yentukuthelo yakho; akukho ukuthula emathanjeni ami ngenxa yesono sami.
38.4: Ngokuba iziphambeko zami zeqile phezu kwekhanda lami; njengomthwalo osindayo ziyangisinda.
38.5: Izilonda zami ziyanuka, zichicha ubovu ngenxa yobuwula bami.
38.6: Ngikhonkobele, ngithotshisiwe kakhulu; usuku lonke ngihamba ngilila.
38.7: Ngokuba ukhalo lwami lutshutshumba kakhulu; akukho ukuphila enyameni yami.
38.8: Ngibuthakathaka, ngidubekile kabi; ngiyakhala ngenxa yokugqiha kwenhliziyo yami.
38.9: Nkosi, ukufisa kwami konke kuphambi kwakho; ukububula kwami akufihlekile kuwe.
38.10: Inhliziyo yami iyagquma kakhulu; amandla ami angishiyile, ngisho nokukhanya kwamehlo ami akusekho kimi.
38.11: Abathandekayo bami nabahlobo bami bemi kude nokuhlupheka kwami; abakwethu bemi kude laphaya.
38.12: Abafuna umphefumulo wami bayangicupha; abafuna ukungilimaza bakhuluma okubi, bazindla inkohliso usuku lonke.
38.13: Mina kodwa nginjengesithulu, angizwa; nginjengesimungulu esingavuli umlomo waso.
38.14: Yebo, nginjengomuntu ongezwayo; akukho ukuphikisa emlonyeni wakhe.
38.15: Ngokuba ngithemba wena Jehova; wena Nkosi Nkulunkulu wami uzakuphendula.
38.16: Ngokuba ngithe: “Funa bajabule ngami, ekusheleleni konyawo lwami bazikhukhumeze ngami.”
38.17: Ngokuba ngiseduze kokuwa, nobuhlungu bami buphambi kwami ngezikhathi zonke.
38.18: Ngokuba ngiyabika ukona kwami; ngiyadabuka ngesono sami.
38.19: Kepha izitha zami ziphilile, zinamandla; baningi abangizonda ngeze.
38.20: Abaphindisela okubi ngokuhle bamelene nami, ngokuba ngilandela okulungileyo.
38.21: Ungangishiyi, Jehova; Nkulunkulu wami, ungabi kude nami.

39.1: Ngithe: “Ngizakulinda izindlela zami ukuba ngingoni ngolimi lwami; ngizakugcina umlomo wami ngesifonyo, omubi esekhona phambi kwamehlo ami.”
39.2: Ngabindela impela, ngathula nakukho okuhle; kwavuswa ubuhlungu bami.
39.3: Inhliziyo yami yavutha phakathi kwami; kwaphembeka umlilo ngisazindla; ngakhuluma ngolimi lwami.
39.4: “Jehova, ngazise ukuphela kwami, nesilinganiso sezinsuku zami ukuba siyini; mangazi ukuthi ngingodlulayo.
39.5: Bheka, izinsuku zami wazenza zaba ngangobubanzi besandla; imihla yokuphila kwami ayilutho kuwe; impela yilowo nalowo muntu ungumoya nje, noma eqine kangakanani.
39.6: “Impela umuntu uhamba njengesithunzi nje; impela uzikhathaza ngokuyize nje; unqwabela imfuyo, kepha akazi ukuthi ngubani ozakuyibutha.
39.7: “Kalokhu-ke, Nkosi, ngilindele ntoni na? Ithemba lami likuwe.
39.8: Ngisindise kuzo iziphambeko zami, ungangenzi isithuko sesiwula.
39.9: Ngiyathula, angivuli umlomo wami; ngokuba nguwe okwenzileyo.
39.10: Susa kimi ukushaya kwakho, ngokuba ngiyaqedwa ngukushaywa yisandla sakho.
39.11: Nxa ulaya umuntu ngesijeziso ngenxa yeziphambeko, ubuhle bakhe ubenza buphele njengenundu; yilowo nalowo muntu ungumoya nje.
39.12: “Yizwa umkhuleko wami, Jehova, ulalele ukumemeza kwami; ungathuli ngezinyembezi zami, ngokuba ngingumfokazi kuwe; ngiyisihambi njengokhokho bami bonke.
39.13: Yeka ukungibuka, ngize ngincibilike, ngingakamuki lapha, ngingabe ngisabakho.”

40.1: Bengilindela uJehova; wayesezikhothamisela kimi, wezwa ukukhala kwami.
40.2: Wangikhipha emgodini wokubhujiswa odakeni lobishi, wamisa izinyawo zami edwaleni, waqinisa izinyathelo zami.
40.3: Wabeka igama elisha emlonyeni wami, igama lokubonga uNkulunkulu wethu; abaningi bayakukubona, besabe, bamethembe uJehova.
40.4: Ubusisiwe umuntu obeka ithemba lakhe kuJehova, ongaphendukeli kwabazidlayo nakwabaphambukela emangeni.
40.5: Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, ziningi izimangaliso zakho ozenzileyo, nezizindlo zakho ngathi; akukho okungafaniswa nawe; uma ngiyilanda, ngiyisho, miningi kunokuba ibalwe.
40.6: Umhlatshelo nomnikelo wokudla awuwuthandi; izindlebe zami uzibhobozile; umnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wesono awuwubizi.
40.7: Ngase ngithi: “Bheka, ngiyeza; encwadini esongwayo kulotshiwe ngami ukuthi:
40.8: Ngiyathanda ukwenza intando yakho, Nkulunkulu wami, nomthetho wakho usenhliziyweni yami.”
40.9: Ngishumayelile ukulunga ebandleni elikhulu; bheka, angizivalanga izindebe zami; Jehova, wena uyakwazi.
40.10: Ukulunga kwakho angikuthukusanga enhliziyweni yami; ngashumayela ukukholeka kwakho nensindiso yakho; umusa wakho neqiniso lakho angikufihlelanga ibandla elikhulu.
40.11: Wena Jehova ungangigodleli ububele bakho; umusa wakho neqiniso lakho makungilonde njalo.
40.12: Ngokuba izinhlupheko ezingenakubalwa zingihaqile, iziphambeko zami zingificile, angaze ngaba nakubona; ziningi kunezinwele zekhanda lami; inhliziyo yami ingishiyile.
40.13: Makuthandeke kuwe Jehova ukuba ungikhulule; Jehova, mawuphuthume ungisize.
40.14: Mabajabhe, babe namahloni bonke abafuna umphefumulo wami ukuba bawuhlwithe; abafisa ukulimala kwami mababuyiselwe emuva, bajabhiswe.
40.15: Mabashaqeke ngenxa yehlazo labo abathi kimi: “Ashila, ashila!”
40.16: Mabethabe, bajabule kuwe bonke abakufunayo; abathanda insindiso yakho mabasho njalo, bathi: “Makadunyiswe uJehova.”
40.17: Noma ngihlupheka, ngimpofu, iNkosi iyanginaka; wena ungumsizi wami noMsindisi wami; Nkulunkulu wami, mawungalibali.

41.1: Ubusisiwe onakekela ohluphekayo; uJehova uyakumsindisa osukwini olubi.
41.2: UJehova uyakumlondoloza, amphilise; uyakubusiswa emhlabeni; awuyikumnikela entandweni yezitha zakhe.
41.3: UJehova uyakumphasa ecansini egula; wena uyakuguqula ukhukho lwakhe ekuguleni kwakhe.
41.4: Mina ngithi: “Jehova, ngihawukele, uphulukise umphefumulo wami, ngokuba ngonile kuwe.”
41.5: Izitha zami zikhuluma okubi ngami, zithi: “Uzakufa nini, igama lakhe lichitheke, na?”
41.6: Nalapho kuza ozongibona, ukhuluma amanga; inhliziyo yakhe izibuthela ukonakala, abesephuma akhulume ngakho.
41.7: Bonke abangizondayo banyenyezelana ngami: bangisongozela okubi, bathi:
41.8: “Into embi inamathele kuye; olele phansi kasayikululama.”
41.9: Yebo, nomhlobo wami ebengimethemba, obedla isinkwa sami, ungiphakamisele isithende sakhe.
41.10: Kepha wena Jehova, ngihawukele, ungilulamise, ukuze ngibaphindisele.
41.11: Ngalokho ngiyazi ukuthi uyangithanda, ngokuba isitha sami asihalalisi phezu kwami.
41.12: Mina uyangimisa ebuqothweni bami; uyangibeka phambi kobuso bakho kuze kube phakade.
41.13: Makabongwe uJehova uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, kusukela phakade kuze kube phakade. Amen, Amen.

42.1: Njengendluzele ilangazelela amanzi emifula, kanjalo umphefumulo wami ulangazelela wena Nkulunkulu.
42.2: Umphefumulo wami womela uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ophilayo; ngiyakufika nini, ngibonakale phambi kukaNkulunkulu, na?
42.3: Izinyembezi zami zingukudla kwami imini nobusuku, ngokuba usuku lonke bathi kimi: “Uphi uNkulunkulu wakho na?”
42.4: Ngiyakukhumbula lokhu, ngithulule umphefumulo wami phakathi kwami, njengalokho ngangihamba esixukwini ngiya naso endlini kaNkulunkulu ngenhlokomo yokwethaba nokubonga, ibandla ligubha umkhosi.
42.5: Yini ukuba udangale, mphefumulo wami, uyaluze phakathi kwami, na? Methembe uNkulunkulu, ngokuba ngisezakumdumisa ngokusindisa kobuso bakhe.
42.6: Nkulunkulu wami, umphefumulo wami udangele phakathi kwami; ngakho-ke ngikhumbula wena ezweni laseJordani, nakwelamaHermoni, nasentabeni yaseMisari.
42.7: Utwa lubizana notwa ekuhlokomeni kwezimpophoma zakho; onke amadlambi akho namaza akho eqile phezu kwami.
42.8: Emini uJehova uyaleza umusa wakhe; ebusuku isihlabelelo sakhe sikimi, ngikhuleke kuNkulunkulu wokuphila kwami.
42.9: Ngizakuthi kuNkulunkulu, iDwala lami: “Ungikhohlweleni na? Ngihambelani ngilila, ngicindezelwe yisitha, na?”
42.10: Kunjengokuphohlozwa kwamathambo ami, nxa izitha zami zingiklolodela, zithi kimi usuku lonke: “Uphi uNkulunkulu wakho na?”
42.11: Yini ukuba udangale, mphefumulo wami, uyaluze phakathi kwami, na? Methembe uNkulunkulu, ngokuba ngisezakumdumisa yena oyinsindiso yobuso bami noNkulunkulu wami.

43.1: Ngahlulele, Nkulunkulu ungimele endabeni yami esizweni esingenamusa, ngikhulule kumuntu wenkohliso nongenakulunga.
43.2: Ngokuba wena Nkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sami; ungilahleleni na? Ngihambelani ngilila, ngicindezelwe yisitha, na?
43.3: Thuma ukukhanya kwakho neqiniso lakho, kungihole, kungiyise entabeni yakho engcwele nasezindlini zakho,
43.4: ngize ngifike kulo i-altare likaNkulunkulu, kuNkulunkulu wenjabulo yokwethaba kwami, ngikudumise ngehabhu,* Nkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wami.
43.5: Yini ukuba udangale, mphefumulo wami, uyaluze phakathi kwami, na? ngisezakumdumisa yena oyinsindiso yobuso bami noNkulunkulu wami.

44.1: Nkulunkulu, sizwile ngezindlebe zethu, okhokho besilandisa ngesenzo owasenzayo emihleni yabo, emihleni yasendulo.
44.2: Nguwe owabaxosha abezizwe ngesandla sakho, kepha bona wabatshala; wazichitha izizwe, kepha bona wabandisa.
44.3: Ngokuba abalidlanga izwe ngenkemba yabo, nengalo yabo ayibasindisanga; kepha kwaba yisandla sakho sokunene, nengalo yakho, nokukhanya kobuso bakho, ngokuba wawubathanda.
44.4: Wena Nkulunkulu uyinkosi yami; yaleza ukusindiswa kukaJakobe.
44.5: Ngawe sizakulahla phansi izitha zethu; ngegama lakho sizakunyathela abasivukelayo.
44.6: Ngokuba angiwethembi umnsalo wami, nenkemba yami ayingisindisi;
44.7: kepha nguwe owasisindisa ezitheni zethu, wajabhisa abasizondayo.
44.8: Sizincoma ngoNkulunkulu usuku lonke; igama lakho siyalibonga kuze kube phakade.
44.9: Nokho ususilahlile, wasijabhisa; awusaphumi nezimpi zethu.
44.11: Usinikezele ukudliwa njengezimvu, wasihlakaza phakathi kwabezizwe.
44.12: Uthengisa ngesizwe sakho ngokuyize; awuzuzi lutho ngokubiza ngaso.
44.13: Usenza isihlamba kubakhelwane bethu, inhlekiso nendumazo kwabasiphahlileyo.
44.14: Usenza isaga kwabezizwe, banikine ikhanda phakathi kwabantu.
44.15: Usuku lonke ukudunyazwa kwami kuphambi kwami, namahloni amboza ubuso bami
44.16: ngenxa yoklolodayo nojivazayo, ngenxa yesitha nomphindiseli.
44.17: Konke lokho kusehlele, kodwa asikukhohlwanga wena; asisaphulanga isivumelwano sakho.
44.18: Inhliziyo yethu ayibuyelanga emuva; izinyathelo zethu aziphambukanga endleleni yakho,
44.19: uze usiphahlaze endaweni yezimpungushe, usimboze ngethunzi lokufa.
44.20: Uma ngabe sikhohliwe igama likaNkulunkulu wethu, sazelulela izandla zethu kunkulunkulu mumbe,
44.21: uNkulunkulu ubengayikukuhlola na? Ngokuba yena uyazazi izimfihlakalo zenhliziyo.
44.22: Yebo, ngenxa yakho sibulawa usuku lonke, siphathiswa okwezimvu zokuhlatshwa.
44.23: Vuka, Nkosi! Ulaleleni na? Vuka, ungasilahli njalonjalo.
44.24: Ubufihlelani ubuso bakho, ukhohlwe ukuhlupheka nokucindezelwa kwethu, na?
44.25: Ngokuba umphefumulo wethu ukhothamele othulini; umzimba wethu unamathele emhlabathini.
44.26: Sukuma, usisize, usihlenge ngenxa yomusa wakho.

45.1: Inhliziyo yami iyachichima ngendaba enhle; ngikhuluma igama engiliqambe ngenkosi; ulimi lwami lulusiba loloba ngokushesha.
45.2: Umuhle wena kunabantwana babantu; ubuhle buthululelwe ezindebeni zakho; ngakho-ke uNkulunkulu ukubusisile kuze kube phakade.
45.3: Bophela inkemba yakho okhalweni lwakho wena qhawe, kube ngukuphakama kwakho nobukhosi bakho.
45.4: Hlahlameleka ebukhosini bakho, uqhubeke ngenxa yeqiniso nokuthobeka nokulunga; isandla sakho sokunene siyakukufundisa izinto ezesabekayo.
45.5: Imicibisholo yakho ibukhali, izizwe ziyawa phansi kwakho; isenhliziyweni yezitha zenkosi.
45.6: Isihlalo sakho sobukhosi, Nkulunkulu, singesaphakade naphakade; intonga yobuqotho iyintonga yombuso wakho.
45.7: Ukuthandile ukulunga, wakuzonda okubi: ngakho-ke uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wakho, ukugcobile ngamafutha enjabulo ngokungaphezu kwabangane bakho.
45.8: Zonke izingubo zakho ziqholiwe ngenhlaka, nenhlaba, nekasiya;* ezindlini zobukhosi zophondo lwendlovu ukubethwa kwezingubhu zezintambo kukujabulisile.
45.9: Amadodakazi amakhosi aphakathi kwabesifazane bakho abadumileyo; inkosikazi imi ngakwesokunene sakho, ihlobe igolide lase-Ofiri.
45.10: Mawuzwe-ke, ndodakazi, uqaphele, ubeke indlebe yakho, ukhohlwe isizwe sakini nendlu kayihlo,
45.11: yikhona inkosi izakubuthanda ubuhle bakho, ngokuba yona iyinkosi yakho, woyikhothamela.
45.12: Indodakazi yaseTire, yebo, nabacebileyo babantu bancenga umusa wakho ngesipho.
45.13: Indodakazi yenkosi inhle kakhulu, ilapho phakathi; ingubo yayo yalukiwe ngegolide.
45.14: Iyiswa enkosini igqoke izingubo ezifekethisiweyo; izintombi ezingabangane bayo ziyayilandela; ziyiswa kuwe.
45.15: Ziyiswa ngokujabula nangokwethaba, zingena endlini yenkosi.
45.16: Amadodana akho ayakuba sesikhundleni sawoyihlo; uyakuwabeka abe yizikhulu emhlabeni wonke.
45.17: Igama lakho ngiyakulenza likhunjulwe ezizukulwaneni zonke; ngakho-ke izizwe ziyakukubonga kuze kube phakade naphakade.

46.1: UNkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sethu namandla ethu; ufunyaniswa elusizo impela ekuhluphekeni.
46.2: Ngakho-ke asiyikwesaba nokuba kuguquka umhlaba, nezintaba zidilikela ekujuleni kolwandle,
46.3: nokuba amanzi alo ehlokoma, ekhephuza, nezintaba zizamazama ngokukhukhumala kwalo.
46.4: Ukhona umfula omanzi awo athokozisa umuzi kaNkulunkulu, indlu engcwele yoPhezukonke.
46.5: UNkulunkulu uphakathi kwawo, awuyikuzanyazanyiswa; uNkulunkulu uyakuwusiza ngovivi lokusa.
46.6: Izizwe ziyaxokozela; imibuso iyazamazama; uphumisela izwi lakhe, umhlaba uncibilike.
46.7: UJehova Sebawoti unathi; uNkulunkulu kaJakobe uyinqaba yethu.
46.8: Wozani nibone izenzo zikaJehova, izincithakalo azenzileyo emhlabeni.
46.9: Uphelisa ukulwa kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba; uyaphula umnsalo, anqume umkhonto, izinqola zempi azishise ngomlilo.
46.10: Thulani, niqonde ukuthi mina nginguNkulunkulu; ngiyakuphakama phakathi kwabezizwe, ngiphakame emhlabeni.
46.11: UJehova Sebawoti unathi; uNkulunkulu kaJakobe uyinqaba yethu.

47.1: Shayani izandla, zizwe zonke; hlokomani kuNkulunkulu ngezwi lokuhalalisa.
47.2: Ngokuba uJehova oPhezukonke uyesabeka; uyinkosi enkulu phezu komhlaba wonke.
47.3: Wathobisa abantu phansi kwethu, nezizwe phansi kwezinyawo zethu.
47.4: Wasikhethela ifa lethu, udumo lukaJakobe amthandayo.
47.5: UNkulunkulu wenyukile ngokuhlokoma, uJehova ngokukhala kwecilongo.
47.6: Hubelani uNkulunkulu, hubani! Hubelani iNkosi yethu, hubani!
47.7: Ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyinkosi yomhlaba wonke; hubani ihubo!
47.8: UNkulunkulu uyabusa izizwe; uNkulunkulu uhlezi esihlalweni sakhe esingcwele sobukhosi.
47.9: Izikhulu zabantu zibuthene, zibe yisizwe sikaNkulunkulu ka-Abrahama, ngokuba izihlangu zomhlaba zingezikaNkulunkulu; uphakeme kakhulu.

48.1: Mkhulu uJehova, udunyiswa kakhulu emzini kaNkulunkulu wethu entabeni yakhe engcwele.
48.2: Inhle ngokuphakama, ingukuthokoza komhlaba wonke intaba yaseSiyoni emaceleni asenyakatho, umuzi weNkosi enkulu.
48.3: UNkulunkulu uyaziwa ezindlini zawo zobukhosi ukuthi uyinqaba.
48.4: Ngokuba bheka, amakhosi abuthana; aqhubeka kanyekanye.
48.8: Njengalokho sizwile, kanjalo sikubonile emzini kaJehova Sebawoti, emzini kaNkulunkulu wethu; uNkulunkulu uyakuwumisa kuze kube phakade.
48.9: Siyazindla ngomusa wakho, Jehova, siphakathi ethempelini lakho.
48.10: Njengalo igama lakho, Nkulunkulu, kunjalo ukubongwa kwakho kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba; isandla sakho sokunene sigcwele ukulunga.
48.11: Mayijabule intaba yaseSiyoni, kwethabe amadodakazi akwaJuda ngenxa yezahlulelo zakho.
48.12: Zungezani iSiyoni, nilikake, nibale imibhoshongo yalo.
48.13: Qaphelani izindonga zalo, nidabule izindlu zalo zobukhosi, ukuze nilandisele isizukulwane esizayo.
48.14: Ngokuba lo Nkulunkulu, unguNkulunkulu wethu phakade naphakade; uzakusihola kuze kube sekufeni.

49.1: Yizwani lokhu nonke nina bantu; bekani indlebe nina nonke enakhileyo ezweni,
49.3: Umlomo wami uzakukhuluma ukuhlakanipha, ukuzindla kwenhliziyo yami kuzakuba ngokokuqonda.
49.4: Ngizakubeka indlebe yami kuso isaga, ngiphenye imfumbe yami ngehabhu.*
49.5: Bengizakwesabelani ezinsukwini ezimbi, lapha ububi babangizingelayo bungihaqa,
49.6: labo abathemba imfuyo yabo bezigabisa ngomcebo wabo omkhulu, na?
49.7: Umuntu angemhlenge umfowabo, angemnike uNkulunkulu ihlawulo ngaye.
49.8: Ngokuba ukuhlengwa komphefumulo wabo kubiza kakhulu; akunakuphela nanini
49.10: Qha, uyakubona ukuthi abahlakaniphileyo bayafa nokuthi isiwula kanye nesiphukuphuku ziyabhubha, imfuyo yabo bayishiyele abanye.
49.11: Ukucabanga kwabo kuthi izindlu zabo zizakuma kuze kube phakade, nemizi yabo ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane; amazwe abo bawabiza ngamagama abo.
49.12: Kepha umuntu, nokuba enodumo, akayikuma; ufana nezilwane ezibhubhayo.
49.13: Le ndlela yabo ingubuwula babo, balandelwa ngabavumela umlomo wabo.
49.14: Baqhutshelwa endaweni yabafileyo njengezimvu; ukufa kuyakubalusa, abaqotho babuse phezu kwabo ngakusasa, isimo sabo siqedwe yindawo yabafileyo, bangabe besaba nandlu.
49.15: Kepha uNkulunkulu uyakuwukhulula umphefumulo wami esandleni sendawo yabafileyo, ngokuba uyakungamukela.
49.16: Ungesabi, nxa umuntu eceba, nxa ubukhosi bendlu yakhe banda.
49.17: Ngokuba ekufeni kwakhe akayikuphatha lutho; ubukhosi bakhe abuyikwehla naye.
49.18: Noma ebusisa umphefumulo wakhe esaphila, futhi abantu bekudumisa, ngokuba uzondle kahle,
49.19: nokho uyakuya esizukulwaneni sawoyise; abayikukubona ukukhanya naphakade.

50.1: UNkulunkulu uMninimandla onke, uJehova, uyakhuluma, ubiza umhlaba kusukela ekuphumeni kwelanga kuze kube sekushoneni kwalo.
50.2: ESiyoni eliphelele ebuhleni uNkulunkulu uqhamile ekukhanyeni.
50.3: UNkulunkulu wethu uyeza, akayikuthula; umlilo udla phambi kwakhe; uphahlwe yisivunguvungu esikhulu.
50.4: Ubiza izulu ngaphezulu kanye nomhlaba ukuba ahlulele isizwe sakhe:
50.5: “Buthelani kimi abangcwele bami abenza isivumelwano nami ngomhlatshelo.”
50.6: Izulu lishumayela ukulunga kwakhe, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ungumahluleli.
50.7: “Yizwa, sizwe sami, ngiyakukhuluma; Israyeli, ngizakufakaza kuwe ukuthi: NginguNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wakho.
50.8: Angiyikukujezisa ngenxa yemihlatshelo yakho; iminikelo yakho yokushiswa iphambi kwami njalo.
50.9: Angiyikuthatha nkunzi endlini yakho nampongo ezibayeni zakho.
50.10: Ngokuba zingezami zonke izilwane zehlathi, nezinkomo zasezintabeni eziyizinkulungwane.
50.11: Ngiyazazi zonke izinyoni zasezintabeni, nezilwane zasendle zaziwa yimi.
50.12: Uma bengilambile, bengingekutshele wena, ngokuba ungowami umhlaba wonke nokugcwala kwawo.
50.13: Ngiyakudla yini inyama yezinkunzi, ngiphuze igazi lezimpongo, na?
50.14: Nikela kuNkulunkulu umnikelo wokubonga, uzigcwalise izithembiso zakho koPhezukonke;
50.15: ngibize ngosuku lwenhlupheko; ngiyakukukhulula, wena uyakungidumisa.”
50.16: Kepha komubi uNkulunkulu uthi: “Yini ukuba ushumayele izimiso zami, uphathe isivumelwano sami ngomlomo wakho,
50.17: ingani uyazonda ukuqondiswa, amazwi ami uwalahla emva kwakho, na?
50.18: Uma ubona isela, uvumelana nalo; neziphingi uhlanganyela nazo.
50.19: Umlomo wakho uwuyekela ebubini; ulimi lwakho luqamba inkohliso.
50.20: Uhlala uhleba umfowenu; unyevuza indodana kanyoko.
50.21: Lokho ukwenzile, ngathula; ushaye sengathi nginjengawe; ngizakukulaya, ngikubeke phambi kwamehlo akho.
50.22: “Qaphelani lokho nina enikhohlwa uNkulunkulu, funa nginidwengule, kungabikho osindisayo.
50.23: Onikela ngomnikelo wokubonga uyangidumisa; oqaphela indlela yakhe ngiyakumbonisa insindiso kaNkulunkulu.”

51.1: Ngihawukele, Nkulunkulu, ngokomusa wakho; yesula iziphambeko zami ngokobubele bakho obukhulu.
51.2: Ngigezisise ebubini bami, ungihlanze esonweni sami.
51.3: Ngokuba ngiyazazi iziphambeko zami; isono sami siphambi kwami njalo.
51.4: Ngonile kuwe wena wedwa, ngakwenza okubi emehlweni akho, ukuze uthiwe ulungile ekukhulumeni kwakho, uchache ekwahluleleni kwakho.
51.5: Bheka, ngazalelwa ebubini, umame wangithabatha esonweni.
51.6: Bheka, uthanda iqiniso ngaphakathi enhliziyweni; wongifundisa ukuhlakanipha ekujuleni kwenhliziyo.
51.7: Ngihlanze ngehisopi,* ngihlambuluke; ngigeze, ngibe mhlophe kuneqhwa.
51.8: Ngizwise intokozo nenjabulo, ukuze ethabe amathambo owachobozileyo.
51.9: Fihla ubuso bakho ezonweni zami, wesule zonke izenzo zami ezimbi.
51.10: Nkulunkulu, dala kimi inhliziyo ehlanzekileyo, uvuse umoya oqinileyo phakathi kwami.
51.11: Ungangilahli ebusweni bakho, ungangemuki uMoya wakho oNgcwele.
51.12: Buyisela kimi ukuthokoza kwensindiso yakho, ungiphase ngomoya ovumayo.
51.13: Khona ngiyakufundisa abaphambukayo izindlela zakho; nezoni ziyakuphendukela kuwe.
51.14: Ngikhulule ecaleni legazi, Nkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yami. Khona ulimi lwami luyakuhubela ukulunga kwakho.
51.15: Nkosi, vula izindebe zami, ukuze umlomo wami ulande ngodumo lwakho.
51.16: Ngokuba awuwuthandi umhlatshelo; noma bengizakukunika uminikelo wokushiswa, ubungayikuthokoza ngawo.
51.17: Iminikelo kaNkulunkulu ingumoya owaphukileyo; inhliziyo eyaphukileyo nedabukileyo, Nkulunkulu, awuyikuyidelela.
51.18: Lenzele iSiyoni okuhle ngokomusa wakho, uzakhe izingange zaseJerusalema.
51.19: Khona uyakuyijabulela iminikelo yokulunga eshiswayo neshiswa yonke; khona bayakunikela ngezinkunzi phezu kwe-altare lakho.

52.1: Uzigabiselani ngokubi wena siqhwaga na? Umusa kaNkulunkulu umi njalo.
52.2: Ulimi lwakho lusongoza okubi njengempuco eloliweyo, wena owenza amacebo.
52.3: Uthanda okubi kunokuhle, namanga kunokukhuluma ukulunga.
52.4: Uthanda onke amazwi okubhubhisa wena lulimi lwenkohliso.
52.5: Ngakho-ke uNkulunkulu uyakukubhidliza kuze kube phakade; uyakukubamba, akukhiphe etendeni lakho, akusiphule ezweni labaphilayo.
52.7: “Bheka, nasi isiqhwaga esingamenzanga uNkulunkulu abe yinqaba yaso, kepha sethemba ingcebo yaso enkulu, siziqinisa ebubini baso.”
52.8: Kepha mina nginjengomnqumo oluhlaza endlini kaNkulunkulu; ngithemba umusa kaNkulunkulu njalonjalo kuze kube phakade naphakade.
52.9: Ngizakukudumisa kuze kube phakade, ngokuba ukwenzile; ngizakulindela igama lakho, ngokuba lihle phambi kwabangcwele bakho.

53.1: Isiwula sithi enhliziyweni yaso: “Akakho uNkulunkulu,” iziphambeko zabo zimbi, ziyanengeka; akakho owenza okuhle.
53.2: UNkulunkulu esezulwini uyababheka abantwana babantu ukubona uma kukhona yini onokuqonda, ofuna uNkulunkulu.
53.3: Baphambukile bonke, bonakele bonke; akakho owenza okuhle, akakho noyedwa.
53.4: Abanakwazi yini abenza okubi, abadla abantu bami njengalokhu bedla isinkwa, bengakhuleki kuNkulunkulu.
53.5: Besaba nokwesaba, lapho kungekho okwesabisayo; ngokuba uNkulunkulu wasakaza amathambo akhe owamisa ngakuwe; wena ubajabhisile, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ubalahlile.
53.6: Sengathi kungavela ukusindiswa kuka-Israyeli eSiyoni. Kuyakuthi lapho uNkulunkulu eguqula ukuthunjwa kwabantu bakhe, uJakobe ethabe, u-Israyeli ajabule.

54.1: Nkulunkulu, ngisindise ngegama lakho, ngahlulele ngamandla akho.
54.2: Nkulunkulu, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe emazwini omlomo wami.
54.3: Ngokuba abafo bangivukele; izidlova zifuna umphefumulo wami; azimbekile uNkulunkulu phambi kwazo.
54.4: Bheka, uNkulunkulu ungumsizi wami; iNkosi ikubo abaphasa umphefumulo wami.
54.5: Uyabuyisela okubi ezitheni zami; zibhubhise ngokweqiniso lakho.
54.6: Ngizakunikela kuwe ngesihle; ngizakulibonga igama lakho, Jehova, ngokuba lihle.
54.7: Ngokuba ungikhululile ekuhluphekeni konke; neso lami libuka izitha zami, lidele.

55.1: Lalela, Nkulunkulu, umkhuleko wami, ungazifihli ekunxuseni kwami.
55.2: Ngizwele, ungiphendule; ngiyayaluza ekukhaleni kwami, ngiyabubula
55.3: ngenxa yezwi lesitha, ngenxa yokucindezela komubi; ngokuba bagingqela okubi phezu kwami; bangizingela bethukuthele.
55.4: Inhliziyo yami iyathuthumela phakathi kwami; amavuso okufa angehlele.
55.5: Ngifikelwe luvalo nokuqhaqhazela; ngikhwelwe ngukwesaba okukhulu.
55.6: Besengithi: “Sengathi ngingaba namaphiko njengejuba; ngabe ngindizela ekudeni, ngihlale khona.”
55.7: Bheka, bengiyakubaleka, ngiye kude, ngingenise ehlane.
55.8: Ngabe ngiphuthuma indawo yokuphepha emoyeni ovunguzayo nasesiphephweni.
55.9: Bachithe, Nkosi, uphambanise ulimi lwabo, ngokuba ngibonile ubudlwangudlwangu nokuxabana emzini.
55.10: Imini nobusuku bahamba bezungeza phezu kwezingange zawo; okubi nokushinga kuphakathi kwawo.
55.11: Ububi buphakathi kwawo; imbandezelo nenkohliso akusuki esigcawini sawo.
55.12: Ngokuba akusiso isitha esingiklolodelayo; ngabe ngiyakuthwala; akusiye ongizondayo oziphakamise phezu kwami; ngabe ngamcashela;
55.13: kepha nguwe ntanga yami, mhlobo wami nomngane wami.
55.14: Sasihlalisana kamnandi; sasiya endlini kaNkulunkulu kanye nebandla elithokozayo.
55.15: Ukufa makubazume, bashonele endaweni yabafileyo besezwa, ngokuba ububi busezindlini zabo nasezinhliziyweni zabo.
55.17: Kusihlwa nasekuseni nasemini ngizakuzikhalela, ngibubule, abeselizwa izwi lami.
55.18: Uyawuhlenga umphefumulo wami ngokuthula, bangasondeli kimi, ngokuba baningi abamelene nami.
55.19: UNkulunkulu uzakuzwa, abaphendule, yena okhona kwaphakade. Yibona kambe okungekho kubo ukuphenduka, nabangamesabiyo uNkulunkulu.
55.20: Ubeka isandla ngakuye ohlalisene kahle naye; udumazile isivumelwano sakhe.
55.21: Umlomo wakhe ubushelezi kunephehlwa, kepha inhliziyo yakhe iyimpi; amazwi akhe athambile kunamafutha; nokho ayizinkemba ezikhokhiweyo.
55.22: Phonsa phezu kukaJehova umthwalo wakho, uzakukuphasa; akayikuvuma naphakade ukuba olungileyo azanyazanyiswe.
55.23: Wena Nkulunkulu uyakubaphonsa egodini lokubhubhisa; abantu begazi nenkohliso abayikufinyelela nasenxenyeni yezinsuku zabo; kepha mina ngizakwethemba wena.

56.1: Yiba nomusa kimi, Nkulunkulu, ngokuba abantu bafuna ukungigwinya; usuku lonke bayangicindezela belwa.
56.2: Izitha zami zifuna ukungigwinya usuku lonke; ngokuba baningi abalwa nami ngokuzidla.
56.4: KuNkulunkulu ngiyakudumisa izwi lakhe; ngithemba uNkulunkulu, angiyikwesaba; inyama ingangenzani na?
56.5: Amazwi ami bawahlanekezela usuku lonke; yonke imicabango yabo iqonde ukungona.
56.6: Bayabuthana, baqamekele, baqaphele izinyathelo zami, njengokuba beqamekela umphefumulo wami.
56.7: Bayakuphunyuka yini ebubini babo na? Diliza izizwe ngentukuthelo, Nkulunkulu.
56.8: Ukuzula kwami ukubalile wena; yetha izinyembezi zami egabheni lakho; azikho encwadini yakho na?
56.9: Khona izitha zami ziyakubuyela emuva mhla ngikhalayo; ngiyakwazi lokhu ukuthi uNkulunkulu unami.
56.10: KuNkulunkulu ngiyakulidumisa izwi; kuJehova ngiyakulidumisa izwi.
56.11: Ngiyethemba kuNkulunkulu, angiyikwesaba; umuntu angangenzani na?
56.12: Nkulunkulu, izithembiso zami kuwe ziphezu kwami; ngiyakunikela kuwe iminikelo yokubonga.
56.13: Ngokuba uwukhululile umphefumulo wami ekufeni nezinyawo zami ekuweni, ukuze ngihambe ebusweni bukaNkulunkulu ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo.

57.1: Yiba nomusa kimi, Nkulunkulu; yiba nomusa kimi. Ngokuba umphefumulo wami uphephela kuwe; ngifuna ukukhosela ethunzini lamaphiko akho, zize zidlule izinhlupheko.
57.3: Uyakuthumela esezulwini, angisindise mhla ofuna ukungigwinya ekloloda. UNkulunkulu uyakuthuma umusa wakhe neqiniso lakhe.
57.4: Umphefumulo wami uphakathi kwezingonyama; ngilala kwabavutha umlilo, abantwana babantu abamazinyo abo ayimikhonto nemicibisholo, abalulimi lwabo luyinkemba ebukhali.
57.5: Phakama, Nkulunkulu, phezu kwezulu, inkazimulo ibe phezu komhlaba wonke.
57.6: Izinyathelo zami bazibekele ugibe; umphefumulo wami ugobile; bembile igebe phambi kwami, kwakhalakathela bona kulo.
57.7: Inhliziyo yami iduduzekile, Nkulunkulu; inhliziyo yami iduduzekile; ngizakuhlabelela, ngihube.
57.8: Vuka, mphefumulo wami; vukani, lugubhu nehabhu!* Ngizakuvusa ukusa.
57.9: Ngizakukubonga, Nkosi, phakathi kwabantu, ngikudumise phakathi kwezizwe.
57.10: Ngokuba umusa wakho mkhulu kuze kube sezulwini, nokuthembeka kwakho kuze kube semafwini.
57.11: Phakama, Nkulunkulu, phezu kwezulu, inkazimulo yakho ibe phezu komhlaba wonke.

58.1: Imbala nikhuluma ukulunga ngokuthula na? Madodana abantu, nahlulela ngobuqotho na?
58.2: Ingani enhliziyweni niphehla imisebenzi emibi; ezweni nilinganisa ngesilinganiso ukudluzula kwezandla zenu.
58.3: Ababi bahlubuka kwasesizalweni, abaqamba amanga baduka kwasesiswini.
58.4: Isihlungu sabo sinjengesihlungu senyoka; banjengebululu eliyisithulu, elivimba indlebe yalo,
58.5: lingalaleli izwi lezinyanga ezilumba amalumbo ngokuhlakanipha.
58.6: Yaphula amazinyo abo emlonyeni wabo, Nkulunkulu! Phohloza amazinyo omhlathi ezingonyama ezingamabhongo, Jehova!
58.7: Mabaphele njengamanzi agobhozayo; nxa ekhomba ngemicibisholo yakhe, mayibe sengathi iqundekile.
58.8: Mababe njengomnenke oncibilika, uphele, njengokuphuphume kowesifazane okungalibonanga ilanga.
58.9: Amabhodwe enu engakazizwa izinkuni zameva, uyakuziphephula, noma ziluhlaza noma zivutha.
58.10: Olungileyo uyakujabula ngokuba ebona impindiselo; uyakugeza izinyawo zakhe egazini lababi,
58.11: abantu baze bathi: “Impela ukhona umvuzo wolungileyo; impela ukhona uNkulunkulu owahlulelayo emhlabeni.”

59.1: Ngikhulule ezitheni zami, Nkulunkulu wami, ngivikele kwabangivukelayo;
59.2: ngikhulule kwabenza okubi, ngisindise kubantu begazi.
59.3: Ngokuba bheka, baqamekela umphefumulo wami; iziqhwaga ziyangihlanganyela, kungekho siphambeko, kungekho sono kimi, Jehova.
59.4: Ziyagijima, zizilungisele, kungekho cala kimi; vuka, ungihlangabeze, ubone.
59.5: Wena kambe, Jehova Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, vuka uphindisele bonke abezizwe, ungahawukeli namunye kwabahlubukileyo.
59.6: Bayabuya kusihlwa, bahlaba umkhulungwane njengenja, bezula emzini.
59.7: Bheka, bayampompa ngomlomo wabo, kukhona izinkemba ezindebeni zabo, ngokuba bathi: “Ngubani ozwayo na?”
59.8: Kepha wena Jehova uyabahleka; uyabaklolodela bonke abezizwe.
59.9: Mandla ami, ngiyakulindela wena, ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyinqaba yami.
59.10: UNkulunkulu wami uyakungihlangabeza ngomusa wakhe; uNkulunkulu uyakungibonisa izitha zami ngokwethaba.
59.11: Ungazibulali, funa abantu bami bakhohlwe; zizulise ngamandla akho, uzilahle phansi, Nkosi, sihlangu sethu.
