59.12: Izwi lezindebe zazo liyisono somlomo wazo; mazibanjwe ekuzidleni kwazo nangenxa yesiqalekiso namanga eziwakhulumayo.
59.13: Ziqede ngokuthukuthela, ziqede zingabe zisabakho; mazazi ukuba nguNkulunkulu obusa kwaJakobe, kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba.
59.14: Ziyabuya kusihlwa; zihlaba umkhulungwane njengenja, zizula emzini.
59.15: Zizulazulela ukudla; uma zingasuthi, zihlala nasebusuku.
59.16: Kepha mina ngizakuhlabelela ngamandla akho, ngethabele umusa wakho ekuseni, ngokuba uyinqaba yami, nesiphephelo ngosuku lokuhlupheka kwami.
59.17: Mandla ami, ngizakuhubela wena; ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyinqaba yami, unguNkulunkulu wami womusa.

60.2: Uzamazamisile umhlaba, wawudabula izimfa; zivale izimfa zawo, ngokuba uyazamazama.
60.3: Isizwe sakho usibonisile izinto ezinzima; usiphuzisile iwayini, sabhuyazela.
60.4: Abakwesabayo ubanike ibhanela* ukuba liphakanyiswe ngenxa yeqiniso.
60.5: Ukuze abathandekayo bakho bakhululwe, sindisa ngesandla sakho sokunene, ungizwele.
60.6: UNkulunkulu ukhulumile ebungcweleni bakhe, wathi: “Ngiyakwethaba; ngiyakulidabula iShekemi, ngisilinganise isiGodi saseSukoti.
60.7: Ngowami uGileyadi, ngowami uManase; u-Efrayimi uyisivikelo sekhanda lami, uJuda uyintonga yami yokubusa.
60.8: UMowabi uyisitsha sami sokuhlambela; phezu kuka-Edomi ngiphonsa isicathulo sami; yethaba ngami, Filistiya.”
60.9: Ngubani oyakungiyisa emzini oqinileyo na? Ngubani oyakungiholela kwa-Edomi na?
60.10: Akusiwena Nkulunkulu osilahlileyo na? Nkulunkulu, awusaphumi nezimpi zethu.
60.11: Siphe ukuba sisizakale ekuhluphekeni, ngokuba ukusiza komuntu kuyize.
60.12: NgoNkulunkulu siyakwenza izenzo zamandla; yena uyakunyathela phansi izitha zethu.

61.1: Yizwa, Nkulunkulu, ukukhala kwami, ulalele umkhuleko wami.
61.2: Ngikhala kuwe ngisemkhawulweni womhlaba, lapho inhliziyo yami isebuthakathakeni; ngiholele edwaleni eliphakeme kunami.
61.3: Ngokuba ubuyisiphephelo sami, inqaba eqinileyo ngakuso isitha.
61.4: Ngiyakuhlala etendeni lakho kuze kube phakade; ngiyakukhosela ekusithekeni kwamaphiko akho.
61.5: Ngokuba wena Nkulunkulu uzizwile izithembiso zami, wabanika ifa abalesaba igama lakho.
61.6: Uyakweleka izinsuku ezinsukwini zenkosi; iminyaka yayo iyakuba njengezizukulwane nezizukulwane.
61.7: Iyakuhlala phambi kukaNkulunkulu kuze kube phakade; yimisele umusa neqiniso ukuba kuyilondoloze.
61.8: Khona ngiyakulidumisa igama lakho kuze kube phakade, ukuze ngigcwalise izithembiso zami imihla ngemihla.

62.1: Umphefumulo wami uzithulele kuNkulunkulu kuphela; insindiso yami ivela kuye.
62.2: Nguye kuphela oyidwala lami nensindiso yami, inqaba yami; angiyikunyakaziswa kakhulu.
62.3: Koze kube nini nisukela umuntu ukuba nimbulale nonke njengodonga olwengemeyo nothango oludilikayo na?
62.4: Yebo, bathunga icebo lokumwisa ekuphakameni kwakhe, bathanda amanga; bayabusisa ngomlomo wabo, kepha ezibilinini zabo bayaqalekisa.
62.5: Mphefumulo wami, zithulisele kuNkulunkulu kuphela, ngokuba ithemba lami livela kuye.
62.6: Nguye kuphela oyidwala lami nensindiso yami, inqaba yami; angiyikunyakaziswa.
62.7: Insindiso yami nodumo lwami kukuNkulunkulu; idwala lami eliqinileyo nesiphephelo sami kukuNkulunkulu.
62.8: Thembani kuye ngezikhathi zonke nina bantu, nithulule inhliziyo yenu phambi kwakhe; uNkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sethu.
62.9: Abantwana babantu bangumoya nje, abantwana bezikhulu bangamanga; esilinganisweni bayakhuphuka, balula kunomoya bonke.
62.10: Maningakwethembi ukuqhwaga, ningazigabisi ngokuphangiweyo; uma imfuyo yanda, ningayibeki inhliziyo kuyo.
62.11: UNkulunkulu ukhulumile kanye, ngikuzwe kabili ukuthi amandla angakaNkulunkulu.
62.12: Nomusa ungowakho, Nkosi; ngokuba wena umphindisela umuntu njengokwenza kwakhe.

63.1: Nkulunkulu, wena unguNkulunkulu wami, ngiyakufuna ekuseni; umphefumulo wami womele wena; inyama yami ilangazelela wena ezweni elomileyo eligagadekileyo, lapho amanzi engekho khona.
63.2: Kanjalo ngikubheka endlini engcwele, ngibone amandla akho nenkazimulo yakho.
63.3: Ngokuba umusa wakho umnandi kunokuphila; izindebe zami ziyakukudumisa.
63.4: Ngiyakukubonga ngisaphila; ngiyakuphakamisa izandla zami egameni lakho.
63.5: Umphefumulo wami uyakusutha kungathi ngamanoni namafutha; umlomo wami uyakudumisa ngezindebe ezethabayo.
63.6: Nxa ngikukhumbula ecansini lami, ngizindla ngawe emilindweni yasebusuku.
63.7: Ngokuba ungisizile; ngiyakwethaba ethunzini lamaphiko akho.
63.8: Umphefumulo wami ubambelele kuwe; esokunene sakho siyangiphasa.
63.9: Kepha abafuna umphefumulo wami ukuwubulala bayakwehlela ezindaweni zomhlaba eziphansi.
63.10: Bayakunikelwa esandleni senkemba, babe yisabelo sezimpungushe.
63.11: Kepha inkosi iyakuthokoza ngoNkulunkulu; bonke abafunga yena bayakuzibonga; ngokuba umlomo wabakhuluma amanga uyakuvalwa.

64.1: Yizwa, Nkulunkulu, izwi lami ekukhaleni kwami, ulondoloze ukuphila kwami evusweni lesitha.
64.2: Ngisithe esigungwini sababi nasesixukwini sabenza okubi,
64.3: abalola ulimi lwabo njengenkemba, bakhombe imicibisholo yabo engamazwi ababayo
64.4: ukuba bamdubule ongenacala ngasesitha, bamdubule ngokuzuma bengesabi.
64.5: Baqinela icebo elibi; bakhuluma ngokufihla izingibe; bathi: “Ngubani oyakusibona na?”
64.6: Basongoza izenzo ezimbi, bathi: “Siliqedile icebo elisongoziweyo,” izibilini nenhliziyo yomuntu kujulile.
64.7: Kepha uNkulunkulu uyakubadubula ngomcibisholo; bagwazwe ngokuzunywa.
64.8: Bayakuwiswa, baficwe lulimi lwabo; bonke abababonayo bayonikina ikhanda.
64.9: Bonke abantu bayashaywa luvalo; bayakushumayela izenzo zikaNkulunkulu, baqonde akwenzileyo.
64.10: Olungileyo uyakujabula kuJehova, aphephele kuye; bonke abaqotho ngenhliziyo bayakuzibonga.

65.1: Udumiso luhlalela wena Nkulunkulu eSiyoni, nesithembiso siyakugcwaliswa kuwe.
65.2: Wena ozwayo imikhuleko, beza kuwe bonke abantu.
65.3: Izenzo ezimbi zangahlula; iziphambeko zethu uyaziyekela.
65.4: Ubusisiwe omkhethayo wena, omsondezayo ukuba ahlale emagcekeni akho; siyakusutha ngokuhle kwendlu yakho, ithempeli lakho elingcwele.
65.5: Uyakusiphendula ngezenzo ezesabekayo ekulungeni, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, wena oyithemba lemikhawulo yonke yomhlaba nelolwandle olukude;
65.6: yena omisa izintaba ngamandla akhe, obhince amandla;
65.7: othulisa ukuduma kwezilwandle, inhlokomo yamaza azo nomsindo wabantu.
65.8: Abakhile emikhawulweni yomhlaba bayesaba ngezibonakaliso zakho; uyethabisa impumalanga nentshonalanga.
65.9: Uhambela umhlaba, unisa imvula, uwuvundisa kakhulu; umfula kaNkulunkulu ugcwele amanzi; ubalungisela abantu ukudla, ngokuba uwulungisa kanjalo umhlaba.
65.10: Umatisa imisele yawo, ulalisa amasoyi awo; uwuthambisa ngezihlambi, ubusise okumila kuwo.
65.11: Umnyaka uyawuhlobisa ngobumnene bakho, nemikhondo yakho iconsa amafutha.
65.12: Amadlelo asehlane ayaconsa; amagquma abhinca injabulo.
65.13: Amadlelo embethe izimvu, nezigodi zisibekelwe ngamabele; konke kuyajabula, kuhlabelele.

66.2: Hlabelelelani inkazimulo yegama lakhe, nibabaze ukudunyiswa kwakhe.
66.3: Yishoni kuNkulunkulu, nithi: “Yeka ukwesabeka kwemisebenzi yakho. Ngenxa yobukhulu bamandla akho izitha zakho ziyakuzithoba phansi kwakho.
66.4: Umhlaba wonke uyakukhuleka kuwe, ukudumise; bayakuhubela igama lakho.”
66.5: Wozani nibone izenzo zikaNkulunkulu; uyesabeka ekwenzeni kwakhe kubantwana babantu.
66.6: Ulwandle waluguqula lwaba yizwe elomileyo; bawela umfula ngezinyawo; lapho sathokoza kuye.
66.7: Ubusa ngamandla akhe kuze kube phakade; amehlo akhe ayahlozinga izizwe; abanenkani mabangaziphakamisi.
66.8: Bongani uNkulunkulu wethu nina zizwe, nizwakalise izwi lokudunyiswa kwakhe
66.9: ogcina umphefumulo wethu ekuphileni, engaluvumeli unyawo lwethu lushelele.
66.10: Ngokuba wena Nkulunkulu usilingile, wasihlanza njengokuhlanzwa kwesiliva.
66.11: Wasingenisa enetheni; wabeka umthwalo onzima ezinkalweni zethu.
66.12: Wavumela abantu ukuba bakhwele phezu kwamakhanda ethu; sangena emlilweni nasemanzini; kepha wasikhiphela ekubuseni.
66.13: Ngiyakungena endlini yakho ngineminikelo yokushiswa; ngizakugcwalisa kuwe izithembiso zami
66.14: ezaphinyiselwa yizindebe zami, zakhulunywa ngumlomo wami ngisekuhluphekeni.
66.15: Ngiyakunikela kuwe iminikelo yokushiswa yezinonileyo kanye nephunga lezinqama; ngiyakunikela ngezinkunzi nangezimpongo.
66.16: Wozani nizwe nina nonke enesaba uNkulunkulu; ngizakulandisa akwenzele umphefumulo wami.
66.17: Ngakhala kuye ngomlomo wami; ukudumisa kwakuphansi kolimi lwami.
66.18: Uma bengiqonde ububi enhliziyweni yami, ibingayikungizwa iNkosi.
66.19: Ngempela uNkulunkulu uzwile, walalela izwi lomkhuleko wami.
66.20: Makabongwe uNkulunkulu ongalahlanga umkhuleko wami nomusa wakhe kimi.

67.1: UNkulunkulu makabe nomusa kithina, asibusise; makakhanyise ubuso bakhe phezu kwethu,
67.2: ukuze indlela yakho yaziwe emhlabeni, insindiso yakho kubo bonke abezizwe.
67.3: Abantu mabakubonge, Nkulunkulu; mabakubonge abantu bonke.
67.4: Izizwe mazijabule, zethabe; ngokuba izizwe uzahlulela ngokulunga, uzihola izizwe emhlabeni.
67.5: Abantu mabakubonge, Nkulunkulu; mabakubonge abantu bonke.
67.6: Umhlaba uthelile izithelo zawo; uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wethu, uyasibusisa.
67.7: UNkulunkulu uyasibusisa; imikhawulo yonke yomhlaba iyakumesaba.

68.1: Makavuke uNkulunkulu, zihlakazeke izitha zakhe; abamzondayo babaleka phambi kwakhe.
68.2: Bamukiswa njengokumukiswa komusi; njengokuncibilika kwengcina phambi komlilo ababi bachithwa phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
68.3: Kepha abalungileyo bayajabula; bayethaba phambi kukaNkulunkulu bethokoza nokuthokoza.
68.4: Hlabelelani kuNkulunkulu, nidumise igama lakhe; menzeleni umendo lowo odabula amahlane; igama lakhe linguJehova; yethabani phambi kwakhe,
68.5: uyise wezintandane, umahluleli wabafelokazi, uNkulunkulu endlini yakhe engcwele,
68.6: uNkulunkulu ohlalisa imihlalaqha ezindlini, akhiphele iziboshwa ekubuseni; ngabahlubukileyo bodwa abakhe ezweni elomileyo.
68.7: Nkulunkulu, ekuphumeni kwakho phambi kwabantu bakho, ekudabuleni kwakho ihlane,
68.8: umhlaba wazamazama, izulu laconsa phambi kukaNkulunkulu, neSinayi lazamazama phambi kukaNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
68.9: Wanisa imvula enkulu, Nkulunkulu; ifa lakho selahlulekile, waliqinisa.
68.10: Ibandla lakho lakha kulo; ngobuhle bakho wabalungisela abahluphekayo, Nkulunkulu.
68.11: INkosi iphumisa izwi; abesifazane ababika indaba ejabulisayo bayisixuku esikhulu.
68.12: Amakhosi ezimpi ayabaleka; ayabaleka wona; isifazane esihlezi ekhaya sabela impango.
68.13: Nxa nilala phakathi kwezibaya, kunjengamaphiko ejuba asibekelwa ngesiliva, izimpaphe zamaphiko alo ngegolide elikhazimulayo.
68.14: Nxa uSomandla ehlakaza amakhosi kulo, likhithika iqhwa eSalimoni.
68.15: Intaba yaseBashani iyintaba kaNkulunkulu; intaba yaseBashani iyintaba eneziqongo.
68.16: Nina zintaba ezineziqongo, yini ukuba niyibuke ngomhawu intaba uNkulunkulu athanda ukuhlala kuyo na? Yebo, uJehova uyakuhlala kuyo kuze kube phakade.
68.17: Izinqola zikaNkulunkulu ziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili, izinkulungwane nezinkulungwane; iNkosi iphakathi kwazo; iSinayi lisendaweni engcwele.
68.18: Wena wenyukela phezulu, wathumba izithunjwa, wamukela izipho kubantu nakwabahlubukileyo, ukuze uJehova uNkulunkulu ahlale khona.
68.19: Mayibongwe iNkosi. Iyasithwala imihla ngemihla; uNkulunkulu uyinsindiso yethu.
68.20: Kithina uNkulunkulu unguNkulunkulu wezinkululo; ukukhipha ekufeni kungokukaJehova iNkosi.
68.21: Impela uNkulunkulu uyakuliphohloza ikhanda lezitha zakhe, ukhakhayi olunesihluthu lwalowo osahamba ezonweni zakhe.
68.22: INkosi yathi: “Ngiyakubabuyisa eBashani, ngibabuyise ekujuleni kolwandle
68.23: ukuba unyawo lwakho ulucwilise egazini, ulimi lwezinja zakho lube nesabelo salo ezitheni.”
68.24: Bayazibona izindwendwe zakho, Nkulunkulu, izindwendwe zikaNkulunkulu wami, iNkosi yami, ziya endlini engcwele.
68.25: Ngaphambili kuhamba abahlabeleli, ngasemuva abashaya ugubhu, ngaphakathi izintombi ezishaya izingubhu.
68.26: Bongani uNkulunkulu emihlanganweni; bongani iNkosi, nina bomthombo ka-Israyeli.
68.27: Nango uBenjamini, omncane, umbusi wabo, neviyo lezikhulu zakwaJuda, izikhulu zakwaZebuloni nezikhulu zakwaNafetali.
68.28: UNkulunkulu wakho ukumisele amandla akho; qinisa, Nkulunkulu, lokho ozenzela khona.
68.29: Ngenxa yethempeli lakho eJerusalema amakhosi ayakukulethela izipho.
68.30: Zikhuze izilwane zasemhlangeni, umhlambi wezinkunzi kanye namankonyane abantu, azithobise phansi ngezinqamu zesiliva; uyazihlakaza izizwe ezithanda ukulwa.
68.31: Izikhulu ziyakuvela eGibithe; amaKushe ayakwelulela ngokushesha izandla zawo kuNkulunkulu.
68.32: Nina mibuso yomhlaba mhubeleni uNkulunkulu, nidumise iNkosi,
68.33: yona ekhwela phezu kwamazulu ezulu asendulo; bhekani, iyezwakalisa izwi layo, izwi elinamandla.
68.34: Nikani uNkulunkulu amandla; ubukhosi bakhe buphezu kuka-Israyeli; amandla akhe asemafwini.
68.35: Nkulunkulu, uyesabeka ezindaweni zakho ezingcwele; uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli nguyena owenzela abantu amandla nokuqina; makadunyiswe uNkulunkulu.

69.1: Ngisindise, Nkulunkulu, ngokuba amanzi afikile emphefumulweni.
69.2: Ngishone odakeni lobishi olujulileyo, kungekho kuma; ngingene emanzini alutwa; imisinga iyangicwilisa.
69.3: Ngikhathele ukukhala kwami, umphimbo wami ushile; amehlo ami ayafiphala ekulindeleni uNkulunkulu wami.
69.4: Abangizonda ngeze baningi kunezinwele zekhanda lami; baningi abafuna ukungiqeda beyizitha zami kungekho sici; nengingakuphanganga ngakubuyisela.
69.5: Nkulunkulu, wena uyabazi ubuwula bami, nezono zami azifihlakele kuwe.
69.6: Mabangajabhiswa ngami abakulindeleyo, Nkosi Jehova Sebawoti; mabangahlazeki ngami abakufunayo, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
69.7: Ngokuba ngithwele isihlamba ngenxa yakho; ihlazo lisibekela ubuso bami.
69.8: Sengaba ngumfokazi kubafowethu, nowezizwe kubantwana bakamame.
69.9: Ngokuba ukushisekela indlu yakho kungidlile; izithuko zabakuthukayo zingehlele.
69.10: Ngakhala, umphefumulo wami wazila; kwaba ngukudunyazwa kwami.
69.11: Isaka ngalenza isambatho sami; ngaba yisaga kubo.
69.12: Abahlezi esangweni bakhuluma ngami; izidakwa ziyangihaya.
69.13: Kodwa mina, umkhuleko wami ukuwe Jehova esikhathini sokuzwelwa, Nkulunkulu; ngenxa yomusa wakho omkhulu ngiphendule eqinisweni lensindiso yakho.
69.14: Ngikhiphe odakeni, mangingashoni; mangisindiswe kubo abangizondayo, nasemanzini alutwa.
69.15: Isikhukhula samanzi masingangicwilisi, utwa lungangigwinyi, umgodi ungangivaleli emlonyeni wawo.
69.16: Ngiphendule, Jehova, ngokuba umusa wakho ulungile; uphendukele kimi ngokobubele bakho obukhulu.
69.17: Ungayifihleli inceku yakho ubuso bakho, ngokuba ngiyahlupheka; shesha ungiphendule.
69.18: Sondela kuwo umphefumulo wami, uwuhlenge, ngikhulule ngenxa yezitha zami.
69.19: Wena uyakwazi ukuthukwa kwami, namahloni ami nokudunyazwa kwami; zonke izitha zami ziphambi kwakho.
69.20: Ukuthukwa kuyaphulile inhliziyo yami, ngigula kakhulu; bengibheka ukuhawukelwa, kepha akwabakho, nabaduduzayo, kepha angibatholanga.
69.21: Banginika inyongo ibe ngukudla kwami; ekomeni kwami bangiphuzisa uviniga.
69.22: Itafula labo malibe yisihibe phambi kwabo, libe lugibe kwabahlezi bezithulele.
69.23: Amehlo abo mawafiphale, ukuze bangaboni; izinkalo zabo zintengezele njalo.
69.24: Thela phezu kwabo ukunengwa kwakho; intukuthelo yakho evuthayo mayibafice.
69.25: Umuzi wabo mawuchitheke; makungabikho ohlala ematendeni abo.
69.26: Ngokuba oshaywe nguwe bayamzingela, baxoxa ngobuhlungu bezinkubela zakho.
69.27: Yengezela ukona ekoneni kwabo; mabangezi ekulungeni kwakho.
69.28: Mabesulwe encwadini yabaphilayo, bangalotshwa kanye nabalungileyo.
69.29: Mina kodwa ngihluphekile, ngibuhlungu; insindiso yakho, Nkulunkulu mayingilondoloze.
69.30: Ngiyakulibonga ngehubo igama likaNkulunkulu, ngimphakamise ngokubonga.
69.31: Kuyakuthandeka kuJehova kunenkomo, kunenkunzi enezimpondo nezinselo.
69.32: Kuyakuthi abayizivi bekubona, bajabule; nina enifuna uNkulunkulu, inhliziyo yenu mayiphile.
69.33: Ngokuba uJehova uyabalalela abampofu, neziboshwa zakhe akazideleli.
69.34: Uyakubongwa yizulu nomhlaba, yizilwandle nakho konke okuphila kuzo.
69.35: Ngokuba uNkulunkulu uzakulisindisa iSiyoni, akhe imizi yakwaJuda; bazakuhlala khona, ibe yifa labo.
69.36: Inzalo yezinceku zakhe iyakulidla ifa; abathanda igama lakhe bayakuhlala kuyo.

70.1: Nkulunkulu, phuthuma ungikhulule. Jehova, phuthuma ungisize.
70.2: Mabajabhe, bayangaze abafuna umphefumulo wami. Mababuyiselwe emuva, bajabhiswe abangifisela umonakalo.
70.3: Abathi ashila, ashila mababuyele emuva ngenxa yokuhlazeka kwabo.
70.4: Mabethabe, bajabule kuwe bonke abakufunayo; abathanda insindiso yakho mabasho njalonjalo, bathi: “Makabe mkhulu uNkulunkulu.”
70.5: Ngokuba mina ngihluphekile, ngimpofu; Nkulunkulu, ngiphuthumele. Wena uyinsizakalo yami nomkhululi wami; Jehova, ungalibali.

71.2: Ngikhulule ngokulunga kwakho, ungihlangulise; beka indlebe yakho kimi, ungisindise.
71.3: Yiba kimi idwala lokuhlala, ukuze ngiye kulo njalonjalo; ukuyalezile ukusindiswa kwami, ngokuba uyidwala lami nenqaba yami.
71.4: Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhulule esandleni somubi, esandleni songalungile nesonakeleyo.
71.5: Ngokuba wena uyithemba lami, Nkosi Jehova, ithemba lami kwasebusheni bami.
71.6: Ngencike kuwe kwasesiswini; nguwe owangikhipha ezibilinini zikamame; ukudumisa kwami kuyakuba ngawe njalo.
71.7: Nginjengesimangaliso kwabaningi, kepha wena uyisiphephelo sami esinamandla.
71.8: Umlomo wami uzakugcwala ukubonga wena, nalo udumo lwakho usuku lonke.
71.9: Ungangilahli esikhathini sobudala, ungangishiyi ekupheleni kwamandla ami,
71.10: ngokuba izitha zami zikhuluma ngami, nabawuhlomele umphefumulo wami bayahlebelana,
71.11: bathi: “UNkulunkulu umshiyile; zingelani nimbambe, ngokuba akakho osindisayo.”
71.12: Nkulunkulu, ungabi kude nami; Nkulunkulu, phuthuma ungisize.
71.13: Abamelene nomphefumulo wami mabajabhe, baphele; abangifunela umonakalo mabembathe amahloni nenhlamba.
71.14: Mina kodwa ngiyakwethemba njalo, ngengeze ukudumisa ekudunyisweni kwakho.
71.15: Umlomo wami uyakulanda ukulunga kwakho, nensindiso yakho lonke usuku; ngokuba anginakukubala.
71.16: Ngiyakuletha izenzo ezinqabileyo zeNkosi uJehova; ngiyakubonga ukulunga kwakho, okwakho kuphela.
71.17: Nkulunkulu, ungifundisile kwasebusheni bami; ngizilandile izimangaliso zakho kuze kube manje.
71.18: Futhi mawungangishiyi, nxa ngimdala, ngiyimpunga, ngize ngishumayele ingalo yakho kuso isizukulwane, amandla akho kubo bonke abezayo.
71.19: Ukulunga kwakho, Nkulunkulu, kufinyelele ezulwini; wena owenze izinto ezinkulu, Nkulunkulu, ngubani onjengawe na?
71.20: Wena owasizwisa izinhlupheko eziningi ezimbi, uyakubuye usiphilise, usikhuphule ezinzulwini zomhlaba.
71.22: Yikhona nami ngizakububonga ubuqotho bakho, Nkulunkulu wami, ngogubhu lwezintambo; ngizakukudumisa ngehabhu* wena oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
71.23: Izindebe zami zizakujabula, ngokuba ngizakukudumisa wena, nomphefumulo wami owuhlengileyo.
71.24: Ulimi lwami futhi luzakukhuluma lonke usuku ngokulunga; ngokuba badunyaziwe, bajabhisiwe abangifunela umonakalo.

72.1: Nkulunkulu, nika inkosi izahlulelo zakho nendodana yenkosi ukulunga kwakho.
72.2: Iyakwahlulela isizwe sakho ngeqiniso nezihlupheki zakho ngemfanelo.
72.3: Izintaba ziyakuletha ukuthula kubantu; kanjalo namagquma, ngokulunga.
72.4: Izakubahlulela abahluphekileyo kubantu, isindise abantwana babampofu, imphohloze onokhahlo.
72.5: Bayakwesaba wena, kusekhona ilanga nenyanga, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
72.6: Iyakwehla njengemvula edlelweni, njengesihlambi esimatisa umhlaba.
72.7: Ezinsukwini zayo olungileyo uyakuqhakaza, kuvame ukuthula, ize ingabikho inyanga.
72.8: Iyakubusa kusukela elwandle kuze kube selwandle, kusukela emfuleni kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba.
72.9: Abakhe ehlane bayakukhothama phambi kwayo; izitha zayo zizakukhotha uthuli.
72.10: Amakhosi aseTharishishi naweseziqhingini ayakuletha izipho; amakhosi aseSheba naseSeba ayakwethula izipho.
72.11: Onke amakhosi ayakuziwisa phambi kwayo; zonke izizwe ziyakuyikhonza.
72.12: Ngokuba iyakukhulula ompofu ozikhalela kuyo, nohluphekayo ongenamsizi.
72.13: Iyakuhawukela odangeleyo nompofu; iyakusindisa imiphefumulo yabampofu.
72.14: Iyakukhulula umphefumulo wabo okhahlweni nasendluzuleni; igazi labo liyakuba yigugu emehlweni ayo.
72.15: Iyakuphila, bayinike igolide laseSheba, bayithandazele njalo, bayibusise lonke usuku.
72.16: Kuyakuba khona inala kakolweni ezweni esiqongweni sezintaba; ukudla kwalo kuyakuhashazela njengeLebanoni; abemizi bayakukhahlela njengotshani bomhlaba.
72.17: Igama layo liyakuma kuze kube phakade; igama layo liyakuxhanta, lisekhona ilanga; bayakuzibusisa ngayo; bonke abezizwe bayakuthi ibusisiwe.
72.18: Makabongwe uJehova uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, onguye yedwa owenza izimangaliso.
72.19: Malibongwe igama lakhe lenkazimulo kuze kube phakade, umhlaba wonke ugcwale inkazimulo yakhe. Amen, Amen.

73.1: Impela uNkulunkulu umnene ku-Israyeli, kubo abanenhliziyo ehlanzekileyo.
73.2: Kepha mina, izinyawo zami zicishe zakhubeka; kwaba kancane ukuba izinyathelo zami zishelele.
73.3: Ngokuba ngaba nomhawu ngabazidlayo, lapho ngibona ukubusa kwababi.
73.4: Ngokuba abanabuhlungu kuze kube sekufeni kwabo, namandla abo aqinile.
73.5: Abahlupheki njengabanye abantu; abahlushwa njengabanye abantu.
73.6: Ngakho-ke iqholo lingumnaka wabo; indluzula ibembesa njengengubo.
73.7: Amehlo abo aphinqekile ngokunona; imicabango yenhliziyo iyachichima.
73.8: Bayaklolodela; ebubini bakhuluma ngokukhahla; bakhuluma besekuphakamemi.
73.9: Umlomo wabo bawuphakamisela ezulwini; ulimi lwabo luhambela emhlabeni.
73.10: Ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sibuyela lapha; amanzi amaningi bazimuncela wona.
73.11: Bathi: “UNkulunkulu wazi kanjani na? Imbala kukhona ukwazi koPhezukonke na?”
73.12: Bheka, laba bayibo ababi; bazinza njalo; bandisa imfuyo.
73.13: Impela ngiyihlanzele ize inhliziyo yami, ngahlamba izandla zami ngingenacala,
73.14: ngokuba ngahlushwa usuku lonke; kwasa ngijeziswa.
73.15: Uma bengithe, ngizakukhuluma kanjalo, bheka, ngabe ngisikhohlisile isizukulwane sabantwana bakho.
73.16: Kwathi ngicabanga ukuba ngikuqonde lokho, kwaba luhlupho emehlweni ami,
73.17: ngaze ngangena endlini engcwele kaNkulunkulu, ngaqaphelisisa ukugcina kwabo.
73.18: Impela ubabeka ezindaweni ezibushelezi; ubawisa babe yincithakalo.
73.19: Maye, bachithwa ngokuphazima kweso! Bashona, babhubha benovalo.
73.20: Njengephupho ekuphaphameni, Nkosi, uyakudelela umfanekiso wabo ekuvukeni kwakho.
73.21: Kwathi inhliziyo yami yaba nomunyu, kuhlaba ezinsweni zami,
73.22: ngaba yisiphukuphuku, angaqonda lutho; ngaba yisilwane kuwe.
73.23: Kepha mina ngiyakube ngikuwe njalo; ungibambile ngesandla sami sokunene.
73.24: Uyakungihola ngesiluleko sakho, andukuba ungamukele enkazimulweni.
73.25: Nginobani ezulwini na? Uma nginawe, angifuni lutho emhlabeni.
73.26: Inyama yami nenhliziyo yami iyaphela; nokho uNkulunkulu uyidwala lenhliziyo yami nesabelo sami kuze kube phakade.
73.27: Ngokuba bheka, abakude nawe bayakubhubha; uyabachitha bonke abahlubukayo kuwe ngokuphinga.
73.28: Kepha mina kungilungele ukusondela kuNkulunkulu; ngenzile iNkosi uJehova ibe yisiphephelo sami, ukuze ngishumayele zonke izenzo zakho.

74.1: Nkulunkulu, usilahleleni kuze kube phakade na? Intukuthelo yakho ithunqelelani izimvu zedlelo lakho na?
74.2: Khumbula ibandla lakho owalizuza endulo, owalikhulula ukuba libe yisifunda sefa lakho, nentaba yaseSiyoni ohlala kuyo.
74.3: Lulamisela izinyawo zakho emidilikweni yaphakade; isitha sone konke endlini engcwele.
74.4: Izitha zakho zibhongile phakathi kwendlu yakho yokubuthana, zamisa izimpawu zazo zaba yizimpawu.
74.5: Zaba sengathi abantu baphakamisa amazembe emithini eminyeneyo.
74.6: Konke okubaziweyo kwayo sezikuphohloze ngembazo nangesando.
74.7: Zayokhela indlu yakho engcwele; indlu yegama lakho zayidumaza kwaze kwaba phansi emhlabathini.
74.8: Zathi enhliziyweni yazo: “Masibachithe kanyekanye,” zashisa zonke izindlu zokubuthana zikaNkulunkulu ezweni.
74.9: Izimpawu zethu asiziboni; akusekho mprofethi; akakho kithina owaziyo ukuthi koze kube nini.
74.10: Nkulunkulu, koze kube nini umcindezeli ethuka, isitha sihlambalaza igama lakho njalo, na?
74.11: Usihoshelani isandla sakho, isandla sakho sokunene, na? Sihoshe esifubeni sakho, uzichithe.
74.12: Nokho uNkulunkulu uyiNkosi yami kwaphakade eyenza insindiso emhlabeni.
74.13: Nguwena owahlukanisa ulwandle ngamandla akho, wachofoza amakhanda ezilo ezesabekayo emanzini.
74.14: Nguwena owaphohloza amakhanda kaLeviyathani,* wamnika abe ngukudla kwezidalwa zasehlane.
74.15: Nguwena owaqhamukisa isiphethu nomfudlana; nguwe owomisa imifula egobhoza njalo.
74.16: Usuku ngolwakho, nobusuku ngobakho; nguwena owenza ukukhanya nelanga.
74.17: Nguwena owamisa yonke imikhawulo yomhlaba; nguwe owenza ihlobo nobusika.
74.18: Khumbula lokhu, Jehova, ukuthi isitha sithukile, nesizwe esinobuwula silihlambalazile igama lakho.
74.19: Ungawunikeli umphefumulo wejuba lakho esilwaneni; ungakhohlwa ukuphila kwezihlupheki zakho njalo.
74.20: Khumbula isivumelwano, ngokuba izindawo ezimnyama zezwe zigcwele izindlu zobudlova.
74.21: Ocindezelweyo makangabuyi ejabhile; ohluphekayo nompofu mababonge igama lakho.
74.22: Vuka, Nkulunkulu, uyimele indaba yakho; khumbula ukuthi uklolodelwa yiziwula usuku lonke.
74.23: Ungakhohlwa izwi lezitha zakho, ukuxokozela kwabakuvukelayo okwenyukela njalonjalo.

75.1: Siyakubonga, Nkulunkulu, siyabonga; igama lakho liseduze; balanda izimangaliso zakho.
75.2: Lapho ngiyakugcina isikhathi esimisiweyo, ngiyakwahlulela ngokulunga.
75.3: Umhlaba uyancibilika nabo bonke abakhe kuwo; mina ngimisile izinsika zawo.
75.5: Ningaluphakamiseli phezulu uphondo lwenu, ningajoqi ngentamo elukhuni.”
75.6: Ngokuba ukuphakanyiswa akuveli empumalanga nasentshonalanga nasehlane lasezintabeni,
75.7: kepha uNkulunkulu ungumahluleli; omunye uyamehlisa, omunye amphakamise.
75.8: Ngokuba esandleni seNkosi kukhona isitsha; iwayini liyakhephuza; sigcwele ngeliqungiweyo, yona iyathulula ngaso; impela bonke ababi emhlabeni bayakuyimunca inhleze yalo, bayiphuze.
75.9: Kepha mina ngiyakumemezela ngakho kuze kube phakade, ngidumise uNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
75.10: Zonke izimpondo zababi ngiyakuzinquma; kepha izimpondo zolungileyo ziyakuphakanyiswa.

76.1: UNkulunkulu uyaziwa kwaJuda, igama lakhe likhulu kwa-Israyeli.
76.2: Itabernakele* lakhe liseSalema, nendlu yakhe iseSiyoni.
76.3: Waphula lapho imicibisholo yomnsalo, nesihlangu, nenkemba, nempi.
76.4: Uyakhazimula ngobukhosi, lapho uvela ezintabeni zempango.
76.5: Bachithekile abaqinile ngenhliziyo, balele ubuthongo babo; amaqhawe awafumanisanga izandla zawo.
76.6: Ngokusola kwakho, Nkulunkulu kaJakobe, kwehlelwa ngubuthongo inqola kanye nehhashi.
76.7: Wena, yebo, wena uyesabeka; ngubani ongema ebusweni bakho ngesikhathi solaka lwakho na?
76.8: Wezwakalisa ukwahlulela kuvela ezulwini; umhlaba wesaba, wathula
76.9: mhla evuka uNkulunkulu ukuba ahlulele, asindise bonke abathobekileyo bomhlaba.
76.10: Ngokuba ulaka lomuntu luyakukudumisa; insalelo yolaka uyakuyibhinca.
76.11: Thembisani, nigcwalise izithembiso kuJehova uNkulunkulu wenu. Bonke abamzungezileyo mabalethe izipho kuye owEsabekayo.
76.12: Uyanquma umoya wezikhulu, wesabeka kuwo amakhosi omhlaba.

77.1: Izwi lami ngiyakuliphakamisela kuNkulunkulu, ngikhale kuNkulunkulu ukuba angibekele indlebe.
77.2: Osukwini losizi lwami ngiyayifuna iNkosi; ebusuku isandla sami seluliwe, asidangali; umphefumulo wami wala ukududuzwa.
77.3: Ngiyamkhumbula uNkulunkulu ngibubula; ngiyazindla, umoya wami uyaphela amandla.
77.4: Uzibambile izinkophe zamehlo ami, angavaleki; ngikhathazekile, angisakwazi ukukhuluma.
77.6: Ebusuku ngiyakhumbula ukubetha kwami ugubhu, ngizindla enhliziyweni yami; nomoya wami uyahlolisisa.
77.7: INkosi iyakulahla kuze kube phakade na? Ayisenakuphinda ibe nomusa na?
77.8: Umusa wayo unqamukile njalo yini na? Isithembiso siphelile yini ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane na?
77.9: UNkulunkulu ukhohliwe ukuba abe nomusa na? Uvalele ububele bakhe ngolaka na?
77.10: Ngase ngithi: “Yilokhu ukuhlupheka kwami, ngokuba isandla sokunene soPhezukonke siphendukile.”
77.11: Ngiyakukhumbula izenzo zikaJehova, yebo, ngikhumbule izimangaliso zasendulo,
77.12: ngicabange ngawo wonke umsebenzi wakho, ngizindle ngezenzo zakho.
77.13: Indlela yakho, Nkulunkulu, isebungcweleni; ngubani ongunkulunkulu omkhulu njengoNkulunkulu na?
77.14: Wena unguNkulunkulu owenza izimangaliso; amandla akho uwazisile ezizweni.
77.15: Ngengalo yamandla wasindisa abantu bakho, amadodana kaJakobe noJosefa.
77.16: Amanzi akubona, Nkulunkulu, amanzi akubona, athuthumela, nezintwa zazamazama.
77.17: Amafu athela amanzi, izulu laduma, imicibisholo yakho yaphuma.
77.18: Izwi lokuduma kwakho lalisesivunguvungwini; imibani yakhanyisa izwe; umhlaba wadikizela, wazamazama.
77.19: Indlela yakho yayiselwandle, nomendo wakho wawusemanzini amaningi, kodwa izinyathelo zakho zazingaziwa.
77.20: Wahola abantu bakho njengezimvu ngesandla sikaMose no-Aroni.

78.1: Zwanini, bantu bami, umthetho wami, nibeke izindlebe zenu emazwini omlomo wami.
78.2: Ngizakuvula umlomo wami ngomfanekiso, ngibonakalise izimfihlakalo zasendulo.
78.4: asinakukufihla kubantwana babo, izindumiso zikaJehova zisitshele kuso isizukulwane esizayo, namandla akhe nezimangaliso zakhe azenzileyo.
78.5: Ngokuba wamisa ubufakazi kwaJakobe, wabeka umthetho kwa-Israyeli, ayala ngawo obaba ukuba bafundise abantwana babo,
78.6: ukuze isizukulwane esilandelayo sazi, abantwana abayakuzalwa, bavuke, batshele abantwana babo,
78.7: babeke ithemba labo kuNkulunkulu, bangakhohlwa imisebenzi kaNkulunkulu, kepha bagcine imiyalo yakhe.
78.8: Bangabi njengawoyise, isizukulwane esiphambeneyo nesihlubukayo, isizukulwane esingaqinisanga inhliziyo yaso, nesimoya waso wawungathembekile kuNkulunkulu.
78.9: Abantu bakwa-Efrayimi, sebehlomile bephethe iminsalo, babuyela emuva ngosuku lokulwa.
78.10: Abasigcinanga isivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu, benqaba ukuhamba emthethweni wakhe,
78.11: bakhohlwa imisebenzi yakhe nezimangaliso zakhe abebabonisile zona.
78.12: Wazenza izimangaliso emehlweni awoyise ezweni laseGibithe endaweni yaseSowani.
78.13: Wahlukanisa ulwandle, wabawelisa; wamisa amanzi njengodonga.
78.14: Wabahola ngefu emini, nobusuku bonke ngokukhanya komlilo.
78.15: Waqhekeza amadwala ehlane, wabaphuzisa njengasotweni olujulileyo.
78.16: Waphumisa edwaleni izifufula, wehlisa amanzi njengemifula.
78.17: Nokho baqhubeka benza ukona kuye, baphambana noPhezukonke ehlane.
78.18: Bamlinga uNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yabo ngokucela ukudla abakufisayo.
78.19: Bakhuluma kabi ngoNkulunkulu, bathi: “UNkulunkulu angalungisa isithebe ehlane na?
78.20: Bhekani, washaya idwala, kwaphuma amanzi, nemifula yampompoza; kepha angabanika nesinkwa, alungisele abantu bakhe inyama, na?”
78.21: Ngalokho uJehova ekuzwa lokho wathukuthela, kwavutha umlilo ngoJakobe, ulaka lwavuka ngo-Israyeli;
78.22: ngokuba abakholwanga nguNkulunkulu, abathembanga ensindisweni yakhe.
78.23: Nokho wayala amafu phezulu, wavula iminyango yezulu,
78.24: wanisa phezu kwabo imana* kube ngukudla, wabapha amabele ezulu;
78.25: abantu badla isinkwa sezingelosi, bathunyelwa ukudla ngokugcweleyo.
78.26: Waphumisa umoya wasempumalanga ezulwini; ngamandla akhe waqhuba umoya waseningizimu.
78.27: Wawisa phezu kwabo inyama njengothuli, nezinyoni ezinamaphiko njengesihlabathi solwandle.
78.28: Wakwehlisa phakathi kwekamu* labo naphakathi kwezindlu zabo.
78.30: Bebengakahlukani nokufisa kwabo, ukudla kwabo kusesemlonyeni wabo,
78.31: intukuthelo kaNkulunkulu yabavukela, wabulala abakhulupheleyo babo, wawisa phansi izinsizwa zakwa-Israyeli.
78.32: Nokho bona njalo, abakholwanga yizimangaliso zakhe.
78.33: Ngakho waqedela izinsuku zabo ezeni neminyaka yabo ovalweni.
78.34: Lapho ebabulala, bamfuna; babuye bamfunisisa uNkulunkulu.
78.35: Base bekhumbula ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyidwala labo; uNkulunkulu oPhezukonke ungumkhululi wabo.
78.36: Kepha bamthopha ngomlomo wabo, baqamba amanga kuye ngolimi lwabo;
78.37: ngokuba inhliziyo yabo yayingabambeleli kuye, bengathembekile esivumelwaneni sakhe.
78.38: Kepha yena enesihawu wathethelela ububi babo, akabhubhisanga; yebo, wabamba kaningi intukuthelo yakhe, akavusanga lonke ulaka lwakhe.
78.39: Wakhumbula ukuthi bayinyama, bangumoya odlulayo ongabuyiyo.
78.40: Kwaba kaningi kangakanani bephambana naye ehlane, bemdabukisa kwahlongasibi.
78.41: Babuye bamlinga uNkulunkulu, bamdabukisa oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
78.42: Abakhumbulanga isandla sakhe nosuku abahlenga ngalo ezitheni,
78.43: lapho ezenza izibonakaliso zakhe eGibithe nezimangaliso zakhe endaweni yaseSowani.
78.44: Waphendula lapho imifula yabo nemifudlana yabo yaba yigazi, ukuze bangabi nakuphuza.
78.45: Wathumela phakathi kwabo izibawu ezabadlayo namasele ababhubhisayo.
78.46: Wanika imiswenya ukudla kwabo, nomsebenzi wabo isikhonyane.
78.47: Wabulala imivini yabo ngesichotho, nemikhiwane yabo ngesangquma.
78.48: Wanikela izinkomo zabo esichothweni nezimvu zabo kuyo imibani.
78.49: Waphonsa kubo ukuvutha kwentukuthelo yakhe, nolaka, nokufutheka, nokuhlupheka, ngokuthuma izithunywa zobubi.
78.50: Walungisela intukuthelo yakhe indlela; akaphephisanga umphefumulo wabo ekufeni, kepha wanikela ukuphila kwabo ezifweni.
78.51: Washaya amazibulo onke aseGibithe, okokuqala kwamandla abo ematendeni kaHamu.
78.52: Kepha waphumisa abantu bakhe njengezimvu; wabahola ehlane njengomhlambi.
78.53: Wabahola kahle, abaze besaba; kepha ulwandle lwasibekela izitha zabo.
78.54: Wabayisa emnceleni wakhe ongcwele, entabeni esasiyizuzile isandla sakhe sokunene.
78.55: Waxosha abezizwe phambi kwabo; edabula izwe wababela ifa, wahlalisa izizwe zakwa-Israyeli ematendeni azo.
78.56: Nokho bamlinga, baphambana noNkulunkulu oPhezukonke, abaze bagcina imiyalo yakhe.
78.57: Bahoshekela emuva, bakhohlisa njengawoyise, baphenduka njengomnsalo ogejayo.
78.58: Bamthukuthelisa ngezindawo zabo eziphakemeyo, bamcunula ngezithombe zabo.
78.59: UNkulunkulu ekuzwa lokho wathukuthela, wamlahla impela u-Israyeli.
78.60: Walishiya itabernakele* laseShilo, itende abelimisile phakathi kwabantu.
78.61: Wanikela amandla akhe ekuthunjweni, nenkazimulo yakhe esandleni sesitha.
78.62: Wanikela abantu bakhe enkembeni, wathukuthelela ifa lakhe.
78.63: Izinsizwa zabo zadliwa ngumlilo; izintombi zabo azihutshelwanga.
78.64: Abapristi babo bawa ngenkemba; abafelokazi babo abaze balila.
78.65: Yayisivuka iNkosi njengokade elele, njengesiqhwaga esikade sahlulwa yiwayini,
78.66: yazishayela emuva izitha zayo, yazithela ngehlazo eliphakade.
78.67: Yalahla indlu kaJosefa, ayikhethanga isizwe sakwa-Efrayimi.
78.68: Kepha yakhetha isizwe sakwaJuda, intaba yaseSiyoni eyithandayo.
78.69: Yayakha indlu yayo engcwele njengezintaba nanjengomhlaba ewusekeleyo kuze kube phakade.
78.70: Yakhetha uDavide inceku yayo, yamthabatha ezibayeni zezimvu.
78.71: Esalandele izimvukazi ezenyisayo, yamthabatha ukuba abeluse abantu bayo uJakobe, nefa layo u-Israyeli.
78.72: Njalo wabelusa ngobuqotho benhliziyo yakhe, wabahola ngenhlakanipho yesandla sakhe.

79.1: Nkulunkulu, abezizwe bangenile efeni lakho; bangcolisile ithempeli lakho elingcwele; benze iJerusalema libe yincithakalo.
79.2: Bazinikile izidumbu zezinceku zakho zibe ngukudla kwezinyoni zezulu, inyama yabakwesabayo kuzo izilo zomhlaba.
79.3: Bachithile igazi labo njengamanzi nxazonke zeJerusalema, akwababikho obembelayo.
79.4: Sesiyisihlamba kubakhelwane bethu, umbhinqo nenhlekiso kwabasiphahlileyo.
79.5: Koze kube nini, Jehova, uthukuthele njalo, ukushisekela kwakho kuvutha njengomlilo, na?
79.6: Thela ulaka lwakho phezu kwabezizwe abangakwaziyo naphezu kwemibuso engakhulekeli igama lakho.
79.7: Ngokuba sebemdlile uJakobe, umuzi wakhe sebewuchithile.
79.8: Mawungasibaleli amacala akuqala; umusa wakho mawusheshe usihlangabeze, ngokuba sesibuthakathaka kakhulu.
79.9: Sisize, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, ngenxa yenkazimulo yegama lakho; usikhulule, usithethelele izono zethu ngenxa yegama lakho.
79.10: Bangasholoni abezizwe ukuthi: “Uphi uNkulunkulu wabo na?” Makwazeke kwabezizwe emehlweni ethu ukuphindiselwa kwegazi lezinceku zakho elichithiweyo.
79.11: Ukububula kwesiboshwa makuze phambi kwakho; londoloza ngobukhulu bengalo yakho asebengabantwana bokufa.
79.12: Buyisela kubakhelwane bethu, kuphindwe kasikhombisa esifubeni sabo inhlamba abakuhlambalaza ngayo, Nkosi.
79.13: Khona thina bantu bakho, izimvu zedlelo lakho, siyakukubonga kuze kube phakade, sishumayele udumo lwakho ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.

80.1: Yizwa, malusi ka-Israyeli, ohola uJosefa njengomhlambi, ohlezi phezu kwamakherubi;* mawubonakale ngokukhazimula.
80.2: Vusa amandla akho phambi kuka-Efrayimi noBenjamini noManase, uze ukusisindisa.
80.3: Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu, ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.
80.4: Jehova Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, koze kube nini uthunqela ngolaka umkhuleko wabantu bakho na?
80.5: Wabapha isinkwa sezinyembezi, wabaphuzisa izinyembezi ngesilinganiso esikhulu.
80.6: Usenza sibe yinto ebangwa ngabakhelwane bethu, nezitha zethu zisihleka usulu.
80.7: Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.
80.8: Wakhipha umvini eGibithe, waxosha abezizwe, watshala wona.
80.9: Wawulungisela indawo phambi kwawo, wagxila, wagcwalisa umhlaba.
80.10: Izintaba zambozwa ngumthunzi wawo, nemisedari* kaNkulunkulu ngamagatsha awo.
80.11: Wenabisa amagatsha awo, aze afika elwandle, namaxhantela awo, aze afika emfuleni.
80.12: Uzidilizeleni izintango zawo, baze bawukhe bonke abadlula ngendlela, na?
80.13: Ingulube yasehlathini iyawudla, nezilwane zasendle ziyawuqothula.
80.14: Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, mawubuye; bheka usezulwini, ubone, unakekele lo mvini,
80.15: yebo, lo mvini otshalwe ngesokunene sakho, nendodana ozikhulisele yona.
80.16: Ushiswe ngumlilo, unqunyiwe; bayakubhubha ngokukhuza kobuso bakho.
80.17: Isandla sakho masibe phezu kwendoda yesokunene sakho, phezu kwendodana yomuntu ozikhulisele yona;
80.18: khona asisayikuhoshekela emuva kuwe; siphilise, khona siyakukhuleka egameni lakho.
80.19: Sibuyise, Jehova Nkulunkulu Sebawoti; ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.

81.1: Halalisani uNkulunkulu amandla ethu, nimemeze ngokujabula kuNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
81.2: Hlabani ihubo, nithathe isigubhu nehabhu* elihle nogubhu.
81.3: Bethani icilongo ekwethwaseni kwenyanga nasekuhlanganeni kwenyanga ngosuku lomkhosi wethu.
81.4: Ngokuba kuyisimiso kwa-Israyeli nomthetho kaNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
81.5: Kungubufakazi abumisayo kwaJosefa mhla ephuma ezweni laseGibithe. Ngizwa ulimi ebengingalwazi luthi:
81.6: “Ngasusa ihlombe lakhe emthwalweni, izandla zakhe zakhululeka eqomeni lokuthwala.
81.7: Wakhuleka usosizini, ngakukhulula; ngakuphendula ngisekusithekeni kokuduma, ngakuvivinya ngasemanzini aseMeriba.
81.8: “Zwanini, bantu bami, ngizakufakaza kini ukuthi: O Israyeli, sengathi ungangilalela!
81.9: Makungabikho kuwe unkulunkulu omunye, ungakhuleki kunkulunkulu wabezizwe.
81.10: Mina nginguJehova uNkulunkulu wakho owakukhuphula ezweni laseGibithe; khamisa umlomo wakho, ngiwugcwalise.
81.11: “Kepha abantu bami abalalelanga izwi lami, u-Israyeli akanginakanga.
81.12: Ngase ngibayeka enkanini yenhliziyo yabo ukuba bahambe ngokuthanda kwabo.
81.13: “Sengathi abantu bami bangangizwa, u-Israyeli ahambe ezindleleni zami.
81.14: Bengiyakuthobisa masinyane izitha zabo, ngiselulele isandla sami kwabamelene nabo.
81.15: Abazondi bakaJehova bebeyakuzithobela kuye, kepha isikhathi sabantu bami besiyakuba khona kuze kube phakade.
81.16: Ubeyakubapha ukolweni omuhle; yebo, bengiyakubasuthisa ngezinyosi zasesiweni.”

82.1: UNkulunkulu umi emhlanganweni wawonkulunkulu; uyahlulela phakathi kwawonkulunkulu.
82.2: Koze kube nini nahlulela ngokungalungile nikhetha ubuso bababi na?
82.3: Yahlulelani ompofu nentandane, nimenzele okufaneleyo olusizi noswelayo.
82.4: Khululani oswelayo nompofu, nibophule esandleni sababi.
82.5: Abanakwazi, abanakuqonda, bahamba ebumnyameni; izisekelo zonke zomhlaba ziyazamazama.
82.6: Mina ngathi: “Ningonkulunkulu nina,” nonke ningamadodana oPhezukonke.
82.7: Kanti nokho niyakufa njengabantu nje, niwe njengesinye sezikhulu.
82.8: Vuka, Nkulunkulu, wahlulele umhlaba, ngokuba wena uyindlalifa yezizwe zonke.

83.1: Nkulunkulu, ungathuli, ungalibali, ungali ukukhuluma, Nkulunkulu.
83.2: Ngokuba bheka, izitha zakho ziyaxokozela, nabakuzondayo baphakamisa ikhanda.
83.3: Ngobuqili benza uzungu ngabantu bakho, bacebisana ukulwa nabathukusiweyo bakho.
83.4: Bathi: “Wozani sibaqothule, bangabe besaba yisizwe, negama lika-Israyeli lingabe lisakhunjulwa.”
83.7: noGebali, no-Amoni, no-Amaleki, neFilistiya nabakhile eTire.
83.8: Ne-Asiriya lahlangana nabo, laba yingalo yabantwana bakaLoti.
83.9: Yenza kubo njengakuMidiyani, nakuSisera, nakuJabini ngasemfuleni iKishoni,
83.10: ababhubhela e-Eni Dori, baba ngumquba womhlabathi.
83.11: Amakhosana abo wenze abe njengo-Orebi noZebi, nabakhulu babo bonke njengoZeba noSalimuna
83.13: Nkulunkulu wami, benze babe njengezibi ezikhwishizayo, njengamakhoba amuka nomoya.
83.14: Njengomlilo oshisa ihlathi, njengelangabi elithungela izintaba,
83.15: baxoshe kanjalo ngesivunguvungu sakho, ubethuse ngesiphepho sakho.
83.16: Thela ubuso babo ngehlazo, baze bafune igama lakho, Jehova.
83.17: Mabahlazeke, baphele amandla kuze kube phakade; mabahluleke, babhubhe,
83.18: bazi ukuthi nguwe wedwa ogama lakho linguJehova; ungoPhezukonke emhlabeni wonke.

84.1: Zithandeka kangaka izindlu zakho, Jehova Sebawoti.
84.2: Umphefumulo wami ulangazelela, womela amagceke kaJehova; inhliziyo yami nomzimba wami kuyahuba ngokwethaba kuNkulunkulu ophilayo.
84.3: Ngokuba umzwilili ufumene indlu, nenkonjane isidleke sayo, lapho ibeka khona amazinyane ayo, ngisho ama-altare akho, Jehova Sebawoti, Nkosi yami, Nkulunkulu wami.
84.4: Babusisiwe abahlala endlini yakho; bayakuhlala bebonga wena.
84.5: Ubusisiwe umuntu omandla akhe akuwe, abazindlela zakho zisezinhliziyweni zabo.
84.6: Bedabula imfunda yezinyembezi bayenza ibe yindawo yeziphethu; yebo, nemvula yokuqala iyayisibekela ngezibusiso.
84.7: Baqhubeka emandleni, baze babonakale phambi kukaNkulunkulu eSiyoni.
84.8: Jehova Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe, Nkulunkulu kaJakobe.
84.9: Wena Nkulunkulu, siHlangu sethu, bheka, ubuke ubuso bogcotshiweyo wakho.
84.10: Ngokuba usuku lunye emagcekeni akho luhle kunezinye eziyizinkulungwane. Ngiyakhetha ukulinda emnyango wendlu kaNkulunkulu wami kunokuhlala ematendeni ababi.
84.11: Ngokuba uJehova uNkulunkulu uyilanga nesihlangu; uJehova uyakupha umusa nodumo; akayikubenqabela okuhle abahamba ngobuqotho.

85.1: Jehova, wabusisa izwe lakho, wambuyisa uJakobe ekuthunjweni.
85.2: Wasusa icala labantu bakho, wasibekela zonke izono zabo.
85.3: Wamukisa yonke intukuthelo yakho, waphenduka ekuvutheni kolaka lwakho.
85.4: Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, ulahle ukusicanukela kwakho.
85.5: Uyakusithukuthelela njalonjalo na? Uyakwelulela ulaka lwakho ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane na?
85.6: Awuzukusivusa, sibuye siphile, ukuze abantu bakho bathokoze ngawe, na?
85.7: Sitshengise umusa wakho, Jehova, usiphe insindiso yakho.
85.8: Mangizwe lokho uNkulunkulu uJehova azakukukhuluma; uyakhuluma ukuthula kubantu bakhe nakubo abamesabayo; mabangabuyeli ebuwuleni.
85.9: Impela insindiso yakhe iseduze nabamesabayo, ukuze kuhlale udumo ezweni lethu.
85.10: Kuyakuhlangabezana umusa neqiniso, kwangane ukulunga nokuthula.
85.11: Kuyakuhluma iqiniso emhlabeni, kulunguzele phansi nokulunga kwasezulwini.
85.12: Yebo, uJehova uyakuveza okuhle; izwe lethu liyakuthela izithelo zalo.
85.13: Ukulunga kuyakuhamba phambi kwakhe, kwenzele izinyawo zakhe indlela.

86.1: Beka indlebe yakho, Jehova, ungiphendule, ngokuba ngilusizi, ngimpofu.
86.2: Londoloza umphefumulo wami, ngokuba ngingoqotho; wena Nkulunkulu wami, sindisa inceku yakho ekwethembayo.
86.3: Yiba nomusa kimi, Nkosi, ngokuba ngikhala kuwe usuku lonke.
86.4: Thokozisa umphefumulo wenceku yakho, ngokuba kuwena, Nkosi, ngiyawuphakamisela umphefumulo wami.
86.5: Ngokuba wena, Nkosi, umuhle, ungothethelelayo, unomusa omkhulu kubo bonke abakhala kuwe.
86.6: Jehova, beka indlebe ekukhulekeni kwami, ulalele izwi lokunxusa kwami.
86.7: Ngosuku losizi lwami ngikhala kuwe, ngokuba uzakungiphendula.
86.8: Phakathi kwawonkulunkulu akakho onjengawe Nkosi; akukho okunjengemisebenzi yakho.
86.9: Izizwe ozenzileyo ziyakufika zonke, zikhuleke phambi kwakho, Nkosi, zidumise igama lakho.
86.10: Ngokuba umkhulu wena, uyenza izimangaliso, unguNkulunkulu wena wedwa.
86.11: Ngifundise, Jehova, indlela yakho; ngiyakuhamba eqinisweni lakho; yenza inhliziyo yami iqonde ntonye, yesabe igama lakho.
86.12: Ngiyakukubonga, Nkosi Nkulunkulu wami, ngenhliziyo yonke yami, ngidumise igama lakho kuze kube phakade.
86.13: Ngokuba umusa wakho mkhulu phezu kwami, ukhululile umphefumulo wami endaweni yabafileyo ephansi.
86.14: Nkulunkulu, izideleli zingivukele, ibandla lezidlwangudlwangu lifuna umphefumulo wami; azibekanga wena phambi kwazo.
86.15: Kepha wena Nkosi unguNkulunkulu ohawukelayo, onomusa nokubekezela, uvame ubumnene nokuthembeka.
86.16: Phendukela kimi, ube nomusa kimi, uyiphe inceku yakho amandla akho, usindise indodana yencekukazi yakho.
86.17: Ngenzele isiboniselo sokuhle, ukuze abangizondayo babone, bajabhe, ngokuba wena Jehova uyangisiza, uyangiduduza.

87.2: UJehova uyawathanda amasango aseSiyoni kunazo zonke izindlu zikaJakobe.
87.4: Ngiyakubala uRahabi neBabele kulabo abangaziyo; yebo, iFilistiya neThire kanye neKushe azalelwa khona.
87.5: Kuyakuthiwa ngeSiyoni: “Yilo nalo wazalelwa khona; oPhezukonke uyaliqinisa.”
87.6: Mhla uJehova eloba izizwe uyakubala ukuthi lo wazalelwa khona.
87.7: Abahubayo nabasinayo bathi: “Imithombo yami yonke ikuwe.”

88.1: Jehova Nkulunkulu wensindiso yami, ngikhala imini nobusuku phambi kwakho.
88.2: Umkhuleko wami mawufike ebusweni bakho, indlebe yakho uyibeke ekunxuseni kwami.
88.3: Ngokuba umphefumulo wami ugcwele izinsizi, ukuphila kwami kusondele endaweni yabafileyo.
88.4: Ngibalwa kanye nabashona emgodini, nginjengomuntu ofileyo.
88.5: Icansi lami liphakathi kwabafileyo; nginjengababuleweyo abalele ethuneni, ongasabakhumbuli, benqunyiwe esandleni sakho.
88.6: Ungibekile emgodini ojulile kunayo yonke, ebumnyameni, otweni.
88.7: Kuyangisinda ukuthukuthela kwakho; amadlambi akho onke ayangicindezela phansi.
88.8: Engikade ngazana nabo ubaxoshele kude, wangenza ngibe yisinengiso kubo; ngivalelwe, ngingephume.
88.9: Iso lami liyafa ngosizi; ngikhala kuwe Jehova imihla yonke, ngizelulela izandla zami kuwe.
88.10: Abafileyo uyakubenzela isimangaliso na? Ziyakuvuka yini izithunzi, zikubonge, na?
88.11: Kuyalandiswa yini ethuneni ngomusa wakho, nangokuthembeka kwakho endaweni yokubhujiswa na?
88.12: Izimangaliso zakho ziyaziwa yini ebumnyameni, nokulunga kwakho ezweni lokukhohlwa na?
88.13: Kepha mina, Jehova, ngikhala kuwe; ekuseni umkhuleko wami uyenyuka phambi kwakho.
88.14: Jehova, ulahlelani umphefumulo wami, ungifihlelelani ubuso bakho na?
88.15: Ngihluphekile, ngingofayo kusukela ebusheni bami; ngithwele ukwesabeka kwakho, ngiphelile.
88.16: Ulaka lwakho olushisayo lungehlele; ukwesabisa kwakho kungiqedile.
88.17: Kungizungeza njengamanzi imihla yonke, kungikaka kanyekanye.
88.18: Isihlobo nomngane ubaxoshele kude; ubumnyama bungumhlobo wami.

89.1: Ngiyakuhlabelela ngomusa kaJehova kuze kube phakade, ngomlomo wami ngazise izizukulwane ngezizukulwane ukuthembeka kwakho.
89.2: Ngokuba ngithe: “Umusa uyakwakhiwa kuze kube phakade; ezulwini uyaqinisa ukuthembeka kwakho.”
89.3: Ngenzile isivumelwano nokhethiweyo wami, ngifungile kuye uDavide inceku yami ukuthi:
89.4: “Ngiyakuqinisa inzalo yakho kuze kube phakade, ngisakhe isihlalo sobukhosi ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.”
89.5: Izimangaliso zakho, Jehova, ziyadunyiswa ngamazulu, ukuthembeka kwakho ebandleni labangcwele.
89.6: Ngokuba ngubani osemafwini ongalinganiswa noJehova na? Ngubani phakathi kwamadodana kaNkulunkulu ongafaniswa noJehova na?
89.7: UNkulunkulu uyesabeka kakhulu emhlanganweni wabangcwele; umelwe ukuhlonishwa yibo bonke abangakuye.
89.8: Jehova Nkulunkulu Sebawoti, ngubani onjengawe na? Unamandla, Jehova, nokuthembeka kwakho kuyakuhaqa.
89.9: Wena uyabusa ukukhukhumala kolwandle; uma kuphakama amadlambi alo, uyawathulisa.
89.10: Wena uchobozile uRahabi njengobuleweyo; uhlakazile izitha zakho ngengalo yakho enamandla.
89.11: Ngelakho izulu, ngowakho umhlaba; izwe nokugcwala kwalo, kukho konke ubeke isisekelo.
89.12: Inyakatho neningizimu wakudala wena; iThabori neHermoni kuyajabula egameni lakho.
89.13: Ingalo yakho inobuqhawe, isandla sakho sinamandla, esokunene sakho siphakeme.
89.14: Ukulunga nokwahlulela kuyisisekelo sesihlalo sakho sobukhosi; umusa neqiniso kuyahamba phambi kobuso bakho.
89.15: Sibusisiwe isizwe esikwazi ukuhlabelela ngenjabulo; siyahamba, Jehova, ekukhanyeni kobuso bakho.
89.16: Egameni lakho siyathokoza usuku lonke; ngokulunga kwakho siyaphakanyiswa.
89.17: Ngokuba wena uyinkazimulo yamandla abo; ngomusa wakho uphondo lwethu luyaphakama.
89.18: Ngokuba isihlangu sethu singesikaJehova; inkosi yethu ingeyoNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
89.19: Ngaleso sikhathi wakhuluma ngombono kubo abakholwayo bakho, wathi: “Ngibekile usizo eqhaweni, ngiphakamisile okhethiwe phakathi kwabantu.
89.20: Ngifumene inceku yami uDavide, ngimgcobile ngamafutha ami angcwele.
89.21: Isandla sami siyakuba naye siqinile, ingalo yami iyakumqinisa.
89.23: Ngiyakuchoboza izitha zakhe ebusweni bakhe, ngihluphe abamzondayo.
89.24: Ukuthembeka kwami nomusa wami kuyakuba naye; egameni lami luyakuphakama uphondo lwakhe.
89.25: Ngiyakubeka isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, esokunene sakhe phezu kwemifula.
89.26: Uyakungibiza ngokuthi: ‘UnguBaba, unguNkulunkulu wami nedwala lensindiso yami.’
89.27: Ngiyakumenza abe yizibulo nophakamileyo kunamakhosi omhlaba.
89.28: Ngiyakumgcinela umusa wami kuze kube phakade; isivumelwano sami soba siqinile kuye.
89.29: Ngiyakwenza inzalo yakhe ime kuze kube phakade, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi sibe njengezinsuku zezulu.
89.30: “Uma abantwana bakhe beshiya umthetho wami bengahambi ngezahlulelo zami,
89.31: uma bephula izimiso zami bengagcini imiyalo yami,
89.32: ngiyakuhambela izono zabo ngenduku, namacala abo ngemivimbo.
89.33: Kepha umusa wami angiyikuwususa kuye, ngingaphikisi ukuthembeka kwami.
89.34: Angiyikwaphula isivumelwano sami, nokuphumileyo ezindebeni zami angiyikukuguqula.
89.35: Ngafunga kanye ubungcwele bami, angiyikuqamba amanga kuDavide.
89.36: Inzalo yakhe iyakuma phakade, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi sibe njengelanga phambi kwami.
89.37: Iyakuma phakade njengenyanga nanjengofakazi othembekileyo osemafwini.”
89.38: Kepha usumlahlile, wamala, wamthukuthelela ogcotshiweyo wakho.
89.39: Uchithile isivumelwano senceku yakho, wadumaza umqhele wayo, wawuphonsa emhlabathini.
89.40: Udilizile zonke izindonga zakhe, wazenza izinqaba zakhe zaba yincithakalo.
89.41: Bonke abadlula ngendlela bayamphanga; waba yihlazo kwabakhelene naye.
89.42: Uphakamisile esokunene sabamelene naye, wajabulisa zonke izitha zakhe.
89.43: Futhi ubuyisele emuva usiko lwenkemba yakhe, awumvumelanga ukuma ekulweni.
89.44: Ususile inkazimulo yakhe, wawisa phansi emhlabathini isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi.
89.45: Ufinyezile izinsuku zobusha bakhe, wamthela ngamahloni.
89.46: Koze kube nini uyakuzisitha, Jehova, nentukuthelo yakho ivutha njengomlilo, na?
89.47: Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi sami singakanani nokuthi wadalela ize bonke abantwana babantu.
89.48: Ngubani oyakuphila engayikubona ukufa, akhulule umphefumulo wakhe emandleni endawo yabafileyo, na?
89.49: Nkosi, uphi umusa wakho wakuqala owawufungela kuDavide ngokuthembeka kwakho na?
89.50: Khumbula, Nkosi, ihlazo lezinceku zakho nokuthi ngithwele esifubeni sami ihlazo lezizwe eziningi kakhulu,
89.51: ezisola ngalo izitha zakho, Jehova, ezisola ngalo ukuhamba kogcotshiweyo wakho.
89.52: Makabongwe uJehova kuze kube phakade. Amen, Amen.

90.1: Nkosi, wena uyisiphephelo sethu ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
90.2: Kungakaveli izintaba, ungakawenzi umhlaba nezwe, kuthi kusukela phakade kuze kube phakade wena Nkulunkulu ukhona.
90.3: Uyambuyisela umuntu othulini, uthi: “Buyani, bantwana babantu.”
90.4: Ngokuba iminyaka eyinkulungwane emehlweni akho injengezolo selidlulile, nanjengomlindo ebusuku.
90.5: Uyabamukisa njengesikhukhula, banjengobuthongo; ekuseni banjengotshani obuhlumayo;
90.6: ekuseni buyakhahlela, buhlume; kusihlwa bunqunywe, bubune.
90.7: Ngokuba siyaqedwa yintukuthelo yakho, nangolaka lwakho siyabhubha.
90.8: Ubekile amacala ethu phambi kwakho, izono zethu ezifihliweyo ekukhanyeni kobuso bakho.
90.9: Ngokuba izinsuku zethu ziyadlula ngentukuthelo yakho; siyafeza iminyaka yethu njengephefu.
90.10: Izinsuku zeminyaka yethu zineminyaka engamashumi ayisikhombisa; kuthi uma ziziningi, zineminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili; nokho ukuvama kwazo kungukuhlupheka nelize, ngokuba zidlula masinyane, thina siyandiza, simuke.
90.11: Ngubani owaziyo amandla entukuthelo yakho nolaka lwakho olunjengakho ukwesabeka kwakho na?
90.12: Sifundise, Nkosi, ukubala izinsuku zethu, sizuze inhliziyo enokuhlakanipha.
90.13: Buya, Jehova! Koze kube nini na? Hawukela izinceku zakho.
90.14: Sisuthise ngomusa wakho, kuse sekuseni, ukuze sithokoze, sijabule izinsuku zethu zonke.
90.15: Sithokozise ngangezinsuku owasihlupha ngazo, nangangeminyaka esabona okubi ngayo.
90.16: Izenzo zakho mazibonakale kuzo izinceku zakho, nenkazimulo yakho kubantwana bazo.
90.17: Yebo, ubuhle beNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu abube phezu kwethu, umise umsebenzi wezandla zethu phezu kwethu; yebo, umsebenzi wezandla zethu uwumise.

91.1: Yena owakhile ekusithekeni koPhezukonke nohlezi emthunzini kaSomandla
91.2: uthi kuJehova: “Uyisiphephelo sami nenqaba yami noNkulunkulu wami engimethembayo.”
91.3: Ngokuba yena uyakukhipha ogibeni lomcuphi nasobhadaneni olubhubhisayo.
91.4: Ngezimpaphe zakhe uyakukusibekela, uphephele phansi kwamaphiko akhe; ukuthembeka kwakhe kuyisihlangu nehawu.
91.5: Awuyikwesaba ivuso lasebusuku, nomcibisholo ondizayo emini,
91.6: nobhadane oluhamba ebumnyameni, nesifo esibhubhisayo emini enkulu.
91.7: Bayakuwa abayizinkulungwane ngaseceleni kwakho, nabayizinkulungwane eziyishumi ngakwesokunene sakho, kepha akuyikufinyelela kuwe.
91.8: Uyakubuka nje ngamehlo akho, ubone ukuphindiselwa kwababi,
91.9: ngokuba uthi: Jehova, uyisiphephelo sami; oPhezukonke umenzile abe yinqaba yakho.
91.10: Awuyikwehlelwa ngokubi, nesifo asiyikusondela etendeni lakho.
91.11: Ngokuba uyakuyaleza izingelosi zakhe ngawe, zikulondoloze ezindleleni zakho zonke.
91.12: Ziyakukuthwala ngezandla, ungaqhuzuki ngonyawo lwakho etsheni.
91.13: Uyakunyathela ingonyama nebululu, unyathele phansi ibhongo lengonyama nodrako.*
91.14: Ngenxa yokuba enamathele kimi, ngakho ngiyamkhulula; ngiyamphakamisa ngokuba elazi igama lami.
91.15: Uyakungibiza, ngimphendule; ngiyakuba naye esosizini, ngimkhulule, ngimdumise.
91.16: Ngiyakumsuthisa ngobude bezinsuku, ngimbonise insindiso yami.

92.1: Kuhle ukumbonga uJehova nokuhubela igama lakho wena oPhezukonke;
92.2: ukushumayela umusa wakho ekuseni nokuthembeka kwakho ebusuku,
92.3: ngokubetha ugubhu olunezintambo eziyishumi, nomqangala, kanye nehabhu* elizwakala kamnandi.
92.4: Ngokuba ungithokozisile, Jehova, ngezenzo zakho; ngiyakumemeza ngokujabula.
92.5: Yeka ubukhulu bezenzo zakho, Jehova. Imicabango yakho ijulile kakhulu.
92.7: Noma ababi behluma njengotshani, nezigangi noma ziqhakaza zonke, kuyenzeka ukuba babhujiswe kuze kube phakade.
92.8: Kepha wena Jehova uphakeme kuze kube phakade.
92.9: Ngokuba bheka, izitha zakho, Jehova, bheka, izitha zakho, ziyakubhubha; bonke abenza okubi bayakuhlakazwa.
92.10: Kepha uphondo lwami uyaluphakamisa njengolwenyathi, ngigcotshwa ngamafutha amasha.
92.11: Iso lami liyakubona ngokujabula izitha zami, nezindlebe zami ziyakuzwa ngokuthokoza ngababi abangivukelayo.
92.12: Olungileyo uyahluma njengesundu, uyakhula njengomsedari* eLebanoni.
92.13: Batshaliwe endlini kaJehova, bamila emagcekeni kaNkulunkulu wethu.
92.14: Nasebudaleni bayakuthela izithelo, bahlume babe luhlaza,
92.15: ukuze bashumayele ukuthi uJehova ulungile; uyidwala lami okungekho kuye ukungalungi.

93.1: UJehova uyinkosi, wembethe ubukhosi; uJehova wembethe, ubhince amandla. Nezwe limi liqinile, lingazanyazanyiswa.
93.2: Isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi simi siqinile kwasendulo; wena ukhona kwaphakade.
93.3: Imifula iphakamisile, Jehova, imifula iphakamisile ukuholoba kwayo; imifula iphakamisa ukuduma kwayo.
93.4: UJehova ophakeme unamandla kunokuholoba kwamanzi amaningi, kunokuduma kwamadlambi olwandle.
93.5: Ukufakaza kwakho kuqinisekile kakhulu. Ubungcwele buyifanele indlu yakho, Jehova, kuze kube phakade.

94.1: Nkulunkulu wempindiselo, Jehova, Nkulunkulu wempindiselo, vela ukhanye.
94.2: Phakama, Mahluleli womhlaba, uphindisele kwabazidlayo izenzo zabo.
94.3: Jehova, koze kube nini ababi, koze kube nini ababi bethaba na?
94.4: Bayampompoza, bakhuluma amagangangozi; bayazidla bonke abenza okubi.
94.5: Isizwe sakho, Jehova, bayasiphohloza, nefa lakho balinyathela phansi.
94.8: Qaphelani nina zithutha phakathi kwabantu; nani ziwula, niyakuqonda nini na?
94.9: Owenza indlebe kanakuzwa na? Owadala iso kanakubona na?
94.10: Othethisa abezizwe, yena ofundisa abantu ukwazi, kanakujezisa na?
94.11: UJehova uyayazi imicabango yabantu ukuba ingumoya nje.
94.12: Jehova, ubusisiwe lowo muntu omyalayo, omfundisayo ngomthetho wakho,
94.13: wenzela ukuba umphumuze ezinsukwini ezimbi, aze ambelwe umgodi lowo ongenamthetho.
94.14: Ngokuba uJehova akayikulahla abantu bakhe, nefa lakhe akayikulishiya.
94.15: Ngokuba ukulunga kuyakubuyela ekwahluleleni, bonke abaqotho ngenhliziyo bakulandele.
94.16: Ngubani oyakungimela phambi kwababi na? Ngubani oyakungelekelela kwabenza okubi na?
94.17: Uma uJehova ebengesilo usizo lwami, umphefumulo wami ubuyakushesha ukuhlala ekuthuleni kokufa.
94.18: Lapho ngithe unyawo lwami luyashelela, umusa wakho, Jehova, wangiphasa.
94.19: Kubo ubuninginingi bemicabango yenhliziyo yami ukududuza kwakho kwathokozisa umphefumulo wami.
94.20: Isihlalo sobubi singahlanganyela nawe yini, leso esisebenza okubi kungathi ngomthetho na?
94.21: Bahlangana ukuvukela umphefumulo wolungileyo; igazi elingenacala bayalilahla.
94.22: Kepha uJehova waba yinqaba yami, uNkulunkulu wami waba yiwa engiphephela kulo.
94.23: Uyaphindisela kubo ukushinga kwabo, abaqede ngobubi babo; uJehova uNkulunkulu wethu uyakubaqeda.

95.1: Wozani simhubele uJehova, sihlabelele ngenjabulo kulo idwala lensindiso yethu.
95.2: Masize phambi kobuso bakhe ngokubonga, sihlabelele kuye ngamahubo.
95.3: Ngokuba uJehova unguNkulunkulu omkhulu, uyinkosi enkulu phezu kwawonkulunkulu bonke.
95.4: Esandleni sakhe kukhona ukujula komhlaba; iziqongo zezintaba ngezakhe nazo.
95.5: Ulwandle ngolwakhe, walwenza; nomhlabathi owomileyo izandla zakhe zawubumba.
95.6: Wozani; masikhuleke, sikhothame, siguqe phambi kukaJehova, uMenzi wethu.
95.7: Ngokuba yena unguNkulunkulu wethu, thina singabantu bedlelo lakhe nezimvu zesandla sakhe. Namuhla, uma nilizwa izwi lakhe,
95.8: ningayenzi lukhuni inhliziyo yenu njengaseMeriba, njengasosukwini lwaseMasa ehlane,
95.9: lapho oyihlo bangilinga khona, bangivivinya, babona umsebenzi wami.
95.10: Iminyaka engamashumi amane nganengwa yileso sizukulwane, ngaze ngathi: “Bangabantu abanhliziyo zabo zidukile, abazazanga izindlela zami,”
95.11: engafunga ngabo olakeni lwami, ngathi: “Abasoze bangena ekuphumuleni kwami.”

96.1: Hlabelelani kuJehova ihubo elisha, nihlabelele kuJehova, mhlaba wonke.
96.2: Hlabelelani kuJehova, nibonge igama lakhe, nimemeze insindiso yakhe imihla ngemihla.
96.3: Landani inkazimulo yakhe phakathi kwabezizwe, izimangaliso zakhe phakathi kwabantu bonke.
96.4: Ngokuba mkhulu uJehova, udumisekile kakhulu; uyesabeka phezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
96.5: Ngokuba bonke onkulunkulu babezizwe bayizithombe, kepha uJehova walenza izulu.
96.6: Udumo nobukhosi kusebusweni bakhe; amandla nenkazimulo kusendlini yakhe engcwele.
96.7: Mnikeni uJehova nina mindeni yabantu, mnikeni uJehova inkazimulo namandla.
96.8: Mnikeni uJehova inkazimulo yegama lakhe, nilethe umnikelo, ningene emagcekeni akhe.
96.9: Khulekani kuJehova, nihlobe ubungcwele; thuthumela ebusweni bakhe, mhlaba wonke.
96.10: Thanini phakathi kwabezizwe: “UJehova uyinkosi,” izwe lihlala liqinile, lingenakushukunyiswa; uthetha amacala ezizwe ngobuqotho.
96.11: Malijabule izulu, umhlaba uthokoze; maluhlokome ulwandle nokugcwala kwalo.
96.12: Mawename amasimu nakho konke okukuwo, ijabule imithi yonke yehlathi
96.13: ebusweni bukaJehova, ngokuba uyeza, yebo, uyeza ukwahlulela umhlaba; uyakwahlulela izwe ngokulunga, nezizwe ngokuthembeka kwakhe.

97.1: UJehova uyinkosi; umhlaba mawethabe, zijabule iziqhingi eziningi.
97.2: Amafu nobumnyama kuyamphahla; ukulunga nokwahlulela kuyisisekelo sesihlalo sakhe sobukhosi.
97.3: Umlilo uyahamba phambi kwakhe, udla izitha zakhe nxazonke.
97.4: Imibani yakhe ikhanyisa izwe; umhlaba uyakubona, uthuthumele.
97.5: Izintaba zincibilika njengengcina phambi kukaJehova, phambi kweNkosi yomhlaba wonke.
97.6: Amazulu ashumayela ukulunga kwakhe; izizwe zonke zibona inkazimulo yakhe.
97.7: Mabajabhe bonke abakhonza izithombe ezibaziweyo, abazigabisa ngezithombe. Mkhonzeni nina nonke bonkulunkulu.
97.8: ISiyoni liyezwa, liyajabula; amadodakazi akwaJuda ayethaba ngenxa yezahlulelo zakho, Jehova.
97.9: Ngokuba wena Jehova uphezu komhlaba wonke, uphakeme kakhulu phezu kwawonkulunkulu bonke.
97.10: Nina enithanda uJehova zondani okubi; uyagcina imiphefumulo yabamkhonzayo; uyabasindisa ezandleni zababi.
97.11: Ukukhanya kuhlwanyelelwe olungileyo, ukujabula kuhlwanyelelwe abanhliziyo ziqotho.
97.12: Jabulani kuJehova nina balungileyo, nibonge igama lakhe elingcwele.

98.1: Mhubeleni uJehova igama elisha, ngokuba wenze izimangaliso; esokunene sakhe nengalo yakhe engcwele kumtholele ukunqoba.
98.2: UJehova wazisile insindiso yakhe; ukulunga kwakhe ukwambulile emehlweni abezizwe.
98.3: Ukhumbulile umusa wakhe nokuthembeka kwakhe kuyo indlu ka-Israyeli; imikhawulo yonke yomhlaba ibonile insindiso kaNkulunkulu wethu.
98.4: Hlokomani kuJehova ngezwi lokuhalalisa, nihlabelele ngenjabulo, nihube.
98.5: Mhubeleni uJehova ngehabhu,* ngehabhu nangezwi lehubo.
98.6: Ngamacilongo nangokukhala komtshingo hlokomani ngezwi lokuhalalisa phambi kweNkosi uJehova.
98.7: Maludume ulwandle nokugcwala kwalo, izwe nabakhileyo kulo.
98.8: Imifula mayishaye ihlombe, izintaba zihalalise kanyekanye
98.9: ebusweni bukaJehova, ngokuba uyeza ukwahlulela umhlaba. Uyakwahlulela izwe ngokulunga nezizwe ngobuqotho.

99.1: UJehova uyinkosi; mabathuthumele abantu; uhlezi phezu kwamakherubi;* mawuzamazame umhlaba.
99.2: UJehova mkhulu eSiyoni, uphakeme phezu kwezizwe zonke.
99.3: Mababonge igama lakho elikhulu nelesabekayo; ungcwele yena.
99.4: Amandla eNkosi athanda okulungileyo, umisile ubuqotho; ukwahlulela nokulunga ukwenzile kwaJakobe.
99.5: Mphakamiseni uJehova uNkulunkulu wethu, nikhuleke ngasesanabelweni sezinyawo zakhe; ungcwele yena.
99.6: OMose no-Aroni babe phakathi kwabapristi bakhe; uSamuweli wayephakathi kwabakhulekayo egameni lakhe. Bakhuleka kuJehova, yena waphendula.
99.7: Wakhuluma kubo esensikeni yefu; bagcina ubufakazi bakhe nezimiso abanika zona.
99.8: Jehova Nkulunkulu wethu, wena ubaphendulile, waba kubo uNkulunkulu othethelelayo nophindiselayo ngezenzo zabo.
99.9: Mphakamiseni uJehova uNkulunkulu wethu, nikhuleke ngasentabeni yakhe engcwele, ngokuba ungcwele uJehova uNkulunkulu wethu.

100.1: Hlokoma kuJehova ngezwi lokuhalalisa, mhlaba wonke.
100.2: Mkhonzeni uJehova ngokujabula, nisondele ebusweni bakhe ngokuhuba kwentokozo.
100.3: Yazini ukuthi uJehova unguNkulunkulu; nguye osenzileyo, akuthina, sibe ngabantu bakhe nezimvu zedlelo lakhe.
100.4: Ngenani emasangweni akhe ngokubonga, nasemagcekeni akhe ngokudumisa; mbongeni, nibusise igama lakhe.
100.5: Ngokuba muhle uJehova; umusa wakhe umi phakade, nokuthembeka kwakhe ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.

101.1: Ngizakuhlabelela ngomusa nokwahlulela, ngikudumise wena Jehova.
101.2: Ngizakuqaphelisisa indlela engenacala. Uyakuza nini kimi na? Ngizakuhamba endlini yami ngenhliziyo engenacala.
101.3: Angizukubeka phambi kwamehlo ami into embi; ukwenza kwabahlubukayo ngiyakuzonda; akuyikunamathela kimi.
101.4: Inhliziyo ephambeneyo iyakusuka kimi; omubi angiyikumazi.
101.5: Omhlebayo umakhelwane wakhe ngasese ngizakumqeda; onamehlo aqhoshayo nenhliziyo ezidlayo angiyikumvumela.
101.6: Amehlo ami akwabathembekileyo bomhlaba ukuba bahlale nami; ohamba endleleni engenacala uyakungikhonza.
101.7: Osebenza ukukhohlisa akayikuhlala endlini yami; okhuluma amanga akayikuma phambi kwamehlo ami.
101.8: Ekuseni imihla ngemihla ngiyakubaqeda bonke ababi bomhlaba, ukuze nginqume emzini kaJehova bonke abenzi bokubi.

102.1: Jehova, yizwa umkhuleko wami; ukukhala kwami makufinyelele kuwe.
102.2: Ungafihli ubuso bakho kimi ngosuku losizi lwami; beka indlebe yakho kimi, ngosuku engimemeza ngalo usheshe ungiphendule.
102.3: Ngokuba izinsuku zami ziphelile njengomusi; amathambo ashile njengezinkuni.
102.4: Inhliziyo yami ishayiwe, ibunile njengotshani, ngokuba ngiyakhohlwa ukudla isinkwa sami.
102.5: Ngenxa yezwi lokububula kwami amathambo ami anamathele enyameni yami.
102.8: Izitha zami ziyangithuka usuku lonke; abahlanya ngami bayangiqalekisa.
102.9: Ngokuba ngidlile umlotha njengesinkwa, nophuzo lwami ngiluxubanisile nezinyembezi.
102.10: Ngenxa yentukuthelo nolaka lwakho ungifukulile, wangilahla.
102.11: Izinsuku zami zinjengethunzi elandayo; mina uqobo ngiyabuna njengotshani.
102.12: Kepha wena Jehova uyakuhlala kuze kube phakade, nesikhumbuzo sakho ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
102.13: Uyakuvuka, uhawukele iSiyoni; sekuyisikhathi sokuliphatha ngomusa, yebo, isikhathi esimisiweyo sesifikile.
102.14: Ngokuba izinceku zalo ziyathokoza ngamatshe alo, zihawukele uthuli lwalo.
102.15: Khona abezizwe bayakulesaba igama likaJehova, amakhosi onke omhlaba inkazimulo yakho.
102.16: Ngokuba uJehova ulakhile iSiyoni, ubonakele enkazimulweni yakhe;
102.17: wanaka umkhuleko wabangenalutho, engawudeleli umthandazo wabo.
102.18: Lokhu kuyakulotshelwa isizukulwane esizayo; abantu abayakudalwa bayakudumisa uJehova.
102.19: Ngokuba ubheke phansi esekuphakameni kwakhe okungcwele, wabuka umhlaba esezulwini
102.20: ukuba ezwe ukububula kwesiboshwa, akhulule abantwana bokufa,
102.21: ukuze kumenyezelwe eSiyoni igama likaJehova nodumo lwakhe eJerusalema,
102.22: nxa izizwe zibuthana ndawonye kanye nemibuso ukumkhonza uJehova.
102.23: Wanciphisa amandla ami endleleni, wafinyeza izinsuku zami.
102.24: Ngithi: “Nkulunkulu wami, ungangisusi enxenyeni yezinsuku zami; iminyaka yakho isezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
102.25: Endulo wawusekela umhlaba, izulu lingumsebenzi wezandla zakho.
102.26: Kuyakubhubha lokhu, kepha uyakuma; yebo, kuyakuguga konke njengengubo; njengesambatho uyakukuguqula, kuguqulwe.
102.27: Kepha unguwe njalo, iminyaka yakho ayiyikuphela.
102.28: Abantwana bezinceku zakho bayakuhlala; inzalo yabo iyakuma phambi kwakho.”

103.1: Mbonge uJehova, mphefumulo wami; konke okuphakathi kwami makubonge igama lakhe elingcwele.
103.2: Mbonge uJehova, mphefumulo wami, ungakhohlwa imisebenzi yonke yakhe yomusa,
103.3: yena othethelela zonke izono zakho, owelapha zonke izifo zakho;
103.4: okhulula ukuphila kwakho ekubhujisweni, okuqhelisa ngomusa nangobubele;
103.5: osuthisa ukulangazela kwakho ngokuhle, ubusha bakho bubuyiswe njengokhozi.
103.6: UJehova ubenzela bonke abacindezelwayo ukulunga nokwahlulela.
103.7: Wamazisa uMose izindlela zakhe, nabantwana bakwa-Israyeli izenzo zakhe.
103.8: UJehova unobubele nesihawu; wephuza ukuthukuthela, kuvama umusa.
103.9: Akathethi njalonjalo; akagcini intukuthelo yakhe kuze kube phakade.
103.10: Akasiphathi njengokufanele izono zethu, akasivuzi njengokwamacala ethu.
103.11: Ngokuba njengokuphakama kwezulu phezu komhlaba unjalo umusa wakhe phezu kwabamesabayo.
103.12: Njengokuba impumalanga yahlukene nentshonalanga, udedisile kangaka kithi iziphambeko zethu.
103.13: Njengoyise ehawukela abantwana bakhe, kanjalo uJehova uyabahawukela abamesabayo.
103.14: Ngokuba uyakwazi ukubunjwa kwethu; uyakhumbula ukuthi siluthuli.
103.15: Izinsuku zomuntu zinjengotshani; uyakhahlela njengembali yasendle.
103.16: Ngokuba umoya uyadlula phezu kwayo, bese yinyamalala, nendawo yayo ingabe isayazi.
103.17: Kepha umusa kaJehova uphezu kwabamesabayo kwaphakade kuze kube phakade, nokulunga kwakhe kubantwana babantwana,
103.18: kubo abagcina isivumelwano sakhe bekhumbula iziyalezo zakhe ukuba bazenze.
103.19: UJehova umisile isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi ezulwini; nombuso wakhe ubusa phezu kwakho konke.
103.20: Bongani uJehova nina zingelosi zakhe, nina maqhawe anamandla enenza okwezwi lakhe nilalela ukukhuluma kwezwi lakhe.
103.21: Bongani uJehova nina mabandla onke akhe, nina zinceku zakhe enenza intando yakhe.
103.22: Bongani uJehova nina misebenzi yakhe yonke ezindaweni zonke zombuso wakhe. Mbonge uJehova, mphefumulo wami.

104.1: Mbonge uJehova, mphefumulo wami; Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, umkhulu, wembethe udumo nobukhosi;
104.2: ogqoka ukukhanya njengengubo, oweneka izulu njengendwangu;
104.3: obeka imishayo yezindlu zakhe emanzini, owenza amafu abe yinqola yakhe, ohamba ngamaphiko omoya;
104.4: owenza izingelosi zibe yimimoya, izikhonzi zakhe zibe yilangabi lomlilo.
104.5: Umisile umhlaba phezu kwezisekelo zawo, ukuze ungazanyazanyiswa kuze kube phakade naphakade.
104.6: Wawumboza ngolwandle njengengubo; amanzi ema phezu kwezintaba.
104.7: Ngokukhuza kwakho abaleka, ngezwi lokuduma kwakho ashesha asuka.
104.8: Enyuka izintaba, ehla izigodi, aze afika endaweni owawuyimisele wona.
104.9: Umisile umncele ukuba angaweqi, angabuyi ukusibekela umhlaba.
104.10: Uthumela imithombo ezigodini; yona igijima phakathi kwezintaba.
104.11: Iyaphuzisa izilwane zonke zasendle, izimbongolo zasendle zicime ukoma kwazo.
104.12: Izinyoni zezulu zakhile ngakuyo, zizwakalisa izwi lazo phakathi kwamagatsha.
104.13: Uphuzisa izintaba okuvela emakamelweni akhe; umhlaba uyaneliswa yisithelo semisebenzi yakho.
104.14: Uhlumisela izinkomo utshani nemifino yokusiza umuntu, ukuze aveze ukudla emhlabeni,
104.15: newayini elijabulisa inhliziyo yomuntu, namafutha okukhazimulisa ubuso, nesinkwa esiqinisa inhliziyo yomuntu.
104.16: Iyasutha imithi kaJehova, imisedari* yaseLebanoni ayitshalileyo,
104.17: okwakhele kuyo izinyoni; ugolantethe unendlu yakhe kuyo imisayipuresi.*
104.18: Izintaba eziphakemeyo ngezezimbuzi zasendle; amawa ayisiphephelo sezimbila.
104.19: Wenza inyanga ibe ngeyokwahlukanisa izikhathi; ilanga liyazi ukushona kwalo.
104.20: Wenza ubumnyama kube ngubusuku; phakathi kwabo kuphuma izilo zonke zasehlathini.
104.21: Izingonyama ezintsha zibhongela impango, zifuna ukudla kwazo kuNkulunkulu.
104.22: Liphuma ilanga, bese zibuyela phansi zilale emihumeni yazo.
104.23: Bese kuphuma umuntu, aye emsebenzini wakhe nasekukhandlekeni kwakhe kuze kuhlwe.
104.24: Jehova, yeka ubuningi bemisebenzi yakho; yonke uyenzile ngokuhlakanipha; umhlaba ugcwele izidalwa zakho.
104.25: Nantu ulwandle, lukhulu, lubanzi; lapho kukhona izilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo ezingenakubalwa, izilwane ezincane nezinkulu.
104.26: Kuhamba khona imikhumbi, uLeviyathani* lowo omenzile ukuba adlale kulo.
104.27: Zonke lezi zidalwa zibheka wena, ukuze uzinike ukudla kwazo ngesikhathi esiyiso.
104.28: Uyazinika ukudla, zibuthe; uvula isandla sakho, zisuthe ngokuhle.
104.29: Uyasitheza ubuso bakho, zethuke; uyasusa umphefumulo wazo, zife, zibuyele othulini lwazo.
104.30: Uyathumela umoya wakho, zidalwe; wenza bube busha ubuso bomhlaba.
104.31: Inkazimulo kaJehova mayime kuze kube phakade; uJehova kathokoze ngemisebenzi yakhe,
104.32: yena obheka umhlaba, besewuthuthumela, othinta izintaba, zithunqe.
104.33: Ngiyakumhubela uJehova kukho konke ukuphila kwami; ngiyakuhlabelela kuNkulunkulu wami ngisekhona.
104.34: Ukuzindla kwami makube mnandi kuye; mina mangithokoze kuJehova.
104.35: Izoni maziphele emhlabeni, kungabe kusaba khona ababi. Mbonge uJehova, mphefumulo wami. Haleluya!

105.1: Bongani uJehova, nibize igama lakhe, nizazise phakathi kwabantu izenzo zakhe.
105.2: Hlabelelani kuye, nimhubele, nikhulume ngezimangaliso zakhe zonke.
105.3: Zibongeni egameni lakhe elingcwele; mazithokoze izinhliziyo zabamfunayo uJehova.
105.4: Funani uJehova namandla akhe, nifunisise ubuso bakhe njalo.
105.5: Khumbulani izimangaliso zakhe azenzileyo, nezibonakaliso zakhe, nezahlulelo zomlomo wakhe,
105.6: nina nzalo ka-Abrahama inceku yakhe, nina bantwana bakaJakobe, abakhethiweyo bakhe.
105.7: Yena unguJehova uNkulunkulu wethu; izahlulelo zakhe zisemhlabeni wonke.
105.8: Ukhumbulile isivumelwano sakhe kuze kube phakade, izwi ayala ngalo izizukulwane eziyinkulungwane,
105.9: avumelana kuso no-Abrahama, nesifungo sakhe ku-Isaka;
105.10: wasiqinisa kuJakobe, saba ngumthetho, naku-Israyeli, saba yisivumelwano esiphakade,
105.11: ethi: “Ngizakukunika izwe laseKhanani libe yisabelo sefa lakho,”
105.12: lapho babe yingcosana ngomumo, yebo, lapho babe yingcosana, futhi babe yizihambi kulo.
105.13: Bazulazula ezizweni ngezizwe, besuka kulo mbuso, beya kwabanye abantu.
105.14: Akavumelanga muntu ukubahlupha, wajezisa amakhosi ngenxa yabo,
105.15: ethi: “Ningathinti abagcotshiweyo bami, ningoni abaprofethi bami.”
105.16: Futhi wathuma indlala phezu kwezwe, walwaphula uzime lwesinkwa.
105.17: Wathuma indoda phambi kwabo: uJosefa wathengiswa abe yisigqila.
105.18: Balimaza izinyawo zakhe ngamaketanga, waboshwa ngensimbi.
105.19: Kwaze kwaba yisikhathi elagcwaliseka ngaso izwi lakhe, izwi likaJehova lamhola.
105.20: Inkosi yathuma yamthukulula, umbusi wabantu wamkhulula.
105.21: Wamenza umphathi wendlu yakhe nenduna yezinto zakhe zonke,
105.22: ukuze abophe izikhulu zakhe ngokuthanda kwakhe, afundise amalunga akhe ukuhlakanipha.
105.23: U-Israyeli wayesefika eGibithe, uJakobe wagogobala ezweni likaHamu.
105.24: Wandisa kakhulu abantu bakhe; wabenza babe namandla kunezitha zabo.
105.25: Wayiguqula inhliziyo yabo ukuba bazonde abantu bakhe, baphathe izinceku zakhe ngobuqili.
105.26: Wathuma uMose inceku yakhe, u-Aroni abemkhethile.
105.27: Benza phakathi kwabo izibonakaliso zakhe nezimangaliso ezweni likaHamu.
105.28: Wathuma ubumnyama, wenza kwaba mnyama, kepha baphambana namazwi akhe.
105.29: Waphendula amanzi abo aba yigazi; wabhubhisa izinhlanzi zabo.
105.30: Izwe labo lagcwala amasele nasezindlini zamakhosi abo.
105.31: Wakhuluma, kwavela izibawu nezinsensane eminceleni yabo yonke.
105.32: Wabanika isichotho saba yimvula yabo, amalangabi omlilo ezweni labo.
105.33: Washaya nemivini yabo nemikhiwane yabo; waphula imithi yasezweni labo.
105.35: Zona zadla imifino yonke yezwe lakubo, zaqothula nezithelo zomhlabathi wabo.
105.36: Washaya namazibulo onke ezweni lakubo, okokuqala kwamandla abo.
105.37: Wayesebakhipha benesiliva negolide, kungekho ontengezelayo emindenini yakubo.
105.38: IGibithe lajabula ekuphumeni kwabo, ngokuba ukwesaba kwabehlela.
105.39: Wendlala ifu lokubasibekela, nomlilo wokukhanyisa ebusuku.
105.40: Bacela, waletha izigwaca, wabasuthisa ngesinkwa sasezulwini.
105.41: Wavula idwala, kwampompoza amanzi, agobhoza emahlane njengomfula.
105.42: Ngokuba wakhumbula izwi lakhe elingcwele no-Abrahama inceku yakhe.
105.43: Wayesekhipha abantu bakhe ngokujabula, abakhethiweyo bakhe ngokuthokoza.
105.44: Wabapha amazwe abezizwe, badla isithelo somsebenzi wabantu
105.45: ukuba baqaphele izimiso zakhe, bagcine imithetho yakhe. Haleluya!

106.1: Haleluya! Bongani uJehova, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
106.2: Ngubani ongalanda izenzo zamandla zikaJehova, azwakalise lonke udumo lwakhe, na?
106.3: Babusisiwe abaqaphela ukwahlulela kwakhe, owenza ukulunga ngezikhathi zonke.
106.4: Ngikhumbule, Jehova, ngomusa onawo kubantu bakho, ungihambele ngensindiso yakho,
106.5: ukuze ngibone inhlanhla yabakhethiweyo bakho, ngithokoze ngentokozo yesizwe sakho, ngizibonge kanye nefa lakho.
106.6: Sonile kanye nawobaba; senzile okubi, sonakala.
106.7: Obaba abaqondanga izibonakaliso zakho eGibithe, abakhumbulanga ubuningi bezenzo zakho zomusa; bahlubuka ngaselwandle, uLwandle Olubomvu.
106.8: Nokho wabasindisa ngenxa yegama lakhe, ukuze abonakalise amandla akhe.
106.9: Wakhuza uLwandle Olubomvu, lwasha; wabaholela ekujuleni njengasehlane.
106.10: Wabasindisa esandleni sababazondayo, wabakhulula esandleni sesitha.
106.11: Amanzi asibekela izitha zabo; akwasala noyedwa kubo.
106.12: Khona bakholwa ngamazwi akhe, bahlabelela udumo lwakhe.
106.13: Bashesha bakhohlwa imisebenzi yakhe, abalindelanga isiluleko sakhe.
106.14: Bahaha nokuhaha ehlane, bamlinga uNkulunkulu kwahlongasibi.
106.15: Wabanika abakufisayo, kepha wathuma ukonda emiphefumulweni yabo.
106.16: Baba nomhawu ngoMose ekamu,* nango-Aroni ongcwele kaJehova.
106.17: Umhlaba wavuleka, wamgwinya uDathani, wagqiba iviyo lika-Abiramu.
106.18: Kokheleka umlilo eviyweni labo; ilangabi lashisa laqeda ababi.
106.19: Benza ithole eHorebe; bakhuleka kuso isithombe esibunjiweyo.
106.20: Baguqula kanjalo inkazimulo yabo, yaba njengenkabi edla utshani.
106.21: Bakhohlwa uNkulunkulu umsindisi wabo owayezenzile izinto ezinkulu eGibithe,
106.22: izimangaliso ezweni likaHamu nokwesabekayo ngaseLwandle Olubomvu.
106.23: Wathi ubezakubabhubhisa, uma uMose okhethiweyo wakhe ebengemanga ebusweni bakhe ukubakhulumela, ukuze amyekise intukuthelo yakhe, funa ababhubhise.
106.24: Badelela izwe elihle, babengakholwa yizwi lakhe.
106.25: Bakhonona besematendeni abo; babengalaleli izwi likaJehova.
106.26: Ngalokho waphakamisa isandla sakhe ngakubo ukuba abawise ehlane,
106.27: awise nenzalo yabo phakathi kwabezizwe, abahlakaze emazweni.
106.28: Bazihlanganisa noBali Peyori, badla okuhlatshelwe abafileyo.
106.29: Bamcunula ngezenzo zabo; kwabhoboka isifo phakathi kwabo.
106.31: lokhu wakubalelwa njengokulunga ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane kuze kube phakade.
106.32: Bamcunula ngasemanzini aseMeriba; kwaba kubi kuMose ngenxa yabo.
106.33: Ngokuba baphambana noMoya wakhe; wakhuluma ngamawala ngomlomo wakhe.
106.35: kepha bahlangana nabezizwe, bafunda imisebenzi yabo.
106.36: Bakhonza izithombe zabo, zaba lugibe kubo.
106.38: Bachitha igazi elingenacala, igazi lamadodana abo namadodakazi abo abawahlabela izithombe zaseKhanani; izwe langcoliswa yigazi.
106.39: Bangcola kanjalo ngemisebenzi yabo, baphinga ezenzweni zabo.
106.40: Intukuthelo kaJehova yokheleka ngakubantu bakhe; ifa lakhe laba yisinengiso kuye.
106.42: Izitha zabo zabacindezela, bathotshiswa phansi kwesandla sazo.
106.43: Kaningi wabakhulula; kepha bahlubuka ngecebo labo, bawiswa phansi ngobubi babo.
106.44: Nokho wanaka ukuhlupheka kwabo, esezwile ukukhala kwabo.
106.45: Wabakhumbulela isivumelwano sakhe; waphenduka ngokobuningi bomusa wakhe.
106.46: Wabatholisa ububele ebusweni babo bonke ababebathumbile.
106.47: Sisindise, Jehova Nkulunkulu wethu, sibuthe kwabezizwe ukuba sidumise igama lakho elingcwele, sethabe ekukudumiseni.
106.48: Makabongwe uJehova uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli kusukela phakade kuze kube phakade. Abantu bonke mabathi: “Amen.” Haleluya!

107.1: Bongani uJehova, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
107.2: Mabasho njalo abahlengiweyo bakaJehova, abahlengileyo esandleni sesitha;
107.3: wababutha emazweni, empumalanga nasentshonalanga, enyakatho naselwandle.
107.4: Bazulazula ehlane ngendlela yakwahlongasibi, abafumananga umuzi wokuhlala.
107.5: Belambile, bomile, umphefumulo wabo waphela amandla phakathi kwabo.
107.6: Base bekhala kuJehova ekuhluphekeni kwabo; wabakhulula ezinsizini zabo.
107.7: Wabahola ngendlela elungileyo ukuba baye emzini wokuhlala.
107.8: Mababonge uJehova ngomusa wakhe nezimangaliso zakhe kubo abantwana babantu.
107.9: Ngokuba usuthisa umphefumulo olangazelayo; umphefumulo olambayo uyawugcwalisa ngokuhle.
107.10: Babehlezi ebumnyameni nasethunzini lokufa beboshiwe osizini nasensimbini,
107.11: ngokuba babephambene namazwi kaNkulunkulu, babesidelele isiluleko soPhezukonke.
107.12: Wathobisa inhliziyo yabo ngokuhlupheka; bawa kungekho osizayo.
107.13: Base bekhala kuJehova ekuhluphekeni kwabo, wabakhulula ezinsizini zabo.
107.14: Wabakhipha ebumnyameni nasethunzini lokufa, wagqabula izibopho zabo.
107.15: Mababonge uJehova ngomusa wakhe nangezimangaliso zakhe kubo abantwana babantu.
107.16: Ngokuba waphulile amasango ethusi, wanquma imigoqo yensimbi.
107.17: Babe yizithutha ngenxa yeziphambeko zabo; ngenxa yobubi babo babehlushwa.
107.18: Umphefumulo wabo wenyanya konke ukudla; basondela emasangweni okufa.
107.19: Base bekhala kuJehova ekuhluphekeni kwabo; wabakhulula ezinsizini zabo.
107.20: Wathuma izwi lakhe, wabaphilisa, wabakhulula emathuneni abo.
