107.21: Mababonge uJehova ngomusa wakhe, nezimangaliso zakhe kubo abantwana babantu.
107.22: Mabanikele iminikelo yokubonga, balande imisebenzi yakhe ngokwethaba.
107.23: Behlela elwandle ngemikhumbi, bathengiselana emanzini amakhulu.
107.24: Laba babona imisebenzi kaJehova nezimangaliso zakhe ekujuleni.
107.25: Ngokuba wakhuluma, wavusa umoya wesiphepho owaphakamisa amadlambi olwandle.
107.26: Bakhuphukela ezulwini, babuye behlela kuzo izintwa; umphefumulo wancibilika ngosizi.
107.27: Bayendayenda, bantengezela njengodakiweyo; konke ukuhlakanipha kwabo kwagwinywa.
107.28: Base bekhala kuJehova ekuhluphekeni kwabo, wabakhulula ezinsizini zabo.
107.29: Wathulisa isiphepho, kwaze kwaba ngukuthula, kwathula namadlambi olwandle.
107.30: Base bethokoza, ngokuba kwaba ngukuthula; wabaholela ethekwini lokufisa kwabo.
107.31: Mababonge uJehova ngomusa wakhe nangezimangaliso zakhe kubo abantwana babantu.
107.32: Mabamphakamise ebandleni labantu, bamdumise emhlanganweni wamalunga.
107.33: Imifula wayiphendula ihlane, nemithombo yamanzi isigagadu,
107.34: nomhlabathi ovundileyo waba lugwadule lukasawoti ngenxa yobubi babahlezi khona.
107.35: Ihlane waliphendula amachibi amanzi, nomhlabathi owomileyo imithombo yamanzi.
107.36: Wabahlalisa khona abalambileyo, bakha khona umuzi wokuhlala.
107.37: Balima amasimu, batshala isivini, kwabathelela izithelo.
107.38: Wababusisa, banda kakhulu, akanciphisa izinkomo zabo.
107.39: Babuye bancipha, bathotshiswa ngokucindezelwa, nangobubi, nangosizi.
107.40: Wathela ukudelelwa phezu kwezikhulu, wabazulazulisa ehlane elingenandlela.
107.41: Nokho waphakamisa ompofu, wamkhipha osizini, enza imindeni njengomhlambi.
107.42: Olungileyo uyakukubona, ajabule; ububi bonke bumelwe ukuvala umlomo.
107.43: Ohlakaniphileyo makaqaphele lokhu; bayakuqonda umusa kaJehova.

108.1: Inhliziyo yami iduduzekile, Nkulunkulu; ngizakuhlabelela, ngihube, ngisho nomphefumulo wami.
108.3: Ngizakukubonga phakathi kwabantu, Jehova, ngikudumise phakathi kwezizwe.
108.4: Ngokuba umusa wakho mkhulu phezu kwezulu, nokuthembeka kwakho kuze kube semafwini.
108.5: Phakama, Nkulunkulu, phezu kwezulu, inkazimulo yakho ibe phezu komhlaba wonke.
108.6: Ukuze abathandekayo bakho bakhululwe, sindisa ngesandla sakho sokunene, ungizwele.
108.7: UNkulunkulu ukhulumile ebungcweleni bakhe, wathi: “Ngiyakwethaba; ngiyakulidabula iShekemi, ngisilinganise isiGodi saseSukoti.
108.8: Ngowami uGileyadi, ngowami uManase; u-Efrayimi uyisivikelo sekhanda lami, uJuda uyintonga yami yokubusa.
108.9: UMowabi uyisitsha sami sokuhlambela; phezu kuka-Edomi ngiphonsa isicathulo sami; phezu kweFilistiya ngiyethaba.”
108.10: Ngubani oyakungiyisa emzini oyinqaba na? Ngubani oyakungiholela kwa-Edomi na?
108.11: Akusiwena Nkulunkulu osilahlileyo na? Nkulunkulu, awusaphumi nezimpi zethu.
108.12: Siphe ukuba sisizakale ekuhluphekeni, ngokuba ukusiza komuntu kuyize.
108.13: NgoNkulunkulu siyakwenza izenzo zamandla; yena uyakunyathela phansi izitha zethu.

109.2: Ngokuba umlomo womubi nomlomo wenkohliso bawuvulile ngakimi; bakhulumile ngami ngolimi lwamanga.
109.3: Bangizungeza ngamazwi enzondo; balwa nami, kungekho sizathu.
109.4: Ngenxa yothando lwami bayangizonda, mina ngisemkhulekweni njalo.
109.5: Bangibuyisele okubi ngokuhle, nenzondo ngothando lwami.
109.6: Beka omubi phezu kwakhe; makume omelene naye ngasesandleni sakhe sokunene.
109.7: Ekwahlulelweni kwakhe makalahlwe yicala; umkhuleko wakhe mawube yisono.
109.8: Izinsuku zakhe mazibe yingcosana, omunye athathe isikhundla sakhe.
109.9: Abantwana bakhe mababe yizintandane, umkakhe abe ngumfelokazi.
109.10: Abantwana bakhe mababe yizintandane, baphanze, bacele bekude nezindawo zabo ezichithekileyo.
109.11: Umtsheleki makabambe konke anakho, abafo baphange izithelo zomsebenzi wakhe.
109.12: Makungabikho omenzela umusa, futhi kungabikho ohawukela izintandane zakhe.
109.13: Inzalo yakhe mayinqunywe; igama layo malesulwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo.
109.14: Ububi bawoyise mabukhumbuleke kuJehova; masingesulwa isono sikanina.
109.15: Mabeme phambi kukaJehova njalo, kunqunywe isikhumbuzo sabo emhlabeni.
109.16: Ngokuba wayengakhumbuli ukwenza umusa, kepha wazingela umuntu odingayo nompofu nodabukile ngenhliziyo ukuba ababulale.
109.17: Wathanda ukuthuka, kweza phezu kwakhe; wayengathokozi ngesibusiso, sahlala kude naye.
109.18: Wagqoka ukuthuka njengesambatho, kwangena ezibilinini zakhe njengamanzi, nasemathanjeni akhe njengamafutha.
109.19: Makube kuye njengesambatho asembathayo nebhande* azibopha ngalo isikhathi sonke.
109.20: Lokhu makube ngumvuzo wezitha, uvela kuJehova, nowabakhuluma kabi ngomphefumulo wami.
109.21: Kepha wena Jehova, Nkosi yami, ngiphathe ngokwegama lakho; njengokuba umusa wakho ulungile, ngisindise.
109.22: Ngokuba ngingodingayo nompofu; inhliziyo yami ilimele phakathi kwami.
109.24: Amadolo ami abuthakathaka ngokuzila ukudla, nomzimba wami uswele ukukhuluphala.
109.25: Futhi ngaba yisihlamba kubona; bengibheka banikina amakhanda abo.
109.26: Ngisize, Jehova Nkulunkulu wami, ngisindise ngokomusa wakho,
109.27: ukuze bazi ukuthi lokhu kuyisandla sakho; wena Jehova ukwenzile.
109.28: Mabathuke bona, wena ubusise; nxa bevuka, mabajabhe; kepha inceku yakho mayithokoze.
109.29: Abamelene nami mabembeswe amahloni, bagqoke ukujabha njengesambatho.
109.30: Ngiyakumbonga uJehova ngomlomo wami, ngimdumise esixukwini.
109.31: Ngokuba uyakuma ngakwesokunene sompofu ukumsindisa kulabo abalahla umphefumulo wakhe.

110.1: UJehova wathi eNkosini yami: “Hlala ngakwesokunene sami, ngize ngenze izitha zakho zibe yisenabelo sezinyawo zakho.”
110.2: Intonga yamandla akho uJehova uyakuyelula eseSiyoni; busa wena phakathi kwezitha zakho.
110.3: Abantu bakho bayazinikela ngenjabulo ngosuku lwempi yakho; ebuhleni bobungcwele abasha bakho bavela njengamazolo esizalweni sokusa.
110.4: UJehova ufungile engayikuguquka, wathi: “Wena ungumpristi kuze kube phakade ngendlela kaMelkisedeki.”
110.5: INkosi ingakwesokunene sakho; iyakuchoboza amakhosi ngosuku lwentukuthelo yayo.
110.6: Iyakwahlulela phakathi kwabezizwe, kugcwale izidumbu, ichoboze amakhanda ezizweni eziningi.
110.7: Iyakuphuza emfuleni ngasendleleni; ngalokho iyakuphakamisa ikhanda.

111.1: Haleluya! Ngiyakubonga uJehova ngenhliziyo yami yonke emhlanganweni nasebandleni labaqotho.
111.2: Mikhulu imisebenzi kaJehova, iphenywa yibo bonke abathokoza ngayo.
111.3: Umsebenzi wakhe ungubukhosi nodumo, nokulunga kwakhe kumi phakade.
111.4: Wenzele izimangaliso zakhe isikhumbuzo; uJehova unomusa nobubele.
111.5: Abamesabayo ubapha ukudla; ukhumbula njalo isivumelwano sakhe.
111.6: Ubonisile abantu bakhe amandla emisebenzi yakhe ngokubapha ifa labezizwe.
111.7: Imisebenzi yezandla zakhe iyiqiniso nokwahlulela; imithetho yonke yakhe iqinile;
111.9: Wabathumela abantu bakhe ukukhululwa; uyalezile isivumelwano sakhe kuze kube phakade; lingcwele, liyesabeka igama lakhe.
111.10: Ukumesaba uJehova kungukuqala kokuhlakanipha; banengqondo enhle bonke abakwenzayo. Udumo lwakhe lumi kuze kube phakade.

112.1: Haleluya! Ubusisiwe umuntu omesabayo uJehova, othokoza kakhulu ngemithetho yakhe.
112.2: Inzalo yakhe iyakuba namandla emhlabeni; isizukulwane sabaqotho siyakubusiswa.
112.3: Ingcebo nemfuyo kusendlini yakhe; ukulunga kwakhe kumi phakade.
112.4: Kuyabaphumela abalungileyo ukukhanya ebumnyameni: umusa, nobubele, nokulunga.
112.5: Umuntu omuhle nguye onomusa, otshelekayo, esekela izindaba zakhe ngokulunga.
112.6: Ngokuba akayikugudluka kuze kube phakade; olungileyo uyakukhunjulwa kuze kube phakade.
112.7: Akesabi imibiko emibi; inhliziyo yakhe iqinile, iyethemba uJehova.
112.8: Imisekile inhliziyo yakhe, ayesabi, aze azibuke izitha zakhe ziphansi.
112.9: Uyaphana, uyabanika abampofu; ukulunga kwakhe kumi kuze kube phakade; uphondo lwakhe luyakuphakama ngodumo.
112.10: Omubi uyakukubona, acunuke, agedle amazinyo akhe, abesephela; isifiso sababi siyakubhubha.

113.1: Haleluya! Dumisani nina zinceku zikaJehova, nidumise igama likaJehova.
113.2: Malibongwe igama likaJehova kusukela kulesi sikhathi kuze kube phakade.
113.3: Kusukela ekuphumeni kwelanga kuze kube sekushoneni kwalo igama likaJehova malidunyiswe.
113.4: UJehova uphakeme phezu kwezizwe zonke, inkazimulo yakhe iphezu kwezulu.
113.5: Ngubani onjengoJehova uNkulunkulu wethu, ohlezi phezulu,
113.7: Uyavusa odingayo othulini, aphakamise ompofu ezaleni,
113.8: ukuze amhlalise nezikhulu, yebo, izikhulu zabantu bakhe.
113.9: Inyumba uyayipha ukuphatha umuzi, ibe ngunina othokozayo wabantwana. Haleluya!

114.1: Kwathi ukuba u-Israyeli aphume eGibithe, indlu kaJakobe kubantu bolunye ulimi,
114.2: khona uJuda waba yindlu yakhe engcwele, u-Israyeli waba ngumbuso wakhe.
114.3: Ulwandle lwakubona, lwabaleka, iJordani labuyiselwa emuva.
114.5: Unani wena lulwandle ukuba ubaleke, nawe Jordani ukuba ubuyiselwe emuva,
114.6: nani zintaba ukuba nitshekule njengezinqama, nani magquma eninjengamawundlu, na?
114.7: Thuthumela, mhlaba, ebusweni beNkosi, ebusweni bukaNkulunkulu kaJakobe,
114.8: yena ophendula idwala libe yichibi lamanzi, insengetsha ibe ngumthombo wamanzi.

115.1: Ungasiphi thina, Jehova, ungasiphi thina, kepha uliphe igama lakho inkazimulo ngenxa yomusa wakho nangenxa yeqiniso lakho.
115.2: Abezizwe bayakusho ngani ukuthi: “Uphi manje uNkulunkulu wabo na?”
115.3: Kepha uNkulunkulu wethu usezulwini; wenza konke akuthandayo.
115.4: Izithombe zabo ziyisiliva negolide, umsebenzi wezandla zomuntu.
115.5: Umlomo zinawo, kepha azikhulumi; amehlo zinawo, kepha aziboni.
115.6: Izindlebe zinazo, kepha azizwa; zinamakhala, kepha azihogeli.
115.7: Zinezandla, kepha aziphathi; zinezinyawo, kepha azihambi; azikhulumi ngomphimbo wazo.
115.9: Israyeli, themba kuJehova; yena ulusizo lwabo nesihlangu sabo.
115.10: O wena ndlu ka-Aroni, themba kuJehova; yena ulusizo lwabo nesihlangu sabo.
115.11: Nina enimesabayo uJehova thembani kuJehova; yena ulusizo lwabo nesihlangu sabo.
115.12: UJehova usikhumbulile; uyakubusisa, abusise indlu ka-Israyeli, abusise indlu ka-Aroni.
115.15: Manibe ngababusisiweyo bakaJehova owenzile izulu nomhlaba.
115.16: Izulu liyizulu likaJehova, kepha umhlaba wawunika abantwana babantu.
115.17: Abafileyo abamdumnisi uJehova, qha, noyedwa kwabehlelayo ekuthuleni.
115.18: Kepha thina siyakumbonga uJehova kusukela kulesi sikhathi kuze kube phakade. Haleluya!

116.1: Ngiyamthanda uJehova, ngokuba uyezwa izwi lokukhuleka kwami.
116.2: Ngokuba ubekile indlebe kimi ngiyakukhuleka kuye zonke izinsuku zami.
116.3: Izintambo zokufa zangizungeza, nobuhlungu bendawo yabafileyo bangibamba; ngafumana ukuhlupheka nosizi.
116.4: Kepha ngabiza igama likaJehova, ngathi: “Ngiyakuncenga, Jehova, khulula umphefumulo wami.”
116.5: Unomusa uJehova, ulungile; uNkulunkulu wethu unobubele.
116.6: UJehova uyalondoloza ongenabuqili; ngithotshisiwe phansi wangisindisa.
116.7: Buyela ekuphumuleni kwakho, mphefumulo wami, ngokuba uJehova ukuphathe ngomusa.
116.8: Yebo, ukhululile umphefumulo wami ekufeni, amehlo ami ezinyembezini, nezinyawo zami ekuweni.
116.12: Ngiyakubuyiselani kuJehova ngazo zonke izenzo zakhe ezinhle kimina na?
116.13: Ngiyakuthatha indebe yensindiso, ngibize igama likaJehova.
116.14: Izithembiso zami kuJehova ngiyakuzigcwalisa, yebo, nasebusweni babantu bakhe bonke.
116.15: Kuyigugu emehlweni kaJehova ukufa kwabangcwele bakhe.
116.16: Ngiyinceku yakho impela, Jehova; ngiyinceku yakho, indodana yencekukazi yakho; uthukululile izintambo zami.
116.17: Ngiyakunikela kuwe umnikelo wokubonga, ngibize igama likaJehova.
116.18: Izithembiso zami kuJehova ngiyakuzigcwalisa yebo, nasebusweni babantu bakhe bonke,
116.19: emagcekeni endlu kaJehova, phakathi kwakho, Jerusalema. Haleluya!

117.1: Dumisani uJehova nina bezizwe zonke, nimbabaze nina bantu bonke.
117.2: Ngokuba umusa wakhe mkhulu kithina; iqiniso likaJehova limi phakade. Haleluya!

118.1: Bongani uJehova, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
118.2: Makathi u-Israyeli: “Yebo, umusa wakhe umi phakade.”
118.3: Mayithi indlu ka-Aroni: “Yebo, umusa wakhe umi phakade.”
118.4: Mabathi abamesabayo uJehova: “Yebo, umusa wakhe umi phakade.”
118.5: Engcingweni yami ngakhuleka kuJehova, uJehova wangiphendula endaweni ebanzi.
118.6: UJehova ungakimi, angiyikwesaba; umuntu angangenzani na?
118.7: UJehova ungakimi ekanye nabangisizayo; ngalokho ngiyakubabuka bephansi abangizondayo.
118.10: Bonke abezizwe bayangizungeza; egameni likaJehova ngiyakubachitha.
118.11: Bayangikaka, yebo, bayangizungeza; egameni likaJehova ngiyakubachitha.
118.12: Bayangibunganyela njengezinyosi, bacimeka njengomlilo wameva; egameni likaJehova ngiyakubachitha.
118.13: Bayangihlohloloza ukuba ngiwe, kepha uJehova uyangisiza.
118.14: UJehova ungamandla ami nesihlabelelo sami, waba yinsindiso yami.
118.15: Izwi lokwethaba nelokusindiswa lisezindlini zabalungileyo; esokunene sikaJehova senza okwamandla.
118.16: Esokunene sikaJehova siphakeme, esokunene sikaJehova sisebenza ngamandla.
118.17: Angiyikufa, kepha ngiyakuphila, ngishumayele imisebenzi kaJehova.
118.18: UJehova wangilaya nokungilaya, kodwa akanginikelanga ekufeni.
118.19: Ngivuleleni amasango okulunga, ngingene ngawo, ngimdumise uJehova.
118.20: Yileli isango likaJehova; olungileyo uyakungena ngalo.
118.21: Ngiyakukudumisa, ngokuba ungizwile, waba yinsindiso yami.
118.22: Itshe abalinqabayo abakhi selaba yinhloko yegumbi.
118.23: Lona lavela kuJehova; liyisimangaliso emehlweni ethu.
118.24: Yilolu usuku alwenzileyo uJehova; siyakwethaba, sithokoze ngalo.
118.25: Sindisa, Jehova! ngiyakuncenga; hlahlamelisa, Jehova! ngiyakucela.
118.26: Makabusiswe ozayo egameni likaJehova; siyanibusisa sisendlini kaJehova.
118.27: UJehova unguNkulunkulu, usikhanyisele; hlobisani umkhosi ngamahlamvu kuze kube sezimpondweni ze-altare.
118.28: Wena unguNkulunkulu wami, ngiyakukubonga; Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyakukuphakamisa.
118.29: Bongani uJehova, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.

119.1: Babusisiwe abaqotho endleleni, abahamba ngemithetho kaJehova.
119.2: Babusisiwe abagcina ubufakazi bakhe, abamfuna ngenhliziyo yonke,
119.3: abangenzi ukungalungi, kepha behamba ezindleleni zakhe;
119.5: Sengathi zingaqondiswa izindlela zami ukuba ngigcine izimiso zakho.
119.6: Khona angiyikujabha; ngiyakuhlonipha iziyalezo zonke zakho.
119.7: Ngiyakukubonga ngobuqotho benhliziyo, lapho ngifunda izahlulelo zakho ezilungileyo.
119.9: Insizwa iyakuyihlanza kanjani indlela yayo na? Ngokuqaphela okwezwi lakho.
119.10: Ngikufunile ngenhliziyo yami yonke; mangingaphambuki emiyalweni yakho.
119.11: Enhliziyweni yami ngiyalonda izwi lakho, ukuze ngingoni kuwe.
119.12: Mawubongwe wena Jehova, ungifundise izimiso zakho.
119.13: Ngomlomo wami ngimemezele zonke izahlulelo zomlomo wakho.
119.15: Ngiyakuzindla ngeziyalezo zakho, ngihloniphe izindlela zakho.
119.16: Ngiyakuthokoza ngezimiso zakho; angiyikukhohlwa izwi lakho.
119.17: Yenzele okuhle inceku yakho ukuba ngiphile, ngigcine izwi lakho.
119.18: Vula amehlo ami ukuba ngibone izimangaliso zasemthethweni wakho.
119.20: Umphefumulo wami waphukile ngokulangazelela njalo izahlulelo zakho.
119.21: Uyakhuza abazidlayo, abaqalekisiweyo, abaduka emiyalweni yakho.
119.22: Susa kimi isihlamba nokudelelwa, ngokuba ngiyaqaphela ubufakazi bakho.
119.23: Yebo, izikhulu zihlezi zikhuluma ngami; inceku yakho iyazindla ngezimiso zakho.
119.24: Ubufakazi bakho buyintokozo yami, bungumluleki wami.
119.25: Umphefumulo wami unamathela othulini; ngiphilise ngokwezwi lakho.
119.26: Ngimemezele izindlela zami, wena wangizwa; ngifundise izimiso zakho.
119.27: Ngiqondise indlela yeziyalezo zakho ukuba ngikhulume ngezimangaliso zakho.
119.28: Umphefumulo wami uyakhala ngosizi; ngivuse ngokwezwi lakho.
119.29: Susa kimi indlela yamanga, ungiphe ngomusa umthetho wakho.
119.30: Ngikhethile indlela yeqiniso; izahlulelo zakho ngizibekile phambi kwami.
119.32: Ngiyakugijima ngendlela yemiyalo yakho, ngokuba uyakwandisa inhliziyo yami.
119.33: Ngitshengise, Jehova, indlela yezimiso zakho; ngiyakuyigcina kuze kube sekupheleni.
119.34: Ngiphe ingqondo, ukuze ngiqaphele umthetho wakho, ngiwugcine ngenhliziyo yami yonke.
119.35: Ngihambise endleleni yemiyalo yakho, ngokuba ngiyathokoza ngayo.
119.36: Thobisela inhliziyo yami ebufakazini bakho, kungabi sekuhaheni.
119.37: Phendula amehlo ami, angaboni okuyize, ungiphilise endleleni yakho.
119.38: Yigcwalise encekwini yakho inkulumo yakho eyenza ukuba wesatshwe.
119.39: Dlulisa isihlamba engisesabayo, ngokuba izahlulelo zakho zinhle.
119.40: Bheka, ngiyalangazelela iziyalezo zakho; ngiphilise ngokulunga kwakho.
119.41: Mawuze kimi umusa wakho, Jehova, insindiso yakho ngokwezwi lakho.
119.42: Khona ngiyakumphendula ongithukayo, ngokuba ngiyalethemba izwi lakho.
119.43: Ungalisusi emlonyeni wami ngokupheleleyo izwi leqiniso, ngokuba ngiyethemba izahlulelo zakho.
119.44: Khona ngiyakuwugcina njalo umthetho wakho, yebo, kuze kube phakade.
119.45: Ngiyakuhamba endaweni ebanzi, ngokuba iziyalezo zakho ngiyazifuna.
119.46: Ngiyakukhuluma ngobufakazi bakho phambi kwamakhosi, ngingajabhi.
119.48: Ngiyakuphakamisela izandla zami kuyo imiyalo yakho engiyithandileyo, ngizindle ngezimiso zakho.
119.49: Khumbula izwi encekwini yakho owangipha ithemba ngalo.
119.50: Lokhu kuyinduduzo ekuhluphekeni kwami, ngokuba izwi lakho lingiphilisile.
119.51: Abazidlayo bangihleka usulu kakhulu, kepha emthethweni wakho angichezuki.
119.52: Ngiyakhumbula izahlulelo zakho zasendulo, Jehova; ngiyaduduzeka.
119.53: Ukuvutha kolaka kungibambile ngenxa yababi abashiya umthetho wakho.
119.54: Zaba yizihlabelelo kimina izimiso zakho endlini yokugogobala kwami.
119.55: Ebusuku ngikhumbula igama lakho, Jehova, ngigcina umthetho wakho.
119.56: Lokhu kwaba ngokwami, ngokuba ngagcina iziyalezo zakho.
119.57: UJehova uyisabelo sami; ngithi ngiyakugcina amazwi akho.
119.58: Ngincenga ubuso bakho ngenhliziyo yami yonke; yiba nomusa kimi ngokwezwi lakho.
119.59: Ngizindla ngezindlela zami, ngiqondisa izinyawo zami ebufakazini bakho.
119.61: Izintambo zababi ziyangizungeza, kepha angikhohlwa umthetho wakho.
119.62: Phakathi kobusuku ngiyakuvuka ngikubonge ngenxa yezahlulelo zakho ezilungileyo.
119.63: Ngingumngane wabo bonke abakwesabayo, abagcina iziyalezo zakho.
119.64: Umhlaba ugcwele umusa wakho, Jehova; ngifundise izimiso zakho.
119.65: Uyenzele inceku yakho okuhle, Jehova, ngokwezwi lakho.
119.66: Ngifundise ukuqonda okuhle nokwazi, ngokuba ngikholwa yimiyalo yakho.
119.67: Ngingakahlupheki ngaduka, kepha manje sengiyaligcina izwi lakho.
119.68: Umuhle wena, futhi wenza okuhle; ngifundise izimiso zakho.
119.69: Abazidlayo baqamba amanga ngami; ngenhliziyo yonke yami ngiyakugcina iziyalezo zakho.
119.70: Inhliziyo yabo injengamafutha ingezwa lutho; kepha mina ngithokoza ngomthetho wakho.
119.71: Kwangilungela ukuba ngihlushwe, ukuze ngifunde izimiso zakho.
119.72: Umthetho womlomo wakho muhle kunezinkulungwane zegolide nezesiliva.
119.73: Izandla zakho zingenzile, zangibumba; ngiphe ingqondo, ukuze ngifunde imiyalo yakho.
119.74: Abakwesabayo bayakujabula lapho bengibona, ngokuba ngethemba izwi lakho.
119.75: Ngiyazi ukuthi izahlulelo zakho zilungile nokuthi wangilaya ngokuthembeka.
119.76: Umusa wakho mawube yinduduzo encekwini yakho ngokwezwi lakho.
119.77: Ububele bakho mabuze kimi, ukuze ngiphile, ngokuba umthetho wakho uyintokozo yami.
119.78: Abazidlayo mabajabhe, ngokuba bangicindezele, kungekho sizathu; kepha mina ngiyakuzindla ngeziyalezo zakho.
119.79: Mabaphendukele kimi abakwesabayo nabaziyo ubufakazi bakho.
119.80: Inhliziyo yami mayiphelele ezimisweni zakho, ukuze ngingajabhi.
119.81: Umphefumulo wami ulangazelela insindiso yakho; ngiyalethemba izwi lakho.
119.82: Amehlo ami alangazelela izwi lakho, ngithi: “Uyakungiduduza nini na?”
119.84: Zingaki izinsuku zenceku yakho? Uzakubahlulela nini abangizingelayo na?
119.85: Abazidlayo bangimbela imigodi, bona abaphambene nomthetho wakho.
119.86: Yonke imiyalo yakho ithembekile; bayangizingela ngamanga; ngisize.
119.87: Bacishe bangiqeda emhlabeni, kepha angishiyanga iziyalezo zakho.
119.88: Ngiphilise ngokomusa wakho, ukuze ngigcine ubufakazi bomlomo wakho.
119.89: Kuze kube phakade, Jehova, izwi lakho limi liqinile ezulwini.
119.90: Ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane ukuthembeka kwakho kukhona; wamisa umhlaba; usemi.
119.91: Ngokwezahlulelo zakho kusekhona nanamuhla, ngokuba konke kuyizinceku zakho.
119.92: Uma umthetho wakho ubungesiyo intokozo yami, ngabe ngibhubhele ekuhluphekeni kwami.
119.93: Angiyikukhohlwa kuze kube phakade iziyalezo zakho, ngokuba ungiphilisile ngazo.
119.94: Ngingowakho, ngisindise, ngokuba ngiyafuna iziyalezo zakho.
119.95: Ababi bahlalele ukungibhubhisa, kepha ngiyaqaphela ubufakazi bakho.
119.96: Ngibonile ukugcina kokuphelelyo konke, kepha umthetho wakho ubanzi kakhulu.
119.97: Ngiyawuthanda umthetho wakho kangaka. Usuku lonke ngizindla ngawo.
119.98: Ngemiyalo yakho ngiyahlakanipha kunezitha zami, ngokuba inami kuze kube phakade.
119.99: Ngiyaqonda kunabo bonke abangifundisayo, ngokuba ngizindla ngobufakazi bakho.
119.100: Nginokuqonda kunabadala, ngokuba ngigcina iziyalezo zakho.
119.101: Ngiyazinqanda izinyawo zami ezindleleni zonke zokubi, ukuze ngigcine izwi lakho.
119.102: Ezahlulelweni zakho angichezuki, ngokuba wena uyangifundisa.
119.103: Amnandi kangaka amazwi akho ekunambitheni kwami; adlula izinyosi emlonyeni wami.
119.104: Ngeziyalezo zakho ngiyathola ukuqonda; ngalokho ngiyazonda zonke izindlela zamanga.
119.105: Izwi lakho liyisibani ezinyaweni zami nokukhanya endleleni yami.
119.106: Ngifungile; ukulonda izahlulelo zakho ezilungileyo ngakugcina.
119.107: Ngiyahlupheka kakhulu; Jehova, ngiphilise ngokwezwi lakho.
119.108: Jehova, yamukela iminikelo yesihle yomlomo wami, ungifundise izahlulelo zakho:
119.109: Umphefumulo wami usesandleni sami njalo; nokho umthetho wakho angiwukhohlwa.
119.110: Ababi bangibekele ugibe, kepha angiduki eziyalezweni zakho.
119.111: Ngidlile ifa lobufakazi bakho kuze kube phakade, ngokuba kuyintokozo yenhliziyo yami.
119.112: Ngithobisile inhliziyo yami ukwenza izimiso zakho njalo, yebo, kuze kube sekupheleni.
119.113: Ngiyabazonda abanhliziyo mbili, kepha umthetho wakho ngiyawuthanda.
119.114: Wena uyisiphephelo sami nesihlangu sami; ngiyethemba izwi lakho.
119.115: Sukani kimi nina enenza okubi, ngokuba ngiyakugcina imiyalo kaNkulunkulu wami.
119.116: Ngiphase ngokwezwi lakho, ukuze ngiphile, ngingajabhi ngethemba lami.
119.117: Ngisekele, ngize ngisindiswe, ngibheke njalo izimiso zakho.
119.118: Uyabadelela bonke abaduka ezimisweni zakho, ngokuba ubuqili babo buyize.
119.119: Uyabalahla bonke ababi bomhlaba njengendiva; ngalokho ngiyathanda ubufakazi bakho.
119.120: Inyama yami iyathuthumela ngovalo ngawe, ngiyesaba izahlulelo zakho.
119.121: Ngiyenza ukwahlulela nokulunga; unganginikeli kubo abahluphi bami.
119.122: Mela inceku yakho kube kuhle; abazidlayo mabangangicindezeli.
119.123: Amehlo ami ayalangazelela insindiso yakho nezwi lokulunga kwakho.
119.124: Yenza encekwini yakho ngokomusa wakho, ungifundise izimiso zakho.
119.125: Ngiyinceku yakho; ngiphe ingqondo ukuba ngazi ubufakazi bakho.
119.126: Kuyisikhathi sikaJehova sokusebenza, ngokuba bawenz' ize umthetho wakho.
119.127: Ngalokho ngiyathanda imiyalo yakho kunegolide, yebo, kunegolide elicwengekileyo.
119.128: Ngalokho ngiyavuma ukuthi imiyalo yakho yonke ilungile; ngiyazonda zonke izindlela zamanga.
119.129: Ubufakazi bakho buyisimangaliso; ngalokho umphefumulo wami uyabugcina.
119.130: Ukwambulwa kwamazwi akho kuyakhanyisa, yebo, kuyabaqondisa abangenalwazi.
119.131: Ngivula umlomo wami, ngikhefuzela, ngokuba ngiyalangazelela imiyalo yakho.
119.132: Bheka kimi, ube nomusa kimi njengokufanele abathanda igama lakho.
119.133: Qinisa izinyathelo zami ezwini lakho; makungangibusi nobubodwa ububi.
119.134: Ngihlenge ekuhlupheni kwabantu, ukuze ngigcine iziyalezo zakho.
119.135: Yikhanyisele inceku yakho ubuso bakho, ngifundise izimiso zakho.
119.136: Imifula yamanzi iyehlela emehlweni ami, ngokuba abagcini umthetho wakho.
119.137: Wena Jehova ulungile; izahlulelo zakho ziqotho.
119.138: Uyalezile ubufakazi bakho ngokulunga ngokuthembeka okukhulu.
119.139: Ukushisekela kwami kungidlile, ngokuba izitha zami zikhohliwe amazwi akho.
119.140: Izwi lakho licwebile kakhulu; ngalokho inceku yakho iyalithanda.
119.142: Ukulunga kwakho kungukulunga okuphakade; umthetho wakho uyiqiniso.
119.143: Ukuhlupheka nosizi kungehlele; imiyalo yakho iyintokozo yami.
119.144: Ukulunga kobufakazi bakho kumi phakade; ngiphe ukuqonda ukuba ngiphile.
119.145: Ngikhala ngenhliziyo yami yonke; ngizwe, Jehova; izimiso zakho ngiyakuzigcina.
119.146: Ngikhala kuwe, ngisindise; ngiyakugcina ubufakazi bakho.
119.147: Ngiyandulela uvivi lokusa ngikhala; ngiyethemba amazwi akho.
119.148: Amehlo ami ayandulela imilindo yobusuku ukuba ngizindle ngezwi lakho.
119.149: Yizwa izwi lami ngokomusa wakho, Jehova, ungiphilise ngokwezahlulelo zakho.
119.150: Bayasondela abalandela ukonakala; bakude nomthetho wakho.
119.151: Wena Jehova useduze; imiyalo yakho yonke iyiqiniso.
119.152: Kudala ngazile ngobufakazi bakho ukuthi ubusekele kuze kube phakade.
119.153: Bheka ukuhlupheka kwami, ungikhulule, ngokuba angikhohlwa umthetho wakho.
119.154: Mela indaba yami, ungihlenge, ungiphilise ngokwezwi lakho.
119.155: Ukusindiswa kukude nababi, ngokuba abafuni izimiso zakho.
119.156: Ububele bakho, Jehova, bukhulu; ngiphilise ngokwezahlulelo zakho.
119.157: Abangizingelayo nabayizitha kimi baningi; kepha ebufakazini bakho angichezuki.
119.158: Lapho ngibona amambuka, ngiyadikibala, ngokuba awagcini izwi lakho.
119.159: Bheka ukuthi ngithanda kangaka iziyalezo zakho, Jehova; ngiphilise ngokomusa wakho.
119.160: Amazwi akho onke ayiqiniso; zonke izahlulelo zakho ezilungileyo zimi kuze kube phakade.
119.161: Izikhulu ziyangizingela, kungekho sizathu, kepha inhliziyo yami iyesaba izwi lakho.
119.162: Ngithokoza ngezwi lakho njengozuza impango enkulu.
119.163: Amanga ngiyawazonda, ngiyawenyanya; umthetho wakho ngiyawuthanda.
119.164: Kasikhombisa ngosuku ngiyakudumisa ngezahlulelo zokulunga kwakho.
119.165: Abathanda umthetho wakho banokuthula okukhulu; akukho sikhubekiso kubo.
119.166: Ngiyethemba insindiso yakho, Jehova; imiyalo yakho ngiyayenza.
119.167: Umphefumulo wami uyagcina ubufakazi bakho; ngiyabuthanda kakhulu.
119.168: Ngiyagcina iziyalezo zakho nobufakazi bakho, ngokuba izindlela zami zonke ziphambi kwakho.
119.169: Ukukhala kwami makusondele ebusweni bakho, Jehova; ngiqondise ngokwezwi lakho.
119.170: Ukuncenga kwami makuze ebusweni bakho; ngihlenge ngokwezwi lakho.
119.171: Umlomo wami mawuchichime indumiso, ngokuba uyangifundisa izimiso zakho.
119.172: Ulimi lwami malukhulume izwi lakho, ngokuba imiyalo yakho yonke ilungile.
119.173: Isandla sakho masibe lusizo kimi, ngokuba ngikhethile iziyalezo zakho.
119.174: Ngiyalangazelela insindiso yakho, Jehova; umthetho wakho uyintokozo yami.
119.175: Umphefumulo wami mawuphile, ukudumise; izahlulelo zakho mazingisize.
119.176: Ngiyaduka njengemvu elahlekileyo; funa inceku yakho, ngokuba angikhohlwa imiyalo yakho.

120.2: Jehova, hlenga umphefumulo wami emlonyeni wamanga nasolimini lwenkohliso.
120.3: Uyakuvuzwa ngani, uyakwenezelelwani wena lulimi lwenkohliso, na?
120.5: Maye kimi! Ngokuba ngigogobele kwaMesheke, ngihlezi ematendeni akwaKedari.
120.6: Umphefumulo wami sekukade wahlala naye ozonda ukuthula.

121.1: Ngiphakamisela amehlo ami ezintabeni; usizo lwami luvelaphi na?
121.2: Usizo lwami luvela kuJehova owenzile izulu nomhlaba.
121.3: Akayikuvuma ukuba unyawo lwakho lushelele; okulondolozayo akayikozela.
121.5: UJehova ungumlondi wakho; uJehova ungumthunzi wakho ngasesandleni sakho sokunene.
121.7: UJehova uyakukulondoloza ebubini bonke; uyakulonda umphefumulo wakho.
121.8: UJehova uyakulondoloza ukuphuma kwakho nokungena kwakho kusukela kulesi sikhathi kuze kube phakade.

122.1: Ngajabula lapho bethi kimi: “Masiye endlini kaJehova.”
122.2: Izinyawo zethu sezimi emasangweni akho, Jerusalema,
122.3: Jerusalema, wena owakhiwe njengomuzi ohlanganisiwe ngokuqinileyo,
122.4: lapho imindeni ikhuphukela khona, imindeni kaJehova, ngokomthetho ka-Israyeli ukuba idumise igama likaJehova.
122.5: Ngokuba kumisiwe khona izihlalo zokwahlulela, izihlalo zobukhosi zendlu kaDavide.
122.7: Makube khona ukuthula phakathi kwezingange zakho, nenhlanhla ezindlini zakho zobukhosi.”
122.8: Ngenxa yabafowethu nabangane bethu ngizakuthi manje: “Makube khona ukuthula kuwe.”
122.9: Ngenxa yendlu kaJehova uNkulunkulu wethu ngiyakukufunela okuhle.

123.1: Ngiyaphakamisela kuwe amehlo ami, wena ohlezi ezulwini.
123.2: Bheka, njengamehlo ezinceku ekuzo izandla zamakhosi azo, namehlo encekukazi ekuso isandla senkosikazi yayo, kanjalo amehlo ethu akuye uJehova uNkulunkulu wethu, aze abe nomusa kithi.
123.3: Sihawukele, Jehova sihawukele, ngokuba sesidiniwe kakhulu ngukudelelwa.
123.4: Umphefumulo wethu udiniwe kakhulu ngukweyisa kwabaziqhenyayo nokudelela kwabazidlayo.

124.1: Uma uJehova ebengenathi, makasho njalo manje u-Israyeli,
124.2: uma uJehova ebengenathi, lapho abantu besivukela,
124.3: ngabe sebesigwinyile ekuvutheni kolaka lwabo kithina;
124.4: amanzi ngabe asewele phezu kwethu, kudlule isikhukhula phezu komphefumulo wethu,
124.5: kudlule phezu komphefumulo wethu amanzi akhukhumeleyo.
124.6: Makabongwe uJehova ongasinikelanga ukuba sibe yimpango yamazinyo abo.
124.7: Umphefumulo wethu uphunyukile njengenyoni ogibeni lwabacuphi; ugibe lwaphukile, thina saphunyuka.
124.8: Usizo lwethu lusegameni likaJehova owenzile izulu nomhlaba.

125.1: Abamethembayo uJehova bafana nentaba yaseSiyoni engenakunyakaziswa kepha imi phakade.
125.2: Njengalokhu izintaba zihaqa iJerusalema, kanjalo uJehova uhaqa abantu bakhe kalokhu kuze kube phakade.
125.3: Ngokuba intonga yababi ayinakuhlala phezu kwesabelo sabalungileyo, funa abalungileyo belulele izandla zabo kokubi.
125.4: Jehova, yenza okuhle kubo abalungileyo nabaqotho ezinhliziyweni zabo.
125.5: Kepha abaphambukela ezindleleni zabo eziyizinsongensonge uJehova uzakubahambisa kanye nabenza okubi. Ukuthula makube phezu kuka-Israyeli.

126.1: Lapho uJehova abuyisa ukuthunjwa kweSiyoni, sasinjengabaphuphayo.
126.2: Umlomo wethu wawusugcwala ukuhleka nolimi lwethu ukuhuba; bathi phakathi kwabezizwe: UJehova ubenzele izinto ezinkulu.
126.4: Buyisa, Jehova, ukuthunjwa kwethu njengemifula yaseningizimu.
126.6: Ohamba ekhala izinyembezi, ephethe imbewu yokuhlwanyela, uyakubuya ngokuthokoza, ephethe izinyanda zakhe.

127.1: Uma uJehova engayakhi indlu, basebenzela ize abayakhayo; uma uJehova engalondolozi umuzi, umlindi wawo ulindela ize.
127.2: Kuyize kini ukuba nivuke ekuseni, nephuze ukuphumula, nidle isinkwa sezinhlupheko, ngokuba uyamupha othandiweyo wakhe esalele.
127.3: Bheka, abantwana bayifa elivela kuJehova, isithelo sesisu singumvuzo.
127.4: Njengemicibisholo esandleni seqhawe banjalo abantwana bobusha.
127.5: Ibusisiwe indoda emgodla wayo ugcwele bona; abayikujabha lapho bekhuluma nezitha zabo esangweni.

128.1: Babusisiwe bonke abamesabayo uJehova, abahamba ngezindlela zakhe.
128.2: Ngokuba uyakudla umsebenzi wezandla zakho; uyakuba nenhlanhla nempumelelo.
128.3: Umkakho uyakuba njengomnqumo othelayo phakathi kwendlu yakho, abantwana bakho babe njengezithombo zomnqumo, bezungeza itafula lakho.
128.4: Ngokuba bheka, kanjalo iyakubusiswa indoda emesabayo uJehova.
128.5: UJehova makakubusise eseSiyoni; uyakubona inhlanhla yaseJerusalema zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakho.
128.6: Uyakubona abantwana babantwana bakho. Ukuthula makube phezu kuka-Israyeli.

129.1: Bangihluphile kaningi kwasebusheni bami, makasho njalo u-Israyeli.
129.3: Abalimi balima emhlane wami, benza ibe mide imisele yabo.
129.5: Mabajabhiswe, babuyiselwe emuva bonke abazonda iSiyoni.
129.7: Ovunayo akagcwalisi ngabo isandla sakhe, nobopha izinyanda izingalo zakhe.
129.8: Abadlulayo abasho ukuthi: “Isibusiso sikaJehova masibe phezu kwenu; siyanibusisa egameni likaJehova.”

130.2: Nkosi, yizwa izwi lami; izindlebe zakho mazilalele izwi lokuncenga kwami.
130.3: Uma wena Jehova uqaphela iziphambeko, Nkosi, ngubani ongema na?
130.5: Ngiyalindela uJehova, umphefumulo wami uyalinda; ngiyalethemba izwi lakhe.
130.6: Umphefumulo wami uyalindela iNkosi kunabalindi belindela ukusa.
130.7: U-Israyeli makamethembe uJehova, ngokuba umusa ukuJehova, nokukhulula okuningi kukuye.

131.1: Jehova, inhliziyo yami ayikhukhumali, amehlo ami awaziphakamisi; angingeni ezindabeni ezinkulu nasezintweni ezingahlulayo.
131.2: Ngiduduzile, ngawuthulisa umphefumulo wami; njengomntwana olunyuliweyo kunina, njengolumulekileyo, unjalo umphefumulo wami phakathi kwami.
131.3: Israyeli, yethemba uJehova kusukela kulesi sikhathi kuze kube phakade.

132.1: Jehova, mkhumbulele uDavide zonke izinhlupheko zakhe
132.2: ukuthi wafunga kuJehova, wenza isithembiso kuye onguMninimandla kaJakobe, ethi:
132.3: “Angiyikungena etendeni lendlu yami; angiyikwenyukela embhedeni wami;
132.4: angiyikunika amehlo ami ubuthongo, nezinkophe zami ukozela
132.5: ngingakatholeli uJehova indawo, indlu yonguMninimandla kaJakobe.”
132.6: Bheka, sizwile ngakho e-Efratha, sakufumana ezweni laseJari.
132.7: “Masingene endlini yakhe, sikhuleke ngasesenabelweni sezinyawo zakhe.
132.8: Vuka, Jehova, uye ekuphumuleni kwakho, wena nomphongolo wamandla akho.
132.9: Abapristi bakho mabembeswe ukulunga, abangcwele bakho bethabe.”
132.10: Ngenxa yenceku yakho uDavide mawungaphenduli ubuso bogcotshiweyo wakho.
132.11: UJehova ufungile kuDavide ngeqiniso, akabuyi kukho, ethi: “Owenzalo yomzimba wakho ngiyakumbeka esihlalweni sakho sobukhosi.
132.12: Uma abantwana bakho begcina isivumelwano sami nobufakazi bami engiyakubafundisa bona, khona abantwana babo bayakuhlala esihlalweni sakho kuze kube phakade.”
132.13: Ngokuba uJehova ukhethile iSiyoni; ulithandile libe yindawo yakhe yokuhlala:
132.14: “Yona ingeyokuphumula kwami kuze kube phakade; lapha ngiyakuhlala khona, ngokuba ngiyifunile.
132.15: Ngiyakubusisa kakhulu ukudla kwalo; abampofu balo ngiyakubasuthisa ngesinkwa.
132.16: Abapristi balo ngiyakubembesa insindiso; abangcwele balo bayakumemeza nokumemeza ngenjabulo.
132.17: “Ngiyakuhlumisa uphondo lukaDavide, ogcotshiweyo wami ngimlungisele isibani.
132.18: Izitha zalo ngiyakuzembesa ihlazo, kepha kuyena uqobo umqhele wakhe uyakukhazimula.”

133.1: Bheka, kuhle, kumnandi kangaka ukuba abazalwane bahlalisane ndawonye bemunye.
133.2: Kufana namafutha amahle ekhanda ehlela esilevini, isilevu sika-Aroni, ehlela nasemphethweni wezambatho zakhe.
133.3: Kufana namazolo aseHermoni ehlela ezintabeni zaseSiyoni. Ngokuba uJehova wayaleza khona isibusiso, yebo, ukuphila kuze kube phakade.

134.1: Bhekani, nibonge uJehova nina nonke zinceku zikaJehova enimi endlini kaJehova ebusuku.
134.2: Phakamiselani izandla zenu endlini engcwele, nimbonge uJehova.
134.3: UJehova makakubusise eseSiyoni, yena owenzile izulu nomhlaba.

135.1: Haleluya! Dumisani igama likaJehova; mdumiseni nina zinceku zikaJehova
135.2: enimi endlini kaJehova emagcekeni endlu kaNkulunkulu wethu.
135.3: Dumisani uJehova, ngokuba uJehova muhle; hubelani igama lakhe, ngokuba limnandi.
135.4: Ngokuba uJehova uzikhethele uJakobe, no-Israyeli ukuba abe yimfuyo yakhe.
135.5: Impela ngiyazi ukuthi uJehova mkhulu nokuthi iNkosi yethu iphezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
135.6: Konke uJehova akuthandayo uyakwenza ezulwini nasemhlabeni, emanzini nasezinzulwini zonke.
135.7: Ukhuphula izinkungu emikhawulweni yomhlaba, wenza imibani kube yimvula; ukhipha umoya ezingotsheni zakhe.
135.8: Washaya amazibulo aseGibithe, awabantu kanye nawezilwane.
135.9: Wathuma izibonakaliso nezimangaliso phakathi kwakho, Gibithe, phezu kukaFaro nezinceku zakhe zonke.
135.10: Washaya izizwe ezinkulu, wabulala amakhosi anamandla:
135.11: uSihoni inkosi yama-Amori, no-Ogi inkosi yaseBashani, nemibuso yonke yaseKhanani.
135.12: Wanika izwe labo laba yifa, laba yifa lika-Israyeli, isizwe sakhe.
135.13: Jehova, igama lakho limi phakade; isikhumbuzo sakho, Jehova, sisezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
135.14: Ngokuba uJehova uyakwahlulela abantu bakhe, ahawukele izinceku zakhe.
135.15: Izithombe zabezizwe ziyisiliva negolide, umsebenzi wezandla zomuntu.
135.16: Umlomo zinawo, kepha azikhulumi; amehlo zinawo, kodwa aziboni.
135.17: Izindlebe zinazo, kepha azizwa, nomoya awukho emlonyeni wazo.
135.19: Wena ndlu ka-Israyeli, mbonge uJehova; wena ndlu ka-Aroni, mbonge uJehova.
135.20: Wena ndlu kaLevi, mbonge uJehova; nina enimesabayo uJehova, mbongeni uJehova.
135.21: UJehova makabongwe eSiyoni, yena owakhe eJerusalema. Haleluya!

136.1: Bongani uJehova, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
136.2: Bongani uNkulunkulu wawonkulunkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
136.3: Bongani iNkosi yamakhosi, ngokuba umusa wayo umi phakade;
136.4: yona engoyedwa owenza izimangaliso ezinkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.5: owenzile izulu ngokuhlakanipha, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.6: owendlala umhlaba phezu kwamanzi, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.7: owenza izinkanyiso ezinkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.8: ilanga ukuba libuse emini, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.9: inyanga nezinkanyezi ukuba zibuse ebusuku, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.10: owalishaya iGibithe, amazibulo alo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.11: owamkhipha u-Israyeli phakathi kwabo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.12: ngesandla esinamandla nangengalo eyeluliweyo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.13: owahlukanisa kabili uLwandle Olubomvu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.14: owawelisa u-Israyeli phakathi kwalo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.15: owachitha uFaro nempi yakhe eLwandle Olubomvu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.16: owahola abantu bakhe ehlane, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.17: owashaya amakhosi amakhulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.18: owabulala amakhosi adumileyo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.19: uSihoni inkosi yama-Amori, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.20: no-Ogi inkosi yaseBashani, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.21: owanika izwe labo laba yifa, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.22: laba yifa lika-Israyeli inceku yakhe, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.23: owasikhumbula sisephansi, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.24: owasikhulula ezitheni zethu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
136.25: onika inyama yonke ukudla, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
136.26: Bongani uNkulunkulu wezulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.

137.1: Ngasemifuleni yaseBabele sahlala khona, sakhala, lapho sikhumbula iSiyoni.
137.2: Amahabhu* ethu sawaphanyeka eminyezaneni ephakathi kwalo.
137.3: Ngokuba abasithumbileyo bacela ukuba sihlabelele igama, nabahluphi bethu bafuna injabulo, bethi: “Sihlabeleleni elinye lamagama aseSiyoni.”
137.4: Siyakuhlabelela kanjani ihubo likaJehova kwelinye izwe na?
137.5: Uma ngikhohlwa wena Jerusalema, masizikhohlwe isandla sami sokunene.
137.6: Ulimi lwami malunamathele olwangeni lwami, uma ngingakukhumbuli, uma ngingaphakamisi iJerusalema phezu kwentokozo yami enkulu.
137.7: Khumbula, Jehova, usuku lweJerusalema, ngenxa yabantwana bakwa-Edomi abathi: “Dilizani, dilizani, kuze kube sesisekelweni salo.”
137.8: Ndodakazi yaseBabele, wena oyakubhujiswa, ubusisiwe oyakuphindisela kuwe izenzo zakho owazenza kithina.
137.9: Ubusisiwe oyakubamba abancane bakho, abaphahlaze edwaleni.

138.1: Ngiyakukubonga ngenhliziyo yami yonke; phambi kwawonkulunkulu ngiyakukuhubela.
138.2: Ngiyakukhuleka phambi kwethempeli lakho elingcwele, ngibonge igama lakho ngenxa yomusa wakho neqiniso lakho, ngokuba phezu kwakho konke uphakamisile igama lakho nezwi lakho.
138.3: Ngosuku engakhala ngalo wangiphendula; wangiqunga isibindi, wangipha amandla emphefumulweni wami.
138.4: Onke amakhosi omhlaba ayakukubonga, Jehova, lapho ezwile amazwi omlomo wakho.
138.5: Yebo, ayakuhlabelela ngezindlela zikaJehova, ngokuba inkulu inkazimulo kaJehova.
138.6: Ngokuba noma uJehova ephakeme, uyanakekela nokho ophansi; uyamazi ozidlayo ekude.
138.7: Noma ngihamba phakathi kwenhlupheko, uyakungiphilisa; uyakwelulela isandla sakho olakeni lwezitha zami, esokunene sakho singisindise.
138.8: UJehova uyakufeza okwami; Jehova, umusa wakho umi phakade; ungashiyi imisebenzi yezandla zakho.

139.2: Uyakwazi ukuhlala kwami nokuvuka kwami, uqonda umcabango wami ukude.
139.3: Uyaphenya ukuhamba kwami nokulala kwami, wazana nezindlela zonke zami.
139.4: Ngokuba alikho izwi olimini lwami, Jehova, ongalaziyo ngokupheleleyo.
139.5: Ungizungezile ngasemuva nangaphambili, wabeka isandla sakho phezu kwami.
139.6: Ukwazi okunjalo kuyangimangalisa; kuphakeme, anginakufinyelela kukho.
139.7: Ngiyakuyaphi, ngisuke emoyeni wakho, na? Ngiyakubalekelaphi, ngimuke ebusweni bakho, na?
139.8: Uma ngikhuphukela ezulwini, wena ulapho; uma ngendlala icansi lami endaweni yabafileyo, nangu wena.
139.9: Uma ngithabatha amaphiko okusa, ngiye ngihlale emikhawulweni yolwandle,
139.10: nalapho isandla sakho siyakungihola, esokunene sakho singibambe.
139.11: Uma bengithi: “Ubumnyama mabungehlele, ukukhanya kube ngubusuku kimi,”
139.12: ubumnyama bebungayikuba mnyama kuwe, ngokuba ubusuku bebuyakukhanya njengemini, ubumnyama bufane nokukhanya.
139.13: Ngokuba wena uzenzile izinso zami, wangaluka esiswini sikamame.
139.14: Ngiyakukubonga, ngokuba ngenziwa ngokwesabekayo nangokumangalisayo; imisebenzi yakho iyamangalisa; umphefumulo wami uyakwazi kahle.
139.15: Amathambo ami ayengafihlekile kuwe, lapho ngenziwa ekusithekeni, ngibunjwa ezindaweni ezijulileyo zomhlaba.
139.16: Amehlo akho angibona ngiseyihlule; zonke izinsuku zami zalotshwa encwadini yakho, zanqunywa, lungakafiki nolulodwa kuzo.
139.17: Imicabango yakho, Nkulunkulu, ingamagugu kimi; bukhulu kangaka ubuningi bayo.
139.18: Uma bengiyakuyibala, miningi kunesihlabathi; lapho ngivuka, bengiyakuba nawe.
139.19: Sengathi ungabulala ababi, Nkulunkulu; ngalokho sukani kimi nina bantu begazi.
139.20: Bakhuluma ngamacebo ngawe, baliphatha ngeze igama lakho.
139.21: Jehova, angibazondi abakuzondayo na? Anginengwa ngabakuvukelayo na?
139.23: Ngihole, Nkulunkulu, wazi inhliziyo yami; ngilinge, wazi imicabango yami,
139.24: ubone, uma kukhona indlela yosizi kimi, ungiholele endleleni yaphakade.

140.1: Ngikhulule, Jehova, kumuntu omubi, ngilondoloze kumuntu oyisidlwangudlwangu.
140.2: Baceba okubi enhliziyweni yabo; izinsuku zonke baviva impi.
140.3: Bayalola ulimi lwabo njengenyoka; isihlungu samabululu siphansi kwezindebe zabo.
140.4: Ngilondoloze ezandleni zomubi, ngilinde kumuntu oyisidlwangudlwangu, oceba ukukhuba izinyawo zami.
140.5: Abazidlayo bangifihlela ugibe; ngezintambo bendlala inetha; eceleni kwendlela bangibekela izihibe.
140.6: Ngathi kuJehova: “UnguNkulunkulu wami wena.” Yizwa, Jehova, izwi lokunxusa kwami.
140.7: Jehova Nkosi yami, mandla ensindiso yami, uvikela ikhanda lami ngosuku lokulwa.
140.8: Ungazivumeli, Jehova, izifiso zababi; ungaphumelelisi amacebo abo, funa baziphakamise.
140.9: Maqondana nesihlungu sabangizungezayo mabambozwe ngububi bomlomo wabo.
140.10: Amalahle ashisayo mawawele phezu kwabo; mabaphonswe emlilweni nasemigodini ejulileyo, bangabe besavuka.
140.11: Umuntu wamanga makangamiswa emhlabeni; ububi mabuzingele umuntu oyisidlwangudlwangu, abhujiswe.
140.12: Ngiyazi ukuthi uJehova uyakumela udaba lohluphekayo nokufaneleyo kwabampofu.
140.13: Impela abalungileyo bayakubonga igama lakho; abaqotho bayakuhlala ebusweni bakho.

141.1: Simakade, ngikhala kuwe, phuthuma uze kimi, lalela izwi lami lapho ngikhuleka kuwe.
141.2: Umkhuleko wami mawufane nempepho phambi kwakho, nokuphakanyiswa kwezandla zami, njengomnikelo wakusihlwa.
141.3: Simakade, bekela umlomo wami umlindi, ugcine umnyango wezindebe zami.
141.4: Ungayiphenduleli inhliziyo yami entweni embi ukuba ngenze imisebenzi yenkohlakalo kanye nabantu abenza inkohlakalo, ngingadli izibiliboco zabo.
141.5: Olungileyo makangishaye, kungumusa kimi; angisole, kungamafutha ekhanda; ikhanda lami malingawenqabi, ngokuba umkhuleko wami umelane nobubi babo.
141.6: Abehluleli babo bayakuphonswa eweni; bayakuzwa ukuthi amazwi ami amnandi.
141.7: Njengalokhu umuntu elima, eklaya umhlabathi, amathambo ethu ahlakazekile ngasemlonyeni wendawo yabafileyo.
141.8: Amehlo ami akuwe Simakade, Nkosi yami, mina ngiphephela kuwe, uze ungangishiyi ngingenamvikeli.
141.9: Ngihlenge ogibeni abangicuphe ngalo, nasezihibeni zabenza okubi.
141.10: Ababi mabawele emanetheni abo, mina ngidlule kuwo.

142.1: Ngiyakhala kuJehova ngezwi lami, ngincenga uJehova ngezwi lami.
142.2: Ngiyathulula ebusweni bakhe isikhalo sami, ngibonakalisa kuye inhlupheko yami.
142.3: Lapho umoya wami udangala phakathi kwami, wena uyawazi umkhondo wami; endleleni engihamba ngayo bangifihlele ugibe.
142.4: Bheka ngakwesokunene sami, ubone ukuthi akakho onginakekelayo; isiphephelo singiphuthele, akakho okhathalela umphefumulo wami.
142.5: Ngikhala kuwe Jehova, ngithi: “Wena uyisiphephelo sami nesabelo sami ezweni labaphilayo.”
142.6: Lalela ukukhala kwami, ngokuba ngicindezelekile kakhulu; ngikhulule kubo abangizingelayo, ngokuba banamandla kunami.
142.7: Khipha umphefumulo wami etilongweni ukuba ngibonge igama lakho; abalungileyo bayakungizungeza, ngokuba uyakungiphatha kahle.

143.1: Jehova, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe ekuncengeni kwami; ungiphendule ngokuthembeka kwakho nokulunga kwakho.
143.2: Ungangeni ekwahluleleni nenceku yakho, ngokuba akukho muntu okhona olungile emehlweni akho.
143.3: Ngokuba isitha siyazingela umphefumulo wami, sicindezela phansi emhlabathini ukuphila kwami; singihlalisile ebumnyameni njengabakade bafa.
143.4: Umoya wami uphelile kimi; inhliziyo yami igongobele phakathi kwami.
143.5: Ngiyakhumbula izinsuku zasendulo, ngizindla ngemisebenzi yakho yonke, ngicabange ngezenzo zezandla zakho.
143.6: Ngiyazelulela izandla zami kuwe; umphefumulo wami womela wena njengomhlaba owomileyo.
143.7: Shesha ungiphendule, Jehova; umoya wami uyaphela; ungangifihleli ubuso bakho, funa ngifane nabashona egodini.
143.8: Ngizwise umusa wakho ekuseni, ngokuba ngiyethemba kuwe; ngazise indlela engifanele ukuhamba ngayo, ngokuba ngiphakamisela kuwe umphefumulo wami.
143.9: Ngikhulule ezitheni zami; Jehova, ngicashe kuwe.
143.10: Ngifundise ukwenza intando yakho, ngokuba wena unguNkulunkulu wami; umoya wakho omuhle mawungihole emhlabathini olelezekileyo.
143.11: Jehova, ngiphilise ngenxa yegama lakho, ngokulunga kwakho uwukhiphe umphefumulo wami ekuhluphekeni.
143.12: Zinqume izitha zami ngomusa wakho, ubabhubhise bonke abahlupha umphefumulo wami, ngokuba ngiyinceku yakho.

144.1: Makabongwe uJehova, idwala lami, ofundisa izandla zami ukuhlasela neminwe yami ukulwa,
144.2: umusa wami nenqaba yami, umbhoshongo wami ophakemeyo nomkhululi wami, isihlangu sami, nengiphephela kuye, nothobisa abantu bami phansi kwami.
144.3: Jehova, uyini umuntu ukuba umazi, nendodana yomuntu ukuba uyikhumbule, na?
144.4: Umuntu ufana nomoya; izinsuku zakhe zinjengethunzi elidlulayo.
144.5: Thobisa amazulu akho, Jehova, wehle; thinta izintaba, zithunqe.
144.6: Imibani mayinyazime, ubahlakaze; thuma imicibisholo yakho, ubaphithizise.
144.7: Yelula isandla sakho phezulu, ungikhulule, ungophule emanzini amakhulu nasesandleni sabafokazi
144.8: abamlomo wabo ukhuluma inkohliso, nesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene samanga.
144.9: Ngiyakuhlabelela kuwe Nkulunkulu isihlabelelo esisha; ngogubhu olunezintambo eziyishumi ngiyakukuhubela.
144.10: Nguye onika amakhosi insindiso, okhulula inceku yakhe uDavide enkembeni elimazayo.
144.11: Ngikhulule, ungophule esandleni sabafokazi abamlomo wabo ukhuluma inkohliso, nesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene samanga.
144.12: Lapho amadodana ethu enjengezithombo ezikhulileyo ebusheni bazo, namadodakazi ethu enjengamatshe amagumbi abaziwe ngendlela yokwakhiwa kwezindlu zamakhosi;
144.13: lapho izingobo zethu zigcwele, ziveza izinhlobo ngezinhlobo, nezimvu zethu zizala ngezinkulungwane, yebo, ngezinkulungwane eziyishumi emadlelweni ethu;
144.14: lapho izinkabi zethu zithweswe kakhulu, nalapho kungekho ukufohla kwesitha nokungena empini nezikhalo ezitaladini zethu,
144.15: babusisiwe abantu abanjalo; babusisiwe abantu abaNkulunkulu wabo unguJehova.

145.1: Ngiyakukuphakamisa wena Nkulunkulu wami, Nkosi, ngilituse igama lakho phakade naphakade.
145.2: Imihla yonke ngiyakukubonga, ngilidumise igama lakho phakade naphakade.
145.3: Mkhulu uJehova, umelwe ukudunyiswa kakhulu; ubukhulu bakhe abuphenyisiseki.
145.4: Isizukulwane siyakubabaza kwesinye imisebenzi yakho, simemezele izenzo zakho zamandla.
145.5: Ngiyakuzindla ngenkazimulo nodumo lobukhosi bakho nangezimangaliso zakho.
145.6: Abantu bayakukhuluma ngamandla ezenzo zakho ezesabekayo; ubukhulu bakho ngiyakubumemezela.
145.7: Bayakweneka kakhulu inkumbulo yobuhle bakho obukhulu, bahube ngokulunga kwakho.
145.8: UJehova unesihe nobumnene; uyephuza ukuthukuthela, mkhulu ngomusa.
145.9: UJehova muhle kubo bonke; uyayihawukela imisebenzi yakhe yonke.
145.10: Yonke imisebenzi yakho iyakukudumisa, abangcwele bakho bakubonge.
145.11: Ngenkazimulo yombuso wakho bayakukhuluma, bashumayele ngamandla akho
145.12: ukuba babazise abantwana babantu izenzo zakho zamandla nenkazimulo yobukhosi bombuso wakho.
145.13: Umbuso wakho ungumbuso kuze kube phakade; ubukhosi bakho busezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
145.14: UJehova uyaphasa bonke abawayo, abavuse bonke abathotshisiweyo.
145.15: Amehlo abo bonke alinda wena; uyabanika ukudla ngesikhathi esiyiso.
145.16: Uyavula isandla sakho, usuthise ukufisa kwakho konke okuphilayo.
145.17: UJehova ulungile ezindleleni zakhe zonke, unomusa emisebenzini yakhe yonke.
145.18: UJehova useduze nabo bonke abambizayo, bonke abambizayo ngeqiniso.
145.19: Uyasuthisa ukufisa kwabamesabayo; uyezwa ukukhala kwabo, abasindise.
145.20: UJehova uyalondoloza bonke abamthandayo, kepha ababi bonke uyakubabhubhisa.
145.21: Umlomo wami uyakukhuluma udumo lukaJehova, inyama yonke ibonge igama lakhe elingcwele kuze kube phakade.

146.2: Ngisaphila ngiyakumdumisa uJehova, ngihube kuNkulunkulu wami ngisekhona.
146.3: Ningethembi ezikhulwini nasendodaneni yomuntu okungekho kuyo ukusiza.
146.4: Umoya wakhe uyaphuma, yena abuyele emhlabathini wakhe; ngalona lolo suku amacebo akhe ayaphela.
146.5: Ubusisiwe yena omsizi wakhe unguNkulunkulu kaJakobe, othemba lakhe likuJehova uNkulunkulu wakhe
146.6: owenzile izulu nomhlaba, nolwandle, nakho konke okuphakathi kwakho, ogcina iqiniso kuze kube phakade;
146.7: obenzela abacindezelweyo ukwahlulela, obapha abalambileyo ukudla; uJehova uyakhulula iziboshwa.
146.8: UJehova uyenza ukuba izimpumputhe zibone; uJehova uyavusa abathotshisiweyo; uJehova uyathanda abalungileyo.
146.9: UJehova uyalondoloza abafokazi; uyaphasa intandane nomfelokazi; kepha indlela yababi uyayiphambanisa.
146.10: UJehova uyabusa kuze kube phakade, uNkulunkulu wakho, Siyoni, ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane. Haleluya!

147.1: Haleluya! Ngokuba kuhle ukuhlabelela kuNkulunkulu wethu, yebo, kumnandi; ukudumisa kufanele.
147.2: UJehova uyalakha iJerusalema; abaxoshiweyo bakwa-Israyeli uyababutha.
147.3: Uyaphilisa abenhliziyo echobozekileyo; izilonda zabo uyazibopha.
147.4: Uyabala inani lezinkanyezi, azibize zonke ngamagama.
147.5: INkosi yethu inkulu, makhulu amandla ayo; ukuqonda kwakhe akunakulinganiswa.
147.6: UJehova uyaphakamisa abathobekileyo; ababi uyabawisa phansi emhlabathini.
147.7: Hubelani uJehova ngokubonga, nimdumise uNkulunkulu wethu ngehabhu,*
147.8: osibekela izulu ngamafu, olungisela umhlaba imvula, ohlumisa utshani ezintabeni.
147.9: Unika izinkomo ukudla kwazo, namazinyane egwababa akhalayo.
147.10: Akathokozi ngamandla ehhashi, akajabuleli imilenze yomuntu.
147.11: UJehova uyathokoza ngabamesabayo, abathemba umusa wakhe.
147.12: Jerusalema, mbabaze uJehova; Siyoni, mdumise uNkulunkulu wakho.
147.13: Ngokuba uqinisile imigoqo yamasango; ubusisile abantwana bakho phakathi kwakho.
147.14: Uyenza ukuthula emikhawulweni yakho; uyakusuthisa ngokolweni omuhle.
147.15: Uyathumela umyalo wakhe emhlabeni; izwi lakhe ligijima ngejubane elikhulu.
147.16: Uyanika iqhwa njengoboya; uhlakaza isithwathwa njengomlotha.
147.17: Uyaphonsa isichotho sakhe njengezinhlamvu; ngubani ongema phambi kwamakhaza akhe na?
147.18: Uyathuma izwi lakhe, likuncibilikise; uyavusa umoya wakhe, amanzi agobhoze.
147.19: Uyatshengisa izwi lakhe kuJakobe, izimiso zakhe nezahlulelo zakhe ku-Israyeli.
147.20: Akenzanga njalo kwesinye isizwe nesisodwa: izahlulelo zakhe asizazi. Haleluya!

148.1: Haleluya! Dumisani uJehova ezulwini, nimdumise kweliphezulu.
148.2: Mdumiseni nina zingelosi zakhe zonke, nimdumise nina mabandla akhe onke.
148.3: Mdumiseni nina langa nenyanga, nimdumise nina zinkanyezi zonke ezikhanyayo.
148.4: Mdumiseni nina mazulu amazulu, nina manzi aphezu kwezulu.
148.5: Makuthathe kudumise igama likaJehova, ngokuba wayaleza, kwadaleka.
148.6: Futhi wakumisa kuze kube phakade; washaya umthetho ongenakweqiwa.
148.7: Mdumiseni uJehova emhlabeni nina mikhomo nezintwa zonke,
148.8: nawe mlilo nesichotho, liqhwa nenkwezane, nawe siphepho esenza okwezwi lakhe,
148.9: nani zintaba namagquma onke, nani mithi ethelayo nayo yonke imisedari,*
148.10: nani zilwane nezinkomo zonke, nani eninwabuzelayo nezinyoni ezindizayo,
148.11: nani makhosi omhlaba nabantu bonke, nani zikhulu nabahluleli bonke bomhlaba,
148.12: nani zinsizwa nezintombi, nani maxhegu nabafana.
148.13: Mabadumise igama likaJehova, ngokuba ngelakhe igama lodwa eliphakeme; inkazimulo yakhe iphezu komhlaba nezulu.
148.14: Usephakamisile uphondo lwabantu bakhe; ngalokho bayamdumisa abangcwele bakhe, abantwana bakwa-Israyeli, abantu abaseduze naye. Haleluya!

149.1: Haleluya! Hlabelelani kuJehova igama elisha, indumiso yakhe emhlanganweni wabangcwele.
149.2: U-Israyeli makathokoze ngowamEnzayo, abantwana baseSiyoni bethabele iNkosi yabo.
149.3: Mabadumise igama lakhe ngokusina, bamhubele ngesigubhu nehabhu.*
149.4: Ngokuba uJehova uyathokoza ngabantu bakhe; abathobekileyo uyabahlobisa ngensindiso.
149.6: Ukumphakamisa uNkulunkulu makube semlonyeni wabo, nenkemba esika nhlangothi zombili esandleni sabo,
149.7: ukuba benze impindiselo kubo abezizwe nezijeziso kubantu,
149.8: babophe amakhosi abo ngamaketanga nabadumileyo babo ngezibopho zensimbi,
149.9: bafeze phezu kwabo isahlulelo esilotshiweyo; kuludumo kubo bonke abangcwele bakhe. Haleluya!

150.1: Haleluya! Dumisani uNkulunkulu endlini yakhe engcwele, nimdumise emkhathini wakhe wamandla.
150.2: Mdumiseni ngenxa yezenzo zakhe zamandla, nimdumise ngenxa yobukhosi bakhe obukhulu.
150.3: Mdumiseni ngezwi lecilongo, nimdumise ngogubhu nehabhu.*
150.4: Mdumiseni ngesigubhu nokusina, nimdumise ngezingubhu ezinezintambo eziyishumi nemitshingo.
150.5: Mdumiseni ngamasimbali* ancencethayo, nimdumise ngezinsimbi ezikhencezayo.
